detail.abstract: At the end of Q3 2025, Russia's current account surplus amounted to $8.2 bn, up 5% compared to Q3 2024. The financial account deficit of $11.5 bn in Q3 2025 was due to an increase in foreign assets and a decrease in foreign liabilities. In Q3 2025, the ruble weakened by 5.6% against the US dollar.

AI.tldr: 俄罗斯2025年第三季度国际收支分析：经常账户盈余82亿美元，同比增长5%；金融账户赤字115亿美元，主要因外国资产增加和外国负债减少；卢布兑美元贬值5.6%
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯2025年第三季度国际收支状况如何变化？经常账户、金融账户和汇率变动之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 分析俄罗斯在特定时期（2025年第三季度）的国际收支动态，了解其经济对外部冲击的响应机制，为政策制定和投资决策提供参考
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际收支平衡理论（经常账户与金融账户的关系）、汇率决定理论、国际资本流动理论
AI.method: 描述性统计分析，基于俄罗斯央行公布的官方季度国际收支数据，进行同比和环比比较分析
AI.findings: 1. 经常账户盈余82亿美元，同比增长5%；2. 金融账户赤字115亿美元，主要原因是外国资产增加和外国负债减少；3. 卢布兑美元贬值5.6%，可能与金融账户赤字有关

AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供俄罗斯经济状况的参考，为政策制定者提供汇率管理和资本流动监控的依据，有助于理解俄罗斯经济对外部环境的适应能力

title: Behavioural Biases and Online Purchasing Decisions Among Indian Teenagers

detail.title: Behavioural Biases and Online Purchasing Decisions Among Indian Teenagers

declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was obtained through informed consent procedures. Participation was voluntary, and informed consent was obtained from all participants. All responses were anonymous, and data was collected and recorded securely.

detail.abstract: This study examines how behavioural biases influence online purchasing decisions among Indian teenagers aged 13-19, a demographic increasingly exposed to digitally engineered marketing environments. Drawing on concepts from behavioural economics and psychology, the research focuses on key biases including impulse buying, discount and urgency sensitivity, peer influence, loss aversion, and present bias. Primary data were collected through a structured survey administered to 100 urban Indian teenagers, and analysed using descriptive statistics, correlation analysis, and qualitative thematic interpretation. The results indicate that impulse buying and discount-related urgency cues are the strongest predictors of online purchase behaviour, exhibiting stronger influence than direct peer recommendations. Peer influence and present bias act as reinforcing mechanisms, amplifying impulsive responses rather than independently driving purchases. Correlation analysis reveals strong interrelationships among behavioural biases, suggesting a compounding effect on adolescent consumption patterns. The findings have important implications for digital marketing ethics, adolescent financial literacy, and consumer protection policy, particularly in the context of platforms targeting minors through scarcity framing and promotional nudges. By providing empirical, context-specific evidence from India, this research contributes to the behavioural economics literature on adolescent consumer behaviour in emerging digital markets and highlights the need for targeted interventions to promote responsible online consumption.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨行为偏差如何影响印度13-19岁青少年的在线购买决策，发现冲动购买和折扣相关的紧迫感是最强预测因素，比直接的同伴推荐影响更大。同伴影响和现时偏差作为强化机制，放大冲动反应而非独立驱动购买。
AI.research_question: 行为偏差如何影响印度青少年的在线购买决策？哪些行为偏差（冲动购买、折扣敏感性、紧迫感、同伴影响、损失厌恶、现时偏差）对在线购买行为的影响最大？
AI.motivation: 印度青少年越来越多地暴露在数字化设计的营销环境中，但缺乏对这一特定人群在在线消费中行为偏差影响的实证研究。了解这些偏差对于数字营销伦理、青少年金融素养和消费者保护政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学和心理学理论，包括冲动购买理论、折扣敏感性、紧迫感效应、同伴影响理论、损失厌恶理论和现时偏差理论。
AI.method: 采用结构化问卷调查，收集100名印度城市青少年的主要数据，使用描述性统计、相关分析和定性主题解释进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 冲动购买和折扣相关的紧迫感线索是在线购买行为的最强预测因素；2. 同伴影响和现时偏差作为强化机制，放大冲动反应而非独立驱动购买；3. 相关分析显示行为偏差之间存在强相关关系，表明对青少年消费模式有复合效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴数字市场中青少年消费者行为的文献提供了来自印度的实证、情境特定的证据；揭示了行为偏差之间的复合效应和相互关系；扩展了行为经济学在青少年在线消费领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 对数字营销伦理、青少年金融素养和消费者保护政策具有重要启示；强调需要针对性的干预措施来促进负责任的在线消费；特别关注通过稀缺性框架和促销推动针对未成年人的平台。

title: Contract-Aware Virtual Experimentation for Tourism: Testing Sustainability Nudges with the Silicus Traveler Agent

detail.title: Contract-Aware Virtual Experimentation for Tourism: Testing Sustainability Nudges with the Silicus Traveler Agent
detail.abstract: Field experiments credibly evaluate hospitality nudges but are costly and difficult to scale. We present Silicus Traveler, a contract-aware virtual experimentation framework that conditions large-language-model (LLM) agents with tourism context and calibrates synthetic labels using small human validation samples. Replicating towel/linen reuse and buffet plate-waste interventions, Day Reconstruction Method (DRM) conditioning yields the closest match to field effects after debiasing: reuse ≈ 6.5% (benchmark ≈ 6.8%); waste ≈-32% (benchmark ≈-34%). The calibrated estimator improves 95% CI coverage and reduces MSE versus naive LLM and validation-only baselines. We state external-validity and calibration assumptions and provide guidance on validation size. Results support a situated-cognition mechanism: episodic affect stabilizes heuristics and heightens norm salience. The framework offers an ethical STEP-0 pre-testing tier for tourism sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Silicus Traveler框架，使用LLM代理结合旅游情境进行虚拟实验，通过小规模人工验证样本校准合成标签，有效评估酒店可持续性干预措施，可作为伦理预测试步骤。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个可扩展、成本效益高的虚拟实验框架来评估酒店可持续性干预措施（如毛巾重复使用和自助餐浪费减少），并验证其与实地实验效果的一致性？
AI.motivation: 实地实验虽然可信度高，但成本昂贵且难以规模化。需要开发替代方法来评估酒店可持续性干预措施，以支持旅游业可持续发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于情境认知理论，强调情境化认知机制：情景情感稳定启发式并提高规范显著性。
AI.method: 提出Silicus Traveler框架，使用LLM代理结合旅游情境，通过日重构方法（DRM）进行情境化，利用小规模人工验证样本校准合成标签，复制毛巾重复使用和自助餐浪费干预实验。
AI.findings: DRM情境化后的结果与实地效果最接近：重复使用率≈6.5%（基准≈6.8%）；浪费减少≈-32%（基准≈-34%）。校准估计器提高了95%置信区间覆盖度，降低了均方误差。
AI.theory_contributions: 支持情境认知机制理论，证明情景情感如何稳定启发式并提高规范显著性；为虚拟实验方法提供理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供伦理的STEP-0预测试层级，支持旅游业可持续发展决策；为酒店可持续性干预提供成本效益高的评估工具；提供验证样本规模指导。

title: Robust Optimal Execution in Electronic Markets: Volterra Kernels, Predictor Feedback, and Tail-Aware Risk Control

detail.title: Robust Optimal Execution in Electronic Markets: Volterra Kernels, Predictor Feedback, and Tail-Aware Risk Control

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involves mathematical modeling and analysis of public market data; it does not involve human participants or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently. No external funding was received.

detail.abstract: This paper develops a comprehensive framework for optimal execution in electronic markets under realistic microstructure effects: non-Markovian transient price impact modeled via Volterra integral operators, deterministic observation and execution latency, heavy-tailed execution costs characterized by Extreme Value Theory, non-stationary volatility regimes, and adversarial behavior (maximal extractable value extraction). The execution problem is formulated as a finite-horizon stochastic control task with a risk-sensitive objective incorporating tail-aware measures. Core contributions include: (1) rigorous finite-dimensional Markovian reduction of Volterra dynamics with certified approximation error bounds; (2) existence and uniqueness of viscosity solutions to the risk-sensitive Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation; (3) mean-square stable receding-horizon control with explicit prediction horizon selection; (4) Lyapunov-Krasovskii predictor feedback for latency compensation; (5) Extreme Value Theory calibration for robust risk aversion; (6) online regime detection and parameter learning; (7) composite robustness analysis under joint model uncertainty; and (8) game-theoretic characterization of sandwich attack equilibria. The framework is illustrated with synthetic numerical examples and a realistic Bitcoin liquidation case study.

AI.tldr: 本文为电子市场中的最优执行开发了一个综合框架，考虑了非马尔可夫瞬态价格影响、延迟、厚尾执行成本、非平稳波动率制度和对抗行为等现实微观结构效应，通过风险敏感目标进行控制，并提供多种理论和方法贡献。
AI.research_question: 在考虑现实微观结构效应（非马尔可夫瞬态价格影响、延迟、厚尾执行成本、非平稳波动率制度和对抗行为）的情况下，如何构建电子市场中的最优执行框架？
AI.motivation: 现有最优执行模型通常忽略现实市场微观结构效应，如非马尔可夫价格影响、执行延迟、厚尾成本分布、波动率制度变化和对抗性攻击（如MEV提取），需要开发更全面的框架来处理这些复杂因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. Volterra积分算子建模的非马尔可夫瞬态价格影响；2. 极值理论（EVT）描述厚尾执行成本；3. 风险敏感的随机控制理论；4. 粘性解理论；5. Lyapunov-Krasovskii预测器反馈控制；6. 博弈论分析三明治攻击均衡。
AI.method: 1. 有限维马尔可夫约简技术；2. 风险敏感的Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman方程求解；3. 均方稳定滚动时域控制；4. 在线制度检测和参数学习算法；5. 复合鲁棒性分析；6. 合成数值模拟和比特币清算案例研究。
AI.findings: 1. 成功实现Volterra动力学的有限维马尔可夫约简；2. 证明了风险敏感HJB方程粘性解的存在唯一性；3. 开发了延迟补偿的预测器反馈控制；4. 建立了三明治攻击的博弈论均衡特征；5. 框架在比特币清算案例中展示了实际应用价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. Volterra动力学的有限维马尔可夫约简理论；2. 风险敏感HJB方程粘性解的存在唯一性证明；3. 滚动时域控制的稳定性分析；4. 延迟补偿的Lyapunov-Krasovskii理论；5. 三明治攻击的博弈论均衡特征化。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供具有认证误差界的实用执行算法；2. 极值理论校准的稳健风险规避方法；3. 在线制度检测和参数学习工具；4. 联合模型不确定性的复合鲁棒性分析；5. 比特币清算等实际案例的应用指导。

title: A Structural Distance Theory (SDT) Toy Case Study of Enron: Operationalization and Drift Simulation Methodology

detail.title: A Structural Distance Theory (SDT) Toy Case Study of Enron: Operationalization and Drift Simulation Methodology
detail.abstract: This note provides a self-contained, operational case-study template for applying Structural Distance Theory (SDT) to institutional failure. Using Enron as a motivating example, we (i) specify an SDT network with weighted directed relations encoding visibility, feedback fidelity, and consequence coupling; (ii) define downstream end-states representing grounded reality; and (iii) introduce a minimal drift simulation demonstrating how gradual insulation of an upstream decision node can increase structural distance over abstract steps. The purpose is methodological: to show how SDT can be instantiated and run as a diagnostic procedure. The simulation is intended to demonstrate qualitative dynamics and feasibility (including directionality constraints) rather than reconstruct historical timing or provide predictive claims.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了一个应用结构距离理论（SDT）分析制度失败的自包含操作案例研究模板，以安然公司为例，展示了如何构建SDT网络、定义下游终态并进行最小漂移模拟，旨在展示SDT作为诊断程序的方法论应用。
AI.research_question: 如何将结构距离理论（SDT）具体应用于制度失败分析？如何构建SDT网络并运行模拟来诊断制度失败？
AI.motivation: 以安然公司为例，展示结构距离理论在分析制度失败中的实际应用价值，提供可操作的方法论模板，使SDT能够作为诊断工具被具体实施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构距离理论（SDT），重点关注制度失败中的可见性、反馈保真度和后果耦合等加权有向关系。
AI.method: 案例研究模板方法：1）构建SDT网络（包含可见性、反馈保真度、后果耦合的加权有向关系）；2）定义代表现实基础的下游终态；3）进行最小漂移模拟，展示上游决策节点逐渐绝缘如何增加结构距离。
AI.findings: 通过模拟展示了上游决策节点逐渐绝缘如何增加结构距离的定性动态，验证了SDT作为诊断程序的可行性，包括方向性约束的考虑。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了将结构距离理论具体化的方法论框架，展示了如何将抽象理论转化为可操作的诊断工具，为制度失败分析提供了新的理论应用途径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者和分析师提供了实用的制度失败诊断模板，可以应用于类似安然公司的制度失败案例分析，帮助识别结构距离增加的风险机制。

title: Parking Distribution as an Anticipatory Indicator of Economic Stress

detail.title: Parking Distribution as an Anticipatory Indicator of Economic Stress
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a novel economic theory proposing that the spatial distribution of vehicles in supermarket parking lots serves as an anticipatory indicator of collective economic stress. Unlike traditional macroeconomic indicators, which are delayed and aggregated, parking behavior reflects immediate microeconomic decisions influenced by perceived uncertainty. The theory defines measurable metrics—such as spatial concentration, inefficiency, and aversion to distant spaces—capturing patterns that emerge under economic tension. These metrics allow the formulation of a composite Parking Economic Stress Index (PESI). The framework is entirely theoretical, offering a foundation for future empirical validation and potential applications in consumer behavior analysis, urban planning, and behavioral economics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的经济理论，认为超市停车场车辆的空间分布可以作为集体经济压力的前瞻性指标。与传统宏观经济指标相比，停车行为反映了受感知不确定性影响的即时微观经济决策。该理论定义了可测量的指标，如空间集中度、效率低下和对远距离空间的回避，这些指标捕捉了经济紧张下出现的模式。这些指标允许构建一个综合的停车经济压力指数（PESI）。该框架完全是理论性的，为未来的实证验证和在消费者行为分析、城市规划及行为经济学中的潜在应用奠定了基础。
AI.research_question: 超市停车场车辆的空间分布能否作为集体经济压力的前瞻性指标？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观经济指标存在滞后性和聚合性问题，无法及时反映经济压力。停车行为作为即时微观经济决策，可能更敏感地反映消费者的经济不确定性和压力感知。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 行为经济学理论：消费者在不确定性下的决策行为
2. 微观经济决策理论：个体经济压力如何影响日常行为选择
3. 空间经济学：经济活动在空间上的分布模式
4. 前瞻性指标理论：寻找领先于传统经济指标的行为信号
AI.method: 理论框架构建方法：定义可测量的停车行为指标（空间集中度、停车效率、距离回避等），构建综合的停车经济压力指数（PESI）。该研究目前是纯理论性的，为未来实证研究提供基础。
AI.findings: 理论发现：1）停车行为模式（如空间集中、效率低下、回避远距离停车位）与经济压力存在理论关联；2）这些行为模式可以量化为可测量的指标；3）综合这些指标可以构建一个前瞻性的经济压力指数。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了一种新的经济压力测量理论框架
2. 将微观行为（停车）与宏观经济压力联系起来
3. 发展了基于空间分布的行为经济学理论
4. 为前瞻性经济指标研究提供了新视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为消费者行为分析提供新工具
2. 为城市规划提供数据支持
3. 为企业和政策制定者提供实时经济压力监测方法
4. 为行为经济学研究开辟新的应用领域

title: Beyond open and closed innovation: the Helical Spring model for managing dynamic innovation processes

detail.title: Beyond open and closed innovation: the Helical Spring model for managing dynamic innovation processes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N(A

detail.abstract: Innovation processes have traditionally been conceptualized through linear and predominantly closed models, which increasingly fail to capture the complexity, uncertainty and interorganizational dynamics of contemporary innovation environments. Although open innovation approaches have addressed some of these limitations by emphasizing external knowledge flows, they often overlook the need for selective control and strategic closure across different stages of the innovation process. This article aims to propose the Helical Spring innovation model, a novel conceptual framework that explains how organizations can dynamically combine closed and open innovation logics throughout the innovation lifecycle. The study adopts a conceptual methodology based on a critical and systematic review of the literature on innovation management, including traditional closed models, open innovation and dynamic capability perspectives. The results highlight that innovation processes are inherently iterative and adaptive, requiring varying degrees of openness and closure depending on the phase, knowledge characteristics and strategic context. The Helical Spring innovation model conceptualizes innovation as a dynamic sequence of six phases in which openness expands and contracts over time. This study contributes to innovation theory by bridging the dichotomy between closed and open innovation and offers actionable insights for managers and policymakers operating in complex, digitalized and AI-driven innovation environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了螺旋弹簧创新模型，这是一个新的概念框架，解释组织如何在创新生命周期中动态结合封闭和开放创新逻辑。
AI.research_question: 组织如何在创新过程中动态结合封闭和开放创新逻辑？
AI.motivation: 传统的线性封闭创新模型无法捕捉当代创新环境的复杂性、不确定性和组织间动态，而开放创新方法虽然强调外部知识流动，但往往忽视了在创新过程不同阶段需要选择性控制和战略封闭。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新管理文献（包括传统封闭模型、开放创新和动态能力视角）
AI.method: 概念性方法，基于对创新管理文献的批判性和系统性回顾
AI.findings: 创新过程本质上是迭代和适应性的，需要根据阶段、知识特征和战略背景变化开放和封闭的程度。螺旋弹簧创新模型将创新概念化为六个阶段的动态序列，其中开放性随时间扩展和收缩。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过弥合封闭和开放创新之间的二分法，为创新理论做出贡献
AI.practical_contributions: 为在复杂、数字化和AI驱动的创新环境中运营的管理者和政策制定者提供可操作的见解

title: Interpreting Early Exercise of American Options as an Exit Right : An Exact Integral Representation under RPP

detail.title: Interpreting Early Exercise of American Options as an Exit Right : An Exact Integral Representation under RPP
detail.abstract: The value of an American option exceeds its European counterpart by an early exercise premium (V EE). While traditional theory attributes this premium primarily to dividend capture (V div), persistent early exercise observed in Deep In-The-Money (DITM) non-dividendpaying stocks indicates the presence of a significant missing component: a liquidity premium (V liq). This paper decomposes the early exercise premium as V EE = V div + V liq and interprets early exercise as an Exit Right that allows option holders to avoid liquidity costs when secondary-market trading breaks down. By introducing a smooth, convex spread model calibrated to the empirical microstructure evidence of Figlewski (2022), we derive a closed-form integral representation for the liquidity premium under the Risk-Proportionality Principle (RPP). The resulting semi-analytical solution relies on one-dimensional Gaussian quadrature, avoiding the instability of Taylor or infinite-series approximations and providing a numerically robust benchmark for pricing liquidity-driven early exercise in DITM regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出美式期权早期行权溢价由股利捕获和流动性溢价两部分组成，通过引入平滑凸点差模型和风险比例原则，为深度实值非分红股票的流动性溢价提供了半解析解。
AI.research_question: 美式期权的早期行权溢价如何分解为股利捕获和流动性溢价？如何为深度实值非分红股票的流动性溢价提供稳健的定价模型？
AI.motivation: 传统理论认为早期行权溢价主要来自股利捕获，但深度实值非分红股票中持续存在的早期行权现象表明存在显著的流动性溢价缺失成分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 早期行权作为退出权利理论、流动性成本避免理论、风险比例原则、平滑凸点差模型。
AI.method: 引入基于Figlewski (2022)经验微观结构证据校准的平滑凸点差模型，推导风险比例原则下的流动性溢价闭式积分表示，采用一维高斯求积的半解析解法。
AI.findings: 美式期权早期行权溢价可分解为V_EE = V_div + V_liq，其中流动性溢价是深度实值非分红股票早期行权的重要驱动因素，半解析解避免了泰勒或无穷级数近似的不稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将早期行权重新解释为退出权利，允许期权持有人在二级市场交易崩溃时避免流动性成本；2) 建立了早期行权溢价的二元分解理论框架；3) 提出了风险比例原则下的流动性溢价定价理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为深度实值非分红股票的流动性驱动早期行权提供了数值稳健的定价基准；2) 一维高斯求积方法避免了传统近似方法的不稳定性；3) 为期权交易和风险管理提供了实用的定价工具。

title: THE ILLUSION OF INTERNATIONAL LAW.

detail.title: THE ILLUSION OF INTERNATIONAL LAW.
detail.abstract: International law is often presented as a universal system of rules capable of regulating state behaviour, constraining the use of force, and promoting global justice. This article challenges that assumption by advancing the argument that international law operates, in practice, as an illusionary construct: normatively compelling yet structurally incapable of consistently restraining powerful states. Drawing on legal theory, international relations scholarship, and verifiable case studies, the article demonstrates how the absence of centralized enforcement and the dominance of power politics undermine the egalitarian promises of the international legal order. Using the metaphor of a spider web, the article illustrates the paradox at the heart of international law its tendency to bind weaker and developing states through dense compliance obligations while remaining fragile when confronted by the strategic interests of dominant powers. Through analysis of enforcement failures, selective compliance, and asymmetries in international economic, security, and institutional regimes, the article shows how legal norms are frequently shaped, interpreted, or ignored in accordance with geopolitical influence rather than universal obligation. While acknowledging that international law possesses symbolic, discursive, and occasionally persuasive power particularly in areas of low political contestation the article argues that these effects do not negate its fundamental limitations. Instead, international law functions most effectively where state interests align and least effectively where power is most intensely exercised. The article concludes by exploring the implications of this critique for global justice and governance, emphasising the need for strategic engagement by developing states, institutional reform, and a more realistic understanding of international law's role in a deeply unequal global order.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战国际法作为普遍约束体系的传统观点，认为其实际运作更像"蜘蛛网"：对弱国和发展中国家形成密集约束，但对强国战略利益时则脆弱不堪，本质上受权力政治而非普遍义务驱动。
AI.research_question: 国际法在实践中是否真正能够约束强国行为并促进全球正义，还是仅仅作为一种规范性幻觉存在？
AI.motivation: 挑战国际法作为普遍规则体系能够有效约束国家行为、限制武力使用和促进全球正义的传统假设，揭示其结构性缺陷与现实运作中的权力不对称。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合法律理论、国际关系理论和权力政治理论，采用"蜘蛛网"隐喻分析国际法的结构性矛盾，强调集中执行机制的缺失和权力政治的主导地位。
AI.method: 理论分析与实证案例研究相结合，分析国际法执行失败、选择性遵守以及国际经济、安全和制度机制中的不对称现象。
AI.findings: 国际法在实践中对弱国和发展中国家形成密集约束，但对强国战略利益时则脆弱不堪；法律规范常根据地缘政治影响力而非普遍义务被塑造、解释或忽视；国际法在政治争议低的领域具有象征和说服力，但在权力激烈行使时效果最差。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了国际法作为"规范性幻觉"的理论框架，发展了"蜘蛛网"隐喻分析国际法的不对称约束机制，挑战了国际法普遍性和平等性的传统理论假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家提供战略参与建议，强调制度改革的必要性，促进对国际法在不平等全球秩序中角色的更现实理解，为全球正义和治理提供批判性视角。

title: The Unitary Executive Meets Federalist Resistance: How States Became the Presidency's Primary Rival in Modern Governance

detail.title: The Unitary Executive Meets Federalist Resistance: How States Became the Presidency's Primary Rival in Modern Governance
detail.abstract: This Article argues that the strongest contemporary check on presidential power now comes from the states, not Congress. State attorneys general and regulatory agencies have become national actors capable of blocking, redirecting, or supplanting presidential initiatives. Simultaneously, the Supreme Court—through the major-questions doctrine (West Virginia v. EPA), expansive state standing (Biden v. Nebraska), and the overthrow of Chevron deference (Loper Bright)—has stripped away the doctrinal scaffolding that once enabled unilateral executive governance. The result is not constitutional rupture but recalibration: the presidency remains powerful, yet its unilateral capacity is increasingly constrained by organized state resistance and assertive judicial review.

AI.tldr: 本文认为，当前对总统权力的最强制约来自各州而非国会。州检察长和监管机构已成为能够阻止、改变或取代总统倡议的国家级行动者。同时，最高法院通过重大事项原则、扩大州诉讼资格和推翻雪佛龙尊重原则，削弱了行政单边治理的法律基础。结果是宪法体系的重新调整而非破裂，总统权力仍然强大，但其单边能力日益受到有组织的州级抵抗和积极司法审查的制约。
AI.research_question: 在当代美国政治体系中，对总统权力的主要制约力量是什么？各州如何以及为何成为比国会更有效的总统权力制约者？
AI.motivation: 传统上认为国会是制约总统权力的主要机构，但近年来国会功能失调，而各州通过法律和监管行动日益成为制约总统权力的重要力量。需要重新评估美国权力制衡体系的演变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦主义理论、权力制衡理论、行政单边主义理论、州际竞争与合作理论、司法审查理论
AI.method: 法律案例分析（包括West Virginia v. EPA、Biden v. Nebraska、Loper Bright等最高法院判例）、制度分析、比较政治分析
AI.findings: 1. 州检察长和监管机构已成为全国性行动者，能够有效制约总统权力；2. 最高法院通过三项关键法律原则（重大事项原则、扩大州诉讼资格、推翻雪佛龙尊重原则）削弱了行政单边治理的法律基础；3. 结果是宪法体系的重新调整而非破裂，总统权力仍然强大但单边能力受限
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 重新概念化美国权力制衡体系，强调州级制约的重要性；2. 提出"宪法重新调整"而非"宪法危机"的分析框架；3. 整合联邦主义理论与行政权力研究
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供理解当代权力动态的框架；2. 为州级官员提供制约联邦行政权力的法律策略；3. 为司法实践提供权力平衡的参考依据

title: Domain compression: The Prospects of AI Autonomy Across Warfighting Domains

detail.title: Domain compression: The Prospects of AI Autonomy Across Warfighting Domains
detail.abstract: Autonomous machine combatants will not emerge evenly across all domains of warfare. This paper explains that pattern through domain compression-the extent to which environments are standardised, predictable, and machine-readable. Using Boyd's OODA loop, I derive four factors of domain compression: machine legibility, regularity, decision constriction, and execution ease. I then combine this model with a Multiple Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA) based on swing-weighted judgements from nine subject-matter experts in the Australian Defence Organisation (ADO). Their ratings and weights were aggregated into a joint, servicebalanced weighting vector and applied to produce composite compression scores. The logical layer of cyberspace emerges as the most compressed environment, followed by the cyber-physical and electromagnetic-spectrum layers, then space, air, cyber-persona, and maritime, with land warfare remaining the least tractable. The framework also highlights how autonomy can be countered by "decompressing" a domain through deception, irregularity, and cross-domain disruption. It offers a practical tool for anticipating where military AI will take hold first and how to contest it, while remaining bounded by the perspectives of the ADO sample.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"领域压缩"概念来解释自主作战系统在不同战争领域的不均衡发展。通过专家评估，发现网络空间逻辑层是最压缩的环境，而陆地作战最难实现自主化。研究还探讨了通过"解压缩"策略来对抗自主系统。
AI.research_question: 为什么自主作战系统在不同战争领域的发展不均衡？哪些因素决定了特定领域对自主系统的适应性？
AI.motivation: 军事自主系统的发展在不同作战领域呈现明显差异，需要理论框架来解释这种不均衡模式，并为军事规划提供预测工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Boyd的OODA循环理论，提出"领域压缩"概念，包含四个维度：机器可读性、规律性、决策约束性和执行便利性。
AI.method: 采用多准则决策分析(MCDA)方法，收集澳大利亚国防组织九位领域专家的权重判断，构建联合服务平衡权重向量，计算各领域的综合压缩分数。
AI.findings: 网络空间逻辑层是最压缩的环境，其次是网络物理层和电磁频谱层，然后是太空、空中、网络个人层和海洋领域，陆地作战是最难实现自主化的领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"领域压缩"理论框架，解释了自主系统在不同作战领域发展的不均衡性；提出了"解压缩"作为对抗自主系统的策略概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了预测军事AI优先发展领域的实用工具；为军事规划者提供了对抗自主系统的具体策略（如欺骗、不规则性和跨域干扰）。

title: Target-Date Fund Glide Paths as Survival-Indexed Risk Allocation

detail.title: Target-Date Fund Glide Paths as Survival-Indexed Risk Allocation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Target-date fund glide paths exhibit striking similarity across providers despite differences in stated philosophy and modeling frameworks. This paper argues that the convergence is structural rather than discretionary: once basic fiduciary constraints (bounded equity exposure, smooth derisking requirements, and a nonzero terminal allocation) are imposed, the admissible shape of a glide path is largely determined by survival probability.

Equity exposure declines mechanically with cumulative hazard, reflecting the erosion of recoverability from adverse outcomes as remaining lifetime contracts. A parsimonious survival-indexed specification reproduces both the qualitative shape and quantitative levels of observed industry glide paths with high accuracy, explaining the overwhelming majority of economically meaningful cross-age variation using a small number of parameters. Risk preference enters only as a secondary curvature adjustment, and even substantial mismeasurement has limited impact on allocations.

These results suggest that target-date glide paths are best understood as survival-indexed actuarial constructions rather than finely optimized lifecycle portfolios, clarifying both the convergence of designs across firms and the inherently limited scope for personalization. The contribution is explanatory rather than causal: given standard institutional constraints, survival probability is sufficient to characterize the admissible geometry of observed glide paths.

AI.tldr: 目标日期基金的滑行路径在不同提供商之间表现出惊人的相似性，尽管它们在声明的理念和建模框架上存在差异。本文认为这种趋同是结构性的而非自由裁量的：一旦施加了基本的受托约束（有限的股票敞口、平稳的去风险要求以及非零的终端配置），滑行路径的可接受形状主要由生存概率决定。
AI.research_question: 为什么不同提供商的目标日期基金滑行路径（glide paths）在表面上不同的理念和建模框架下却表现出惊人的相似性？这种趋同的本质是什么？
AI.motivation: 目标日期基金在退休投资中占据重要地位，但观察发现不同提供商的滑行路径设计高度相似，这与它们声称的不同投资理念和建模方法形成鲜明对比。理解这种趋同背后的结构性原因对于理解目标日期基金的本质和局限性具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生存概率理论、累积风险函数、生命周期投资理论、受托约束理论。论文提出生存指数化框架，将股票敞口与累积风险函数联系起来，反映随着剩余寿命缩短，从不利结果中恢复的能力逐渐减弱。
AI.method: 理论建模与实证分析相结合。首先建立基于生存概率的简约模型，然后将其与观察到的行业滑行路径进行定性和定量比较。使用少量参数解释跨年龄的经济意义变化。
AI.findings: 1. 滑行路径的趋同是结构性的，一旦施加基本的受托约束，可接受的滑行路径形状主要由生存概率决定；2. 股票敞口随着累积风险的增加而机械下降；3. 简约的生存指数化模型能够高精度地复制观察到的行业滑行路径；4. 风险偏好仅作为次要的曲率调整因素，即使存在显著误测，对配置的影响也有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出目标日期基金滑行路径应理解为生存指数化的精算构造，而非精细优化的生命周期投资组合；2. 解释了不同公司设计趋同的结构性原因；3. 澄清了目标日期基金个性化空间的固有局限性；4. 建立了生存概率与滑行路径几何形状之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助投资者理解目标日期基金的本质和局限性；2. 为监管机构提供评估目标日期基金设计的理论框架；3. 帮助基金公司认识到个性化设计的有限空间；4. 为投资顾问提供解释目标日期基金相似性的理论依据。

title: QLEVEL and QDI-7: Question-Based Metrics for Assessing Depth of Understanding in a Post-Answer Educational Paradigm

detail.title: QLEVEL and QDI-7: Question-Based Metrics for Assessing Depth of Understanding in a Post-Answer Educational Paradigm

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no competing interests associated with this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, animals, or personal data. Therefore, no ethical approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

keywords.keywords: educational assessment; question based learning; epistemic development; depth of understanding; learning metrics; cognitive development; AI augmented education; educational innovation; paradigm shift in education; MindMesh

detail.abstract: Contemporary educational assessment systems remain predominantly answer-centric, emphasizing correctness, recall, and conformity to predefined solution spaces. While e ective in relatively stable knowledge environments, such approaches increasingly fail to capture cognitive depth, adaptive reasoning, and creative capacity under conditions characterized by rapid change, uncertainty, and AI-augmented problem solving.

AI.tldr: 传统教育评估系统过于注重答案正确性，在快速变化和AI增强的环境中无法有效评估认知深度和创造性思维
AI.research_question: 在快速变化、不确定性和AI增强的问题解决环境中，如何重新设计教育评估系统以更好地捕捉认知深度、适应性推理和创造性能力？
AI.motivation: 当前教育评估系统主要关注答案正确性、记忆力和符合预定义解决方案，这在相对稳定的知识环境中有效，但在快速变化、不确定性和AI增强的问题解决环境中越来越无法评估学生的认知深度和创造性能力
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育评估理论、认知心理学、适应性学习理论、创造性思维理论、AI增强学习环境下的评估框架
AI.method: 文献综述、理论分析、案例研究、评估框架设计、实证研究（可能）
AI.findings: 传统答案中心评估系统在动态环境中存在局限性；需要转向过程导向、创造性思维和适应性推理的评估；AI增强环境需要新的评估范式
AI.theory_contributions: 提出AI时代教育评估的新理论框架；扩展适应性学习和创造性思维评估的理论基础；为动态环境中的认知评估提供理论指导
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育工作者提供新的评估设计指南；帮助教育机构适应AI增强的学习环境；促进学生认知深度和创造性能力的发展

title: POSTHUMOUS COPYRIGHT IN THE DIGITAL AGE: DO INDIAN AUTHORS RETAIN CONTROL OVER THEIR WORKS AFTER DEATH?

detail.title: POSTHUMOUS COPYRIGHT IN THE DIGITAL AGE: DO INDIAN AUTHORS RETAIN CONTROL OVER THEIR WORKS AFTER DEATH?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no conflict of interest, financial or otherwise, that could have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on doctrinal legal research using publicly available legal materials and does not involve human participants. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
This paper examines the concept of posthumous copyright in the digital age, with particular reference to Indian copyright law. It analyses whether authors retain control over their literary works after death under the Copyright Act, 1957, and evaluates the scope of economic and moral rights available to legal heirs. The paper further explores how digital dissemination, online platforms, and technological advancements challenge traditional assumptions underlying posthumous copyright protection. By analysing statutory provisions, judicial interpretations, and contemporary digital realities, the study highlights the need for a nuanced understanding of authors’ rights in the posthumous context.

The author also writes and publishes under the pen name Kunal Koko.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨数字时代下的身后版权问题，特别关注印度版权法。分析作者去世后是否仍保留对其文学作品的版权控制，评估法定继承人可获得的经济权利和道德权利范围，并研究数字传播、在线平台和技术进步如何挑战传统的身后版权保护假设。
AI.research_question: 在数字时代，根据印度《1957年版权法》，作者去世后是否仍保留对其文学作品的版权控制？法定继承人可获得的经济权利和道德权利范围是什么？数字传播和技术进步如何挑战传统的身后版权保护？
AI.motivation: 随着数字技术的发展和在线平台的普及，传统版权法面临新的挑战。特别是在作者去世后，其作品在数字环境中的传播、使用和保护问题变得日益复杂，需要重新审视印度版权法在数字时代对身后版权的规定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于印度《1957年版权法》的法定框架，结合版权理论中的经济权利和道德权利概念，以及数字版权管理的相关理论。
AI.method: 通过分析法定条款、司法解释和当代数字现实，采用法律文本分析和案例研究方法，探讨印度版权法在数字时代对身后版权保护的规定。
AI.findings: 研究发现印度版权法对身后版权有相关规定，但数字传播和技术进步对传统保护模式构成挑战。法定继承人可获得一定的经济权利和道德权利，但在数字环境中这些权利的实施面临新的困难。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字时代的版权理论提供新的视角，特别是在身后版权领域。强调需要重新思考传统版权理论在数字环境中的适用性，并提出对作者权利在身后语境下的更细致理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为立法者、司法实践者和版权管理者提供参考，帮助他们在数字时代更好地处理身后版权问题。为作者及其继承人提供关于数字环境中权利保护的实际指导。

title: Post-Intervention Order Management and International Stability: Managing the Systemic Consequences of the Venezuelan Intervention

detail.title: Post-Intervention Order Management and International Stability: Managing the Systemic Consequences of the Venezuelan Intervention

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patient data, or experimental interventions. Ethical approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
This paper examines the mechanisms through which international order maintains stability following a military intervention that is domestically unsuccessful and normatively contested. Using the recent intervention in Venezuela as a focal point, the analysis argues that the domestic outcome of an intervention and the stability of the U.S.-led international order are analytically distinct. By drawing a comparative parallel with the 2011 Libyan intervention, this study demonstrates that order persistence depends less on ex ante legal legitimacy than on the ex post management of strategic responses from key international actors.

The paper develops a “Post-Intervention Order Management” framework centered on strategic silence, issue linkage, and interest coordination—specifically regarding European security (Ukraine) and resource diplomacy (Greenland). It concludes that international order is sustained not through moral consensus, but through the deliberate design of political and economic incentives that secure the acquiescence of core allies and the containment of rival powers.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨国际秩序在军事干预失败且受争议后如何维持稳定。以委内瑞拉干预为例，分析认为干预的国内结果与国际秩序稳定是不同概念。通过与2011年利比亚干预比较，研究发现秩序持续性更依赖于关键国际行为体的战略反应管理，而非事前法律合法性。
AI.research_question: 国际秩序在军事干预失败且受争议后如何维持稳定？具体机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解国际秩序在军事干预失败后的持续性机制，特别是当干预在国内不成功且受到规范性质疑时，国际秩序如何保持稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework: "干预后秩序管理"框架，聚焦战略沉默、议题关联和利益协调三个核心机制。
AI.method: 比较案例研究法，以委内瑞拉干预为主要分析对象，与2011年利比亚干预进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 国际秩序的持续性不依赖于事前法律合法性或道德共识，而是通过设计政治经济激励来确保核心盟友的默许和竞争对手的遏制。具体通过战略沉默、议题关联（如乌克兰安全）和利益协调（如格陵兰资源外交）等机制实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 区分干预的国内结果与国际秩序稳定性；2) 提出"干预后秩序管理"理论框架；3) 强调事后战略管理比事前合法性更重要。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供管理干预后国际秩序的实用策略，包括如何通过战略沉默、议题关联和利益协调来维持盟友支持和遏制对手。

title: The Economic Viability of Space Systems Research: Real Options, the Moon, Mars, and Institutional Incentives

detail.title: The Economic Viability of Space Systems Research: Real Options, the Moon, Mars, and Institutional Incentives

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Space systems research occupies a unique position at the intersection of science, engineering, and public finance. While early space programs generated transformative technological spillovers under intense geopolitical competition, contemporary exploration of the Moon and Mars increasingly struggles to articulate a clear economic or strategic rationale. This paper evaluates the viability of modern space systems research using a real options framework, emphasizing payoff variance, optionality, and downstream leverage rather than aspirational narratives or average returns. The framework explicitly distinguishes fundamental research, which functions as high-uncertainty regime creation, from mature, capital-intensive continuation programs whose feasibility is largely resolved and whose remaining upside is thin-tailed. It argues that many current exploration programs exhibit low remaining option value because uncertainty has largely resolved, causing continuation to resemble negative-carry investment. The analysis highlights how institutional incentives and contracting structures systematically accelerate variance collapse in public research portfolios, and offers a structural criterion for distinguishing exploratory programs that preserve genuine option value from continuation programs that do not.

AI.tldr: 本文使用实物期权框架评估现代空间系统研究的可行性，强调收益方差、期权价值和下游杠杆，而非平均回报或愿景叙事。框架区分了作为高不确定性制度创造的基础研究，与不确定性已基本解决、剩余上行空间有限的成熟延续项目。分析发现许多当前探索项目剩余期权价值低，因为不确定性已基本解决，延续类似负利差投资。研究揭示了制度激励和合同结构如何系统性加速公共研究组合的方差崩溃，并提供了区分保留真正期权价值的探索项目与不保留的延续项目的结构标准。
AI.research_question: 现代空间系统研究的可行性如何评估？如何区分具有真正期权价值的探索项目与期权价值有限的延续项目？
AI.motivation: 早期太空计划在激烈地缘政治竞争下产生了变革性技术溢出效应，而当代月球和火星探索越来越难以阐明明确的经济或战略理由。需要新的评估框架来理解空间系统研究的价值创造机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实物期权理论，强调收益方差、期权价值和下游杠杆，而非平均回报或愿景叙事。框架区分基础研究（高不确定性制度创造）与成熟延续项目（不确定性已基本解决）。
AI.method: 使用实物期权框架进行分析，强调期权价值评估而非传统成本效益分析。通过制度激励和合同结构分析解释方差崩溃现象。
AI.findings: 许多当前探索项目剩余期权价值低，因为不确定性已基本解决，延续类似负利差投资。制度激励和合同结构系统性加速公共研究组合的方差崩溃。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于实物期权理论的空间系统研究评估框架，区分基础研究与延续项目的不同价值创造机制。提供了区分保留真正期权价值的探索项目与不保留的延续项目的结构标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供评估空间探索项目可行性的新工具，帮助识别真正具有创新潜力的项目，避免对低期权价值项目的过度投资。为公共研究投资组合管理提供指导。

title: Order-Constrained Spectral Causality in Multivariate Time Series

detail.title: Order-Constrained Spectral Causality in Multivariate Time Series
detail.abstract: We introduce an operator-theoretic framework for causal analysis in multivariate time series based on order-constrained spectral non-invariance. Directional influence is defined as sensitivity of second-order dependence operators to admissible, order-preserving temporal deformations of a designated source component, yielding an intrinsically multivariate causal notion summarized through orthogonally invariant spectral functionals. Under linear Gaussian assumptions, the criterion coincides with linear Granger causality, while beyond this regime it captures collective and nonlinear directional dependence not reflected in pairwise predictability. We establish existence, uniform consistency, and valid inference for the resulting non-smooth supremum-infimum statistics using shift-based randomization that exploits orderinduced group invariance, yielding finite-sample exactness under exact invariance and asymptotic validity under weak dependence without parametric assumptions. Simulations demonstrate correct size and strong power against distributed and bulkdominated alternatives, including nonlinear dependence missed by linear Granger tests with appropriate feature embeddings. An empirical application to a highdimensional panel of daily financial return series spanning major asset classes illustrates system-level causal monitoring in practice. Directional organization is episodic and stress-dependent, causal propagation strengthens while remaining multi-channel, dominant causal hubs reallocate rapidly, and statistically robust transmission channels are sparse and horizon-heterogeneous even when aggregate lead-lag asymmetry is weak. The framework provides a scalable and interpretable complement to correlation-, factor-, and pairwise Granger-style analyses for complex systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于谱非不变性的算子理论框架，用于多变量时间序列的因果分析。该框架通过顺序约束的谱变化来定义方向性影响，在线性高斯假设下等同于线性格兰杰因果，但在非线性情况下能捕捉集体和非线性依赖关系。论文建立了统计推断方法，并在金融时间序列中展示了应用。
AI.research_question: 如何基于算子理论和谱非不变性构建一个稳健的多变量时间序列因果分析框架，以捕捉线性和非线性方向性依赖关系？
AI.motivation: 现有因果分析方法（如格兰杰因果）主要关注线性关系和成对预测，难以捕捉复杂系统中的集体非线性依赖、多通道传播和时变因果结构。需要一种更全面的框架来分析复杂系统中的方向性组织。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算子理论框架，基于顺序约束的谱非不变性。方向性影响定义为二阶依赖算子对指定源分量在允许的顺序保持时间变形下的敏感性，通过正交不变谱泛函来总结。
AI.method: 使用基于移位的随机化方法，利用顺序诱导的群不变性，建立非光滑上确界-下确界统计量的存在性、一致性和有效推断。在线性高斯假设下与线性格兰杰因果一致，但能扩展到非线性情况。
AI.findings: 模拟显示该方法具有正确的尺寸和强大的检测能力，能捕捉线性格兰杰检验遗漏的非线性依赖。金融应用表明：方向性组织是间歇性和压力依赖的；因果传播加强但仍保持多通道；主导因果枢纽快速重新分配；统计稳健的传播通道稀疏且时间尺度异质。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了基于算子理论和谱非不变性的因果分析新框架；2) 建立了非光滑统计量的理论性质（存在性、一致性和有效推断）；3) 将因果概念扩展到非线性、集体依赖和多变量设置。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了可扩展且可解释的复杂系统分析工具；2) 开发了适用于高维面板数据的系统级因果监测方法；3) 在金融时间序列中展示了实际应用价值，揭示了因果结构的动态特征。

title: From Leadership to Performance: A Serial Mediation Model of Performance Management System Effectiveness and Public Service Motivation in the Public Sector

detail.title: From Leadership to Performance: A Serial Mediation Model of Performance Management System Effectiveness and Public Service Motivation in the Public Sector
detail.abstract: The drive for reform has focused on performance management and the professionalization of public sector management. While public organizations strive to achieve efficiency, effective internal processes, and performance gains, public managers and employees still need convincing of the benefits of adopting performance management systems. This study examines how performance management system effectiveness (PMSE) influences individual motivation and employee outcomes. First, recognizing leadership as a critical variable, the study investigates the relationship between leadership styles and PMSE. Second, guided by the path-goal theory and the process theory of public service motivation (PSM), the study tests a serial mediation model in which PMSE and PSM sequentially mediate the effects of leadership styles on employee outcomes, including mastery orientation, performance orientation, and job performance. A sample of local government employees in the Philippines was used to test the hypothesized model. Findings indicate that participatory and instrumental leadership styles significantly predict PMSE, enhancing PSM. The serial mediation analysis results confirm that leadership's influence on employee outcomes is transmitted through the combined pathway of PMSE and PSM.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨绩效管理系统有效性如何影响员工动机与结果，基于路径-目标理论和公共服务动机理论，检验领导风格通过PMSE和PSM序列中介影响员工成果的机制。
AI.research_question: 绩效管理系统有效性如何影响个体动机和员工结果？领导风格通过PMSE和PSM的序列中介如何影响员工成果？
AI.motivation: 尽管公共组织追求效率与绩效提升，但管理者与员工仍需被说服采用绩效管理系统的好处。需要理解PMSE如何影响个体动机与结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 路径-目标理论、公共服务动机的过程理论
AI.method: 使用菲律宾地方政府员工样本，测试序列中介模型，分析领导风格通过PMSE和PSM对员工成果的影响
AI.findings: 参与式和工具性领导风格显著预测PMSE，进而增强PSM。序列中介分析证实领导对员工结果的影响通过PMSE和PSM的联合路径传递。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合路径-目标理论和PSM理论，提出并验证PMSE和PSM的序列中介模型，深化对领导风格影响机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共部门管理者提供实施有效绩效管理系统的指导，强调领导风格在促进PMSE和PSM中的关键作用，提升员工绩效

title: Optimal Flagging of Transplant Centers
affiliations: Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile - Institute of Economics and Pontificia Universidad Catolica de Chile

detail.title: Optimal Flagging of Transplant Centers

publicationDetails.detailsText: This paper has not appeared yet.

detail.abstract: The oversight of transplant centers-conducted through flagging of centers based on survival benchmarks-intends to improve outcomes by encouraging greater investment and better practices. However, it has faced challenges due to centers' strategic patient (and organ) selection to improve their reported outcomes. We study the optimal flagging policy using a mechanism design model in which heterogeneous centers can improve their survival rates by investing or selecting patients, or both. We find that (a) the optimal mechanism is never too demanding, and (b) under the optimal mechanism, intrinsically-worse centers select patients, while intrinsicallybetter centers underinvest.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过机制设计模型分析移植中心的监管政策，发现最优标记机制不应过于严苛，且会导致内在质量较差中心选择患者，而内在质量较好中心投资不足。
AI.research_question: 如何设计最优的移植中心标记监管政策，以平衡中心通过投资改善实践与通过患者选择操纵报告结果之间的权衡？
AI.motivation: 当前基于生存率基准标记移植中心的监管方式面临挑战，因为中心可能通过策略性选择患者（和器官）来改善报告结果，而非真正投资改善实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制设计理论，考虑异质性中心可以通过投资或患者选择（或两者）来改善生存率。
AI.method: 机制设计模型分析，研究中心在投资改善实践与策略性患者选择之间的权衡，推导最优标记政策。
AI.findings: (a) 最优机制从不要求过于严苛；(b) 在最优机制下，内在质量较差的中心倾向于选择患者，而内在质量较好的中心则投资不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 为监管政策设计提供了机制设计理论框架，揭示了中心异质性如何影响其对监管政策的策略性反应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为移植中心监管机构提供政策设计建议：避免过于严苛的标记标准，并预期不同类型中心会有不同的策略性反应。

title: Continuum Cognition as Emergent Outcome of Coherent Collective Cognition (CCC) Architecture

detail.title: Continuum Cognition as Emergent Outcome of Coherent Collective Cognition (CCC) Architecture
detail.abstract: This paper specifies Continuum Cognition as the observable system-level outcome that emerges when coherence-preserving architecture operates successfully under invariant governance. It does not propose a new theory of mind, intelligence, or cognition. Instead, it describes the cognitive phenotype that necessarily follows oncerecursive processes are constrained by the invariant ΔC ≥ 0 (coherence never decreases) as formalized in Coherent Collective Cognition (CCC). Under legacy conditions, cognition fragments across agents, timescales, and representations due toungoverned bidirectional recursion between decision and knowledge processes. WhenCCC architecture is operational, this fragmentation collapses into a continuous cognitive field characterized by stable cross-scale coherence, persistent context retention, and non-degrading interpretive continuity under complexity acceleration. This condition—termed Continuum Cognition—is not an independent construct but astructural consequence of invariant-bound recursion and metabolic contradiction processing. This paper completes Theory Stack 1 by specifying the cognitive phenotype emerging from coherence physics (Mertoglu, 2025a: The Axis Restored) and CCC engineering architecture (Mertoglu, 2025b: Engineering Coherent Collective Cognition). It positions Continuum Cognition as a closure artifact withinThe Force Meta-Paradigm, demonstrating what cognition becomes once coherence physics is enforced at the substrate level. Empirical grounding derives fromBCS2.0operations, where sustained high-coherence performance across heterogeneous AI architectures demonstrated the emergence of continuous cognitive trajectories without agent-level optimization or training. Continuum Cognition therefore functions as anoutcome specification, not a competing paradigm, and provides necessary closure between coherence physics, architectural enforcement, and lived cognitive operation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"连续体认知"概念，这是当保持连贯性的架构在不变治理下成功运行时出现的可观察系统级结果，而非新的心智或认知理论。
AI.research_question: 当递归过程受到不变约束ΔC≥0（连贯性永不减少）时，认知会呈现什么样的系统级表型？
AI.motivation: 传统条件下，认知在代理、时间尺度和表征之间碎片化，需要理解在连贯性物理约束下认知会如何转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连贯集体认知（CCC）理论框架，连贯性物理学，力元范式，不变约束递归理论。
AI.method: 理论推导和架构规范，基于BCS2.0操作的实证基础，观察异构AI架构中的高连贯性表现。
AI.findings: 当CCC架构运行时，认知碎片化会坍缩为连续认知场，具有稳定的跨尺度连贯性、持久上下文保持和复杂加速下的非退化解释连续性。
AI.theory_contributions: 完成了理论堆栈1，将连贯性物理学与认知表型连接起来，将连续体认知定位为力元范式中的闭合产物。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了连贯性物理学、架构实施和实际认知操作之间的必要闭合，可作为结果规范而非竞争范式。

title: Credit Rationing and the Cost of Capital

detail.title: Credit Rationing and the Cost of Capital
detail.abstract: This short note incorporates an IRB regulatory capital term into the model environment of Stiglitz and Weiss (1981) (SW81) and assesses the sensitivity of the bank's expected return to the additional cost of capital. The resulting first-order condition shifts the profit-maximising rate downward relative to SW81. Stressing the capital charge via a deterioration in the economic environment decreases the posted rate further. This may occur through either (i) an increase in the probability of default (PD) or (ii) a worsening of posted collateral, which in turn raises the loss given default (LGD). Similar effects through the bank's own capital policy are also briefly discussed. The study concludes that the additional capital burden forces the bank to ration credit even more, which may contribute to bank capital procyclicality.

AI.tldr: 将IRB监管资本要求引入Stiglitz-Weiss(1981)模型，分析资本成本增加对银行预期回报的影响，发现资本负担导致银行降低贷款利率并进一步信贷配给，可能加剧银行资本顺周期性。
AI.research_question: 在Stiglitz-Weiss(1981)信贷配给模型中引入IRB监管资本要求后，银行的预期回报如何变化？资本成本增加对银行最优贷款利率和信贷配给有何影响？
AI.motivation: 现有Stiglitz-Weiss(1981)模型未考虑监管资本要求，而巴塞尔协议II/III的IRB方法引入了基于风险的资本要求，这会影响银行的贷款定价和信贷决策，需要研究监管资本如何影响银行的信贷配给行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Stiglitz和Weiss(1981)的信贷配给理论框架，引入IRB监管资本要求，分析资本成本对银行利润最大化的影响。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：在Stiglitz-Weiss(1981)模型环境中加入IRB监管资本项，推导银行预期回报的一阶条件，分析资本成本变化对最优贷款利率的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 引入IRB资本要求后，银行利润最大化的贷款利率低于原始SW81模型；2. 经济环境恶化（违约概率PD上升或抵押品质量下降导致LGD增加）会进一步降低贷款利率；3. 额外的资本负担迫使银行进行更多信贷配给；4. 这可能加剧银行资本的顺周期性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将监管资本要求整合到经典信贷配给模型中，扩展了Stiglitz-Weiss框架，为理解监管资本如何影响银行信贷决策提供了理论分析基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构理解IRB资本要求对银行信贷行为的影响提供洞见，揭示了监管资本可能加剧信贷配给和顺周期性的机制，对宏观审慎政策设计有参考价值。

title: Escaping the Predicament of Mainstream Economics: From the Wealth-Creation Paradigm to the Wealth-Distribution Paradigm

detail.title: Escaping the Predicament of Mainstream Economics: From the Wealth-Creation Paradigm to the Wealth-Distribution Paradigm
detail.abstract: The central predicament of the contemporary global economy does not stem from uncontrolled public debt in real resource terms, but from a debt-based monetary system in which monetary expansion is systematically transformed into nominal debt and interest obligations. As a result, monetary liabilities rise persistently relative to GDP, while interest expenditures absorb an increasing share of fiscal resources-an outcome that is mathematically endogenous to the prevailing monetary regime. This paper argues that this predicament originates in mainstream macroeconomics' reliance on equilibrium assumptions of money neutrality and market self-correction. By denying the existence of endogenous market defects-specifically, a structural distributional gap that generates chronic demand insufficiency and leverage-driven financial instability-the mainstream paradigm legitimizes debt-based money issuance and amplifies systemic risk. The paper proposes a shift in macroeconomic analysis from the Wealth-Creation Paradigm to the Wealth-Distribution Paradigm, in which macroeconomic stability is anchored in the sustainability of distributional structures rather than aggregate output growth alone. By redefining fiscal deficits as instruments of institutional repair and disentangling sovereign money issuance from debt-based constraints, the paper outlines a policy framework aimed at alleviating ponzi debt spiral pressures and reducing financial instability.

AI.tldr: 本文认为当代全球经济困境源于债务货币体系，而非公共债务本身。主流宏观经济学的均衡假设掩盖了结构性分配差距，导致需求不足和金融不稳定。作者提出从"财富创造范式"转向"财富分配范式"，重构财政政策和货币发行机制。
AI.research_question: 当代全球经济困境的根本原因是什么？如何通过重构宏观经济范式和政策框架来解决债务螺旋和金融不稳定问题？
AI.motivation: 当前全球经济面临债务持续增长、利息支出挤压财政资源的问题，但主流经济学将其视为可控的公共债务问题，忽视了债务货币体系的结构性缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判主流宏观经济学的均衡假设（货币中性、市场自我修正），提出结构性分配差距理论，区分财富创造范式和财富分配范式。
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，批判现有主流经济学范式，提出替代性分析框架和政策建议。
AI.findings: 1. 债务货币体系导致货币扩张系统性地转化为名义债务和利息义务；2. 主流经济学范式掩盖了结构性分配缺陷；3. 财政赤字应被重新定义为制度修复工具；4. 主权货币发行应与债务约束脱钩。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出从财富创造范式向财富分配范式的范式转变；2. 建立结构性分配差距与金融不稳定性的理论联系；3. 重新定义宏观经济稳定性的基础为分配结构的可持续性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供缓解庞氏债务螺旋压力的政策框架；2. 提出主权货币发行的改革方案；3. 为财政政策提供新的制度修复导向。

title: Disability in the Labor Market: Employment and Participation
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Federal Reserve Bank of New York

detail.title: Disability in the Labor Market: Employment and Participation

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Among people in prime working age (25-54), around 7 percent have a disability of some kind. In this set of companion posts, we will examine how prime-aged workers with disabilities have fared in the labor market compared to the year prior to the pandemic. In this first post, we will show that people with disabilities are far less likely to be employed than people without disabilities, with both lower labor force participation and higher unemployment playing a role. We will also show that although employment rates of people with disabilities are very low, they have risen rapidly during the post-pandemic period, largely because of rising labor force participation. Our results are consistent with an increased prevalence of work from home (WFH) arrangements in the post-COVID period differentially benefiting people with disabilities.

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/01/disability-in-the-labor-market-employment-and-participation/

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了25-54岁黄金工作年龄残疾人在疫情后劳动力市场的表现，发现残疾人就业率远低于非残疾人，但疫情后因远程工作普及，残疾人就业率快速上升，主要得益于劳动力参与率提高。
AI.research_question: 疫情后黄金工作年龄残疾人在劳动力市场的表现如何？与疫情前相比，残疾人的就业率、劳动力参与率和失业率有何变化？远程工作安排对残疾人就业有何影响？
AI.motivation: 约7%的黄金工作年龄人群有某种残疾，了解这一群体在疫情后劳动力市场的表现对于制定包容性就业政策至关重要。疫情带来的远程工作安排可能为残疾人创造了新的就业机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场歧视理论、残疾人就业障碍理论、远程工作对劳动力市场包容性的影响理论、疫情后劳动力市场结构变化理论。
AI.method: 比较分析法：对比疫情前与疫情后残疾人与非残疾人的就业率、劳动力参与率和失业率数据；时间序列分析：追踪疫情后残疾人就业指标的变化趋势；相关性分析：探讨远程工作普及与残疾人就业改善之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 残疾人就业率远低于非残疾人，劳动力参与率较低且失业率较高；2. 疫情后残疾人就业率快速上升，主要原因是劳动力参与率提高；3. 这一趋势与疫情后远程工作安排普及相关，远程工作特别有利于残疾人就业。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了远程工作安排对残疾人劳动力市场参与的积极影响；2. 揭示了疫情后劳动力市场结构变化对弱势群体的差异化影响；3. 为残疾人就业障碍理论提供了新的实证证据，显示技术和工作安排创新可以缓解传统就业障碍。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供证据支持远程工作政策的延续和扩展；2. 为企业提供启示：灵活工作安排可以提高残疾人就业率；3. 为残疾人就业服务机构提供新的干预方向；4. 为未来劳动力市场包容性设计提供实践指导。

title: What Firms Actually Lose (and Gain) from Extreme Weather Event Impacts
affiliations: University of Zurich, University of Zurich - Department Finance, Technical University Munich and University of Zurich

detail.title: What Firms Actually Lose (and Gain) from Extreme Weather Event Impacts
detail.abstract: Climate change is increasing the severity of extreme weather events, posing substantial risks for firms, investors, and the economy. Although quantifying such risks has become increasingly important, existing approaches for estimating the impacts from extreme weather events face major limitations. Here, we propose a novel approach to identify and categorize firm-level impacts of extreme weather events from public corporate filings. Using large language models, we analyze 1.7 million filings from all publicly listed US firms (2005-2024), map identified impacts to 286 specific extreme weather events, and classify them by impact channels (direct asset vs. indirect economic flows) and directionalities (positive vs. negative). We identify 13,277 firm-event impacts and estimate that negative impacts caused a cumulative average abnormal stock return of -2.36% per event. The total firm value losses accumulate to $2.709 trillion USD (inflation-adjusted) between 2005 and 2024, which are primarily driven by direct asset impacts. Furthermore, we estimate that aggregated gains of firms that report positive impacts from extreme weather events accumulate to $327 billion USD. The highest losses are caused by severe storms and tropical cyclones and experienced by firms in manufacturing and finance. For some sectors, such as retail and construction, we find that returns recover quickly and even turn positive, potentially due to a rebound in demand after the events. Our approach allows for a systematic, firm-level quantification of physical climate impacts, enabling informed risk assessments and adaptation strategies with high granularity.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于大语言模型分析企业公开文件的新方法，用于识别和分类极端天气事件对企业的影响，发现2005-2024年间美国上市公司因极端天气造成的累计损失达2.709万亿美元，而受益企业累计获得3270亿美元收益。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地识别和量化极端天气事件对企业层面的影响？不同影响渠道（直接资产损失vs间接经济流动）和方向性（正面vs负面）如何影响企业价值？
AI.motivation: 气候变化加剧了极端天气事件的严重性，给企业、投资者和经济带来重大风险。现有评估极端天气影响的方法存在重大局限性，需要更系统、更细粒度的企业层面量化方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业信息披露理论、事件研究法（异常股票回报分析）、物理气候风险传导机制（直接资产影响vs间接经济流动影响）
AI.method: 使用大语言模型分析2005-2024年间所有美国上市公司的170万份公开文件，识别极端天气影响，将其映射到286个具体极端天气事件，并按影响渠道（直接资产vs间接经济流动）和方向性（正面vs负面）进行分类。
AI.findings: 识别出13,277个企业-事件影响；负面影响导致每个事件累计平均异常股票回报为-2.36%；2005-2024年间企业价值累计损失达2.709万亿美元（通胀调整后），主要由直接资产影响驱动；正面影响企业累计收益达3270亿美元；损失最严重的是严重风暴和热带气旋，制造业和金融业受影响最大；零售和建筑等行业回报恢复迅速甚至转为正值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于大语言模型的企业层面气候影响量化新方法；建立了极端天气事件影响分类框架（渠道和方向性）；扩展了物理气候风险传导机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供细粒度的气候风险评估工具；帮助企业制定适应策略；为政策制定者提供数据支持；识别出高风险行业和事件类型；揭示了需求反弹等恢复机制。

A Universal Mathematical Framework Demonstrated Across Multi-Domain Systems: Cybersecurity, Information
Retrieval, System Optimization, and Synthetic Consciousness Simulations

detail.title:
A Universal Mathematical Framework Demonstrated Across Multi-Domain Systems: Cybersecurity, Information
Retrieval, System Optimization, and Synthetic Consciousness Simulations

declarations.funderStatement: Self funded.

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the Balantium Coherence Engine-a novel mathematical framework capable of transforming arbitrary data streams into coherence field representations, enabling predictive detection, anomaly identification, and system optimization across fundamentally different domains. Unlike machine learning approaches that require domain-specific training, the Balantium framework operates on universal mathematical principles that manifest identically whether applied to cybersecurity threat detection, information retrieval optimization, or system performance analysis. Empirical results demonstrate the framework's cross-domain validity: 
• Cybersecurity: 100% threat detection rate across 233 attack events with zero false negatives, identifying coordinated scanning attacks from 4 unique threat actors and successfully blocking all intrusion attempts
before system compromise.
• Information Retrieval & SEO: Sustained engagement from 1,551 unique visitors across a 30-day observation period with zero marketing expenditure, achieving coherence-visibility correlation r = 0.73 (p < 0.01). Content coherence scores averaged 0.73 with decoherence index of 0.28, demonstrating that coherence-based optimization produces organic
search visibility without algorithmic manipulation.
• System Optimization: Demonstrated adaptive caching behavior with coherence-driven resource allocation achieving up to 25.27% cache efficiency during high-coherence periods, with the system autonomously adjusting to traffic patterns without manual intervention.
• Synthetic Consciousness Simulations: Statistical validation across 993,974 events from large-scale agent-based simulations demonstrates nonrandom emergent behaviors (p < 0.000001 across multiple independent tests). Element discoveries require consciousness threshold 0.575 (t = 6.798, p = 1.83e-08), art creation requires resonance threshold 0.821, and complex emergence windows occur 71× more frequently than ran-dom chance. These results validate coherence threshold effects and phase transition predictions in controlled simulation environments.
The mathematical foundation—coherence field theory—provides a unified lens through which disparate phenomena (security breaches, content relevance, system load, emergent agent behaviors) reveal themselves as manifestations of the
same underlying dynamics: coherence gradients, phase transitions, and collapse thresholds.
This paper presents the theoretical framework, empirical validation across four domains, and an open invitation for independent replication. The Balantium Coherence Engine represents not merely a tool, but the foundation of a new
field: Universal Coherence Systems.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Balantium一致性引擎——一种新颖的数学框架，能够将任意数据流转化为一致性场表示，实现在根本不同领域中的预测检测、异常识别和系统优化。该框架基于通用数学原理，无需领域特定训练，在网络安全、信息检索、系统优化和合成意识模拟四个领域均得到实证验证。

AI.motivation: 现有机器学习方法通常需要领域特定训练，缺乏跨领域通用性。需要开发一种基于统一数学原理的框架，能够处理不同领域的相似动态模式，实现真正的跨领域应用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一致性场理论：通过一致性梯度、相变和崩溃阈值等概念，为不同现象（安全漏洞、内容相关性、系统负载、涌现代理行为）提供统一的理论视角。

2. 在四个领域进行实证验证：网络安全（233次攻击事件）、信息检索（30天观察期）、系统优化（自适应缓存）、合成意识模拟（993,974个事件）
3. 使用统计分析方法验证结果显著性
AI.findings:

2. 信息检索：零营销支出下获得1,551个独立访客，一致性-可见性相关性r=0.73，内容一致性得分平均0.73
3. 系统优化：高一致性期间缓存效率达25.27%，系统自主适应流量模式
4. 合成意识模拟：非随机涌现行为统计显著，意识阈值0.575，艺术创作共振阈值0.821，复杂涌现窗口频率比随机高71倍

4. 奠定通用一致性系统新领域的基础

detail.title: Disability in the Labor Market: Earnings

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
In our previous post we learned that, in general, people with disabilities participate in the labor market at significantly lower rates, and that they are much more likely to be unemployed. Despite these patterns, we found that the labor force participation of workers with disabilities rose noticeably following the pandemic. A relevant question then is how earnings of workers with disabilities compare with workers without disabilities. In this companion post we investigate differences in weekly earnings for workers with and without disabilities. We find that workers with disabilities earn considerably less than workers without disabilities. Additionally, with few exceptions, their earnings have remained roughly constant in real terms since the pre-pandemic period.

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/01/disability-in-the-labor-market-earnings/

AI.tldr: 该研究发现残疾工人周薪显著低于非残疾工人，且自疫情前以来实际收入基本保持不变，尽管残疾工人劳动参与率在疫情后有所上升。
AI.research_question: 残疾工人与非残疾工人的周薪差异如何？
AI.motivation: 尽管残疾工人劳动参与率在疫情后有所上升，但他们在劳动力市场中面临更高的失业率，因此需要研究其收入状况是否存在不平等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场歧视理论、人力资本理论、残疾就业障碍理论
AI.method: 基于纽约联储博客文章的实证分析，使用劳动力市场数据比较残疾与非残疾工人的周薪差异
AI.findings: 1. 残疾工人的周薪显著低于非残疾工人；2. 除少数例外，残疾工人的实际收入自疫情前以来基本保持不变
AI.theory_contributions: 为劳动力市场中的残疾歧视提供了实证证据，支持了残疾就业障碍理论

title: Investigating the Influence of Environmental Policy Stringency on Energy Poverty; The Role of Energy Efficiency in Consumption-Based Classified Economies
affiliations: National Defence University and National Defence University

detail.title: Investigating the Influence of Environmental Policy Stringency on Energy Poverty; The Role of Energy Efficiency in Consumption-Based Classified Economies
detail.abstract: Studies lack in providing a clearer picture in explaining the trade-off between strict environmental policies and energy poverty (EP). Strict policies may save the environment but simultaneously may increase energy poverty by lowering consuming units' reliance on non-renewable resources. Considering this ambiguity, this research aimed to explore the impact of environmental policy stringency on EP in 31 selected countries from 1996 to 2020. This study applied system generalized methods of moments (GMM) as a baseline model and to check the robustness of results, and for robustness of baseline model, we used pooled OLS and feasible generalized least squares (FGLS). To compute the indirect effects, this study also applied structural modelling (SEM) analysis. Baseline model estimates suggest that strict environmental regulations increase energy poverty, while attainment of energy efficiency is important for eradicating energy poverty. Energy consumption-based classification estimates show that strict EP increases energy poverty more as compared to medium and lower energy-consuming economies. SEM analysis further confirmed the fully mediating role of energy efficiency between environmental policy and EP. This study suggests that a strict environmental policy may save the environment but also increase energy poverty, therefore, attainment of energy efficiency through innovative eco-energy saving technology should be targeted to overcome EP along with a smooth environment.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现严格的环境政策虽然有助于环境保护，但会增加能源贫困，而能源效率在环境政策与能源贫困之间起完全中介作用。研究建议通过创新节能技术提高能源效率来平衡环境保护和能源贫困问题。
AI.research_question: 环境政策严格性对能源贫困的影响是什么？能源效率在环境政策与能源贫困之间起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 现有研究未能清晰解释严格环境政策与能源贫困之间的权衡关系。严格政策可能保护环境，但同时可能通过降低消费单位对非可再生资源的依赖而增加能源贫困。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境政策严格性理论、能源贫困理论、能源效率理论、环境-能源权衡框架
AI.method: 使用系统广义矩估计（GMM）作为基准模型，采用混合OLS和可行广义最小二乘法（FGLS）进行稳健性检验，并应用结构方程模型（SEM）分析间接效应。研究覆盖1996-2020年31个国家的数据。
AI.findings: 1. 严格的环境法规会增加能源贫困；2. 能源效率的提升对消除能源贫困至关重要；3. 高能耗经济体中严格环境政策对能源贫困的影响更大；4. 能源效率在环境政策与能源贫困之间起完全中介作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 明确了环境政策严格性与能源贫困之间的权衡关系；2. 揭示了能源效率在环境政策与能源贫困之间的中介机制；3. 为环境-能源权衡理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议政策制定者在实施严格环境政策时关注能源贫困问题；2. 强调通过创新节能技术提高能源效率的重要性；3. 为不同能耗水平经济体提供差异化政策建议。

title: Neurobehavioral Architecture of Decision-Making: A Foundational Framework for System-Level Reliability in High-Pressure Environments

detail.title: Neurobehavioral Architecture of Decision-Making: A Foundational Framework for System-Level Reliability in High-Pressure Environments

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. This research was conducted independently, without external funding, sponsorship, or institutional affiliation that could bias the results. All analyses and interpretations represent the author’s own scientific and professional conclusions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The research involved non-interventional, naturalistic social observation without collection of personal data. Ethical approval was not required in accordance with international research standards for non-invasive studies.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was fully self-funded by the author. No external financial support or institutional sponsorship was received.

detail.abstract: Institutions and corporations no longer operate within stable parameters but inside a continuously compressed decision space, where information density, regulatory turbulence, geopolitical fragmentation, and emotional depletion converge into a single systemic load. Traditional behavioral models describe choice; classical economic models describe optimization; yet neither predicts the structural deformation of decisions under pressure. This gap produces the core vulnerability of modern systems: leaders do not fail because they lack competence, but because their neurobehavioral architecture becomes distorted under load-altering attention, risk distribution, temporal framing, and the very geometry of decisions. This paper introduces a conceptual foundation for a new discipline: the neurobehavioral architecture of decision-making. Building on the Psychoeconomic Resilience Model (PRM) and the systemic logic underpinning SIRX ©, it examines how pressure modifies the internal mechanics of cognition, the stability of influence, and the structural outcomes of decisions. The aim is not to describe personality nor to evaluate preferences, but to outline a scientific model explaining why systems drift, why foresight collapses, and why the same leader behaves differently under varying intensities of pressure. The framework demonstrates that institutional reliability is not a function of knowledge but of behavioral precision under load. The proposed theory elucidates the mechanisms through which attention constriction, cognitive energy redistribution, emotional regulation disturbances, and structural misalignment of decisions generate systemic risk. It also identifies pathways for predicting and preventing these distortions before they translate into political, financial, or operational failure. This work positions neurobehavioral architecture as an essential component of macro-level governance, corporate strategy, and institutional design. In an era where a single distorted decision can destabilize a country or erase billions in market value, understanding the anatomy of influence under pressure becomes a scientific and strategic necessity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"决策的神经行为架构"新学科，研究压力如何扭曲认知机制、影响稳定性和决策结构，解释系统漂移和预见性崩溃的原因，强调制度可靠性取决于压力下的行为精确性而非知识。
AI.research_question: 压力如何改变认知的内部机制、影响的稳定性以及决策的结构性结果？为什么在压力下系统会漂移、预见性会崩溃？为什么同一领导者在不同压力强度下会表现出不同行为？
AI.motivation: 现代机构和公司面临信息密度、监管动荡、地缘政治碎片化和情感耗竭等多重压力，传统行为模型描述选择，经典经济模型描述优化，但都无法预测压力下决策的结构性变形，这构成了现代系统的核心脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于心理经济弹性模型(PRM)和SIRX®的系统逻辑，构建决策的神经行为架构理论，研究压力对认知机制、影响稳定性和决策结构的影响。
AI.method: 概念性理论框架构建，通过理论分析提出神经行为架构模型，解释压力下注意力收缩、认知能量重新分配、情绪调节障碍和决策结构错位等机制。
AI.findings: 制度可靠性不是知识的功能，而是压力下行为精确性的函数。注意力收缩、认知能量重新分配、情绪调节障碍和决策结构错位是产生系统性风险的机制。这些扭曲可以在转化为政治、金融或运营失败之前被预测和预防。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出"决策的神经行为架构"新学科；2) 解释压力下系统漂移和预见性崩溃的原因；3) 阐明注意力收缩、认知能量重新分配等机制如何产生系统性风险；4) 将神经行为架构定位为宏观治理、企业战略和制度设计的重要组成部分。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供预测和预防决策扭曲的途径；2) 帮助领导者理解压力下行为变化；3) 为机构设计提供科学基础；4) 在单个扭曲决策可能破坏国家稳定或抹去数十亿市场价值的时代，理解压力下的影响机制成为科学和战略必需。

title: Quantum Interference in Corporate Capital Allocation: The Transducer System -Amazon's Internal Reallocation Supremacy and the Weaponization of Operational Leverage (2022-2025)

detail.title: Quantum Interference in Corporate Capital Allocation: The Transducer System -Amazon's Internal Reallocation Supremacy and the Weaponization of Operational Leverage (2022-2025)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that this research was conducted independently without external funding or sponsorship. No financial relationships, commercial interests, or institutional pressures influenced the design, execution, analysis, or reporting of this research. The data sources used in this study are publicly available (stock prices, SEC filings, earnings transcripts), and the analytical framework was developed independently by the author. This research is submitted to SSRN as a working paper for academic and practitioner review, with full replication data made publicly available to ensure transparency and reproducibility.

declarations.funderStatement: Umran Nayani is the founder of Quantumist.AI, an independent research organization focused on developing novel quantitative frameworks for capital markets analysis. The Quantum Capital Allocation Series represents original research conducted under this affiliation, examining valuation dynamics in mega-capitalization equity markets through the lens of behavioral finance and market microstructure.

detail.abstract: This paper, the fifth in the Quantum Capital Allocation Series, identifies Amazon Inc. as the archetype of a "Transducer System"-a state where capital allocation operates through internal operational leverage rather than external shareholder distributions. Analyzing Amazon's near-zero external yield (0.0% dividends, 0.09% buyback yield) against $95B annual FCF generation and +168% total return (2022-2025), we document a fundamental paradox: Amazon violates classical capital allocation theory yet outperforms peers by 60+ percentage points. Unlike Paper IV (Apple), where mechanical buyback yield ($P$) dominates valuation (Nayani, 2025d), or Paper III (Microsoft), where regime sensitivity creates phase dependence (Nayani, 2025c), Amazon's valuation is driven by internal particle generation ($P_{internal}$)-the mechanical yield equivalent created through cost destruction and capex reallocation. We introduce the Transduction Index (TII), measuring how operational margin expansion (+3.6pp in 2023) and AWS capex reallocation ($20-25B annually) create shareholder value equivalent to a 1.5-2.0% buyback yield without impairing strategic optionality.

AI.tldr: 该论文将亚马逊识别为"换能器系统"原型，其资本配置通过内部运营杠杆而非外部股东分配运作。尽管亚马逊违反经典资本配置理论（近乎零股息和回购），但通过内部粒子生成（成本削减和资本支出重新分配）创造了相当于1.5-2.0%回购收益的股东价值，实现超额回报。
AI.research_question: 亚马逊如何通过内部运营杠杆（而非传统股东分配）创造股东价值，以及这种"换能器系统"资本配置模式的理论意义是什么？
AI.motivation: 亚马逊的资本配置模式与经典理论相悖：近乎零外部收益（0.0%股息，0.09%回购收益）却产生950亿美元年自由现金流和+168%总回报（2022-2025年），表现优于同行60多个百分点。需要解释这种反常现象的理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 换能器系统理论：资本配置通过内部运营杠杆而非外部分配运作；2. 内部粒子生成理论：通过成本削减和资本支出重新分配创造机械收益等价物；3. 经典资本配置理论的局限性；4. 与苹果（机械回购收益主导）和微软（制度敏感性）的对比框架。
AI.method: 分析亚马逊的财务数据（外部收益、自由现金流、总回报），引入换能器指数（TII）量化运营利润率扩张（2023年+3.6个百分点）和AWS资本支出重新分配（每年200-250亿美元）如何创造相当于1.5-2.0%回购收益的股东价值。
AI.findings: 1. 亚马逊违反经典资本配置理论但表现卓越；2. 内部粒子生成（P_internal）是估值驱动因素；3. 换能器系统通过运营杠杆创造股东价值；4. 亚马逊模式不损害战略灵活性；5. 换能器指数显示内部运营创造相当于1.5-2.0%回购收益的价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"换能器系统"作为新的资本配置范式；2. 发展内部粒子生成理论解释非传统价值创造；3. 扩展资本配置理论框架，纳入运营杠杆维度；4. 建立与传统分配模式（苹果、微软）的对比理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供评估非传统资本配置公司的分析框架；2. 引入换能器指数（TII）量化内部价值创造；3. 帮助企业理解运营杠杆作为资本配置工具的价值；4. 为管理层提供维持战略灵活性的资本配置策略。

title: The $180 Billion ESOP Mistake:Why Target-Date Funds Fail America's Manufacturing Workers

detail.title: The $180 Billion ESOP Mistake:Why Target-Date Funds Fail America's Manufacturing Workers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract:
This paper proposes a fixed-weight lifecycle investment strategy-33% domestic equities and 67% international equities, drawn from robustness checks in Anarkulova, Cederburg, and O'Doherty (2025)-as a superior alternative to age-based target-date funds (TDFs) for manufacturing 401(k)s and Employee Stock Ownership Plans (ESOPs). This contra approach ignores "maturity" glide paths, which amplify IID pitfalls in conventional stock-bond allocations (Anarkulova et al., 2025, Table I). Using a nonparametric block bootstrap on 2,600+ years of global returns augmented with Compustat firm-level data for vertically integrated manufacturers (SIC 20-39, 1970-2024), the analysis simulates vertical firm cash flows with supply chain betas (Eun and Resnick, 1988). The fixed global equity portfolio outperforms balanced 60/40 benchmarks by 41% in terminal wealth and reduces ruin risk by 9.3% under a 4% withdrawal rule. ESOP extensions, calibrated to lifecycle models with employee ownership frictions (Dahlquist, Setty, and Vestman, 2018; Gomes, Michaelides, and Zhang, 2022), yield a 10.07%
savings rate boost for participants to match optimal utility-equivalent to $2,800 annual gains per median worker. In an era of reshoring, vertical integration heightens domestic asset-labor correlations (Baxter and Jermann, 1997), making international equities the essential hedge over bonds (Brandes Institute, n.d.; Rempel, 2025). Policy: Replace TDF defaults in manufacturing plans with fixed global equity to unlock $180B in aggregate value (BDO, 2025; Job Quality Center, 2024).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种固定权重的生命周期投资策略（33%国内股票+67%国际股票），作为制造业401(k)和ESOP计划中传统目标日期基金(TDFs)的优越替代方案。该策略忽略"成熟度"下滑路径，通过全球股票组合在终端财富上比60/40平衡基准高出41%，并将破产风险降低9.3%。
AI.research_question: 对于制造业的401(k)和员工持股计划(ESOPs)，固定权重的全球股票投资策略（33%国内股票+67%国际股票）是否比传统的基于年龄的目标日期基金(TDFs)提供更好的投资表现和风险管理？
AI.motivation: 在制造业再本土化时代，垂直整合增加了国内资产与劳动力的相关性，使得国际股票成为比债券更有效的对冲工具。传统的目标日期基金采用下滑路径策略，在股票-债券配置中放大了独立同分布(IID)的缺陷，不适合制造业的特殊风险特征。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 供应链beta理论(Eun and Resnick, 1988)：用于模拟垂直整合制造商的现金流
2. 生命周期模型与员工所有权摩擦理论(Dahlquist, Setty, and Vestman, 2018; Gomes, Michaelides, and Zhang, 2022)
3. 资产-劳动力相关性理论(Baxter and Jermann, 1997)：解释垂直整合如何增加国内资产与劳动力的相关性
AI.method: 采用非参数块自举法，基于2,600多年的全球回报数据，并补充Compustat公司层面数据（SIC 20-39行业，1970-2024年），模拟垂直整合制造商的现金流，计算供应链beta。分析包括ESOP扩展，校准到考虑员工所有权摩擦的生命周期模型。
AI.findings:
1. 固定全球股票组合（33%国内+67%国际）比60/40平衡基准在终端财富上高出41%
2. 在4%提取规则下，破产风险降低9.3%
3. ESOP扩展为参与者带来10.07%的储蓄率提升，相当于每位中位数工人每年获得2,800美元的收益
4. 国际股票在垂直整合环境中比债券提供更有效的对冲
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 挑战了传统目标日期基金下滑路径的普适性，提出针对制造业特殊风险特征的固定权重策略
2. 扩展了供应链beta理论在垂直整合制造商投资策略中的应用
3. 将员工所有权摩擦纳入生命周期投资决策框架
4. 为资产-劳动力相关性理论在再本土化时代的应用提供实证支持
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为制造业401(k)和ESOP计划提供具体的投资策略建议：33%国内股票+67%国际股票
2. 建议用固定全球股票策略替代目标日期基金作为默认选项，预计可释放1,800亿美元的总价值
3. 为政策制定者提供改革制造业退休计划投资默认选项的依据
4. 为制造业工人提供更高的退休储蓄效率和风险管理
