title: The Endogenous Economic Growth Model of John Rae (1796-1872): -Habits and Society as the Source of Innovation

detail.title: The Endogenous Economic Growth Model of John Rae (1796-1872): -Habits and Society as the Source of Innovation

publicationDetails.detailsText: It is part of a Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
In this research, I present Rae's contributions regarding similarities and advanced features of current and conventional EEG models. Following this procedure, I expect to clarify Rae's contributions, not only as a precursor, as the Canadian Economic Association and Howitt (1994, 1996) acknowledged him, but also as a developer of an EEG model. Furthermore, while Rae introduced a sociological perspective into the conceptualization of capital, I argue that Rae's model could enhance the explanatory power of EEG models.

I developed this article by identifying and evolving, through a selected reading of Rae [1834 -as edited by James (1965)- and re-edited by Mixer (1905)], the basic features of the EEG model to show its originality, pertinence, and advancement concerning the stylized features of a canonic and more recent EEG model.

Incidentally, following Rae's narrative, the presentation of his contributions in this respect could be an excellent didactic application for introducing EEG themes in advanced undergraduate learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过分析Rae的EEG模型贡献，探讨其作为先驱者和模型开发者的双重角色，并论证Rae模型如何增强当代EEG模型的解释力。
AI.research_question: Rae在EEG模型发展中的具体贡献是什么？他的模型如何增强当代EEG模型的解释力？
AI.motivation: 澄清Rae在EEG模型发展中的角色，不仅作为先驱者（如加拿大经济协会和Howitt所承认），更是作为EEG模型的开发者，并展示其模型对当代EEG理论的增强潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: EEG（演化经济地理学）模型理论，Rae的资本概念化中的社会学视角，演化经济学理论框架。
AI.method: 通过对Rae [1834 - 经James (1965)编辑和Mixer (1905)重新编辑] 的文本进行选择性阅读，识别和发展EEG模型的基本特征，展示其相对于经典和近期EEG模型的原创性、相关性和先进性。
AI.findings: Rae的EEG模型具有原创性、相关性和先进性；他的社会学视角的资本概念化可以增强EEG模型的解释力；Rae的叙述可作为高级本科教学中引入EEG主题的优秀教学应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了Rae在EEG理论发展中的双重角色（先驱者和开发者）；论证了Rae的社会学视角资本概念化对EEG理论的增强作用；展示了Rae模型相对于经典和近期EEG模型的先进性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高级本科教学提供了引入EEG主题的优秀教学材料；为理解EEG模型的历史发展提供了新的视角；为当代EEG研究提供了理论借鉴。

title: Exploring Strategies for Sustainable Growth Among Rural Sari-Sari Stores in Northern Mindanao

detail.title: Exploring Strategies for Sustainable Growth Among Rural Sari-Sari Stores in Northern Mindanao
detail.abstract: Sari-sari stores serve as vital pillars of rural economies in Northern Mindanao, providing essential goods, local employment, and fostering social cohesion within communities. Despite their significance, many of these microenterprises face enduring challenges, including limited access to capital, weak financial management, and competition from larger retail chains. Ensuring their sustainability is therefore crucial for supporting inclusive rural development. However, limited empirical research has examined localized strategies that promote the long-term growth of these stores across rural Mindanao, creating a notable research gap. This paper explores the demographic characteristics and sustainable growth strategies of sari-sari store owners in rural locality in Northern Mindanao focusing on financial performance, customer retention, and community engagement. A quantitative descriptive design was employed, surveying store owners through a structured questionnaire and analyzing data using descriptive statistics such as frequency, percentage, and mean. Findings indicate that store ownership is predominantly female and concentrated among older adults who exhibit strong financial discipline, community ties, and customer-oriented service. Nonetheless, challenges remain in innovation, income disparity, and cautiousness in offering credit. The results underscore the importance of capacity-building initiatives, financial literacy programs, and youth entrepreneurship engagement to enhance resilience and competitiveness. These insights contribute to the formulation of policies supporting financial inclusion and sustainable rural enterprise development in Northern Mindanao.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了北棉兰老岛乡村sari-sari商店的人口特征和可持续增长策略，发现店主主要为女性、年长者，具备良好财务纪律和社区联系，但仍面临创新不足、收入差距和信贷谨慎等挑战。
AI.research_question: 北棉兰老岛乡村sari-sari商店的人口特征是什么？哪些可持续增长策略能促进这些商店的长期发展？
AI.motivation: sari-sari商店是北棉兰老岛乡村经济的重要支柱，但面临资本获取有限、财务管理薄弱和大零售连锁竞争等挑战，缺乏针对该地区商店长期增长的实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 乡村企业发展理论、可持续增长理论、小微企业金融包容性理论、社区参与理论。
AI.method: 采用定量描述性设计，通过结构化问卷调查商店店主，使用频率、百分比和均值等描述性统计分析数据。
AI.findings: 商店所有权主要为女性且集中在年长者群体；店主表现出良好的财务纪律、社区联系和客户导向服务；但仍面临创新不足、收入差距和信贷提供谨慎等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了乡村小微企业可持续增长理论，提供了北棉兰老岛特定情境下的实证证据，深化了对性别、年龄与小微企业绩效关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供支持金融包容性和可持续乡村企业发展的具体建议，包括能力建设计划、金融素养项目和青年创业参与等干预措施。

title: Small and Medium Enterprises in New Zealand: Navigating Monetary Volatility, Structural Constraints, and the Path to Sustainable Growth

detail.title: Small and Medium Enterprises in New Zealand: Navigating Monetary Volatility, Structural Constraints, and the Path to Sustainable Growth

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The Author has no conflicts of interest to disclose. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author has no financial or personal relationships with other people or organizations that could inappropriately influence or bias this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/a
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Abstract

This study analyzes New Zealand's Small and Medium Enterprise (SME) sector during an unprecedented monetary policy cycle (Official Cash Rate: 0.25% to 5.50% from 2020 to 2023; then 2.50% by 2025) and identifies key structural barriers that limit sector performance. Using mixed-methods analysis that includes difference-in-differences models on published data from Reserve Bank of New Zealand, Statistics New Zealand, and OECD databases, along with a comparative institutional analysis of Denmark, Finland, and Ireland, I have documented a 12.8% contraction in SME lending, 22,000 job losses, and a yearly 8,400 business closures during monetary periods of tightening. Novel contributions include: (1) Extensive analysis of disproportionate monetary policy transmission to New Zealand SMEs, with a 156% pass-through during contraction compared to 90% during easing; (2) An integrated framework that combines export underperformance (96% of exporters contribute 12% of total value), labor force inefficiencies (300,000 workers exceeding 50 hours weekly; 23.8% youth unemployment), and innovation gaps (0.3% R&D concentration compared to 0.8-1.2% in peer countries); (3) Comparative institutional analysis with Finland, Ireland, and Denmark identifying transferable policy mechanisms. Evidence-based recommendations include counter-cyclical credit facilities, tripling export facilitation, legislation on working hours, and innovation voucher programs, yielding a benefit-cost ratio of 3.4:1 at a fiscal cost of 0.1% of GDP, projecting 15,000-20,000 net jobs, NZ$500-750 million in annual export growth, and a 0.3%-0.5% increase in productivity gains.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了新西兰中小企业在货币政策紧缩周期中的表现，发现贷款收缩12.8%、失业2.2万人、每年8400家企业关闭，并提出了政策建议。
AI.research_question: 新西兰中小企业部门在货币政策紧缩周期中面临哪些结构性障碍？如何通过比较制度分析提出有效的政策干预措施？
AI.motivation: 新西兰中小企业面临前所未有的货币政策周期（2020-2023年OCR从0.25%升至5.50%，预计2025年降至2.50%），需要识别限制该部门绩效的关键结构性障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导理论、比较制度分析、中小企业绩效理论、结构性障碍分析框架。
AI.method: 混合方法分析：使用新西兰央行、统计局和OECD数据的双重差分模型，以及对丹麦、芬兰和爱尔兰的比较制度分析。
AI.findings: 1. 货币政策紧缩期间：中小企业贷款收缩12.8%，失业2.2万人，每年8400家企业关闭；2. 货币政策传导不对称：紧缩时期传递率156% vs 宽松时期90%；3. 结构性障碍：出口表现不佳（96%出口商仅贡献12%总值）、劳动力效率低下（30万人每周工作超50小时；青年失业率23.8%）、创新差距（研发集中度0.3% vs 同行国家0.8-1.2%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深入分析货币政策对中小企业的不对称传导机制；2. 整合出口表现、劳动力效率和创新差距的综合分析框架；3. 通过比较制度分析识别可转移的政策机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 基于证据的政策建议：反周期信贷工具、三倍出口便利化、工作时间立法、创新券计划，预计成本效益比3.4:1，财政成本占GDP的0.1%，可创造1.5-2万净就业岗位，年出口增长5-7.5亿新西兰元，生产率提高0.3-0.5%。

title: Beyond Deterministic Models: A Cloud-Based Monte Carlo Framework for Legacy Refinery Investment Decisions

detail.title: Beyond Deterministic Models: A Cloud-Based Monte Carlo Framework for Legacy Refinery Investment Decisions
detail.abstract: The valuation of legacy refining assets has become increasingly complex due to heightened margin volatility, crude price uncertainty, and the capital-intensive nature of downstream operations. Traditional deterministic financial models fail to capture the non-linear behavior of refining economics, producing estimates that are often disconnected from real operational risk. This paper presents a stochastic valuation framework that integrates production variability, refining margin dynamics, crude price fluctuations, and full working capital effects-including inventories, accounts receivable, and accounts payable-within a Monte Carlo simulation environment. A key differentiating element is the modeling of the catalytic cracking unit (FCC) activation. Although the commissioning of an FCC is a discrete operational event producing a step-change in refining margins, its financial impact is modeled as a continuous probabilistic variable across thousands of simulated scenarios. This approach captures both uncertainty in timing and variability in the uplift magnitude. The model was implemented using a lightweight architecture combining Google Sheets as a collaborative assumptions front-end, Google Colab as the cloud-based simulation engine, and a standalone Python application for automated production runs. Results provide probability-based Net Present Value (NPV) ranges, sensitivity bands, and investment thresholds, enabling more robust and realistic capital planning for the modernization or reactivation of legacy refinery units.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个随机估值框架，通过蒙特卡洛模拟整合生产变异性、炼油利润动态、原油价格波动和营运资本效应，为传统炼油资产提供概率性NPV评估，特别关注催化裂化装置（FCC）启用的连续概率建模。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够捕捉炼油资产非线性经济行为的随机估值框架，以更准确地评估传统炼油资产的价值，特别是在面临高度利润波动、原油价格不确定性和资本密集型运营的情况下？
AI.motivation: 传统确定性财务模型无法捕捉炼油经济的非线性行为，其估值结果往往与实际运营风险脱节。由于炼油利润波动加剧、原油价格不确定性和下游运营的资本密集型特性，传统炼油资产的估值变得日益复杂。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机估值理论、蒙特卡洛模拟方法、实物期权理论（通过FCC启用的概率建模体现）、营运资本管理理论、炼油经济学。
AI.method: 开发一个集成蒙特卡洛模拟的随机估值框架，整合生产变异性、炼油利润动态、原油价格波动和完整营运资本效应（包括库存、应收账款和应付账款）。特别采用连续概率变量建模FCC启用的财务影响，而非离散事件。技术架构结合Google Sheets作为协作前端、Google Colab作为云端模拟引擎、Python应用进行自动化生产运行。
AI.findings: 模型能够生成基于概率的净现值（NPV）范围、敏感性区间和投资阈值。与传统确定性模型相比，该框架提供了更稳健和现实的资本规划工具，特别适用于传统炼油装置的现代化或重新启用决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将离散运营事件（如FCC启用）建模为连续概率变量，扩展了实物期权理论在炼油资产估值中的应用；2）开发了一个整合生产、财务和市场风险因素的综合性随机估值框架；3）提出了处理炼油经济非线性行为的创新建模方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为炼油行业提供实用的概率性估值工具，支持更明智的资本投资决策；2）通过轻量级技术架构（Google Sheets + Colab + Python）实现协作和可扩展的模拟分析；3）帮助管理者更好地评估传统炼油资产现代化或重新启用的风险和回报。

title: Global Human Capital, Local Order Resources: A Mid-Range Framework from Sydney and New York

detail.title: Global Human Capital, Local Order Resources: A Mid-Range Framework from Sydney and New York

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a theory-building paper based on secondary sources and does not involve human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper develops a mid-range framework for understanding how global human capital and local order resources interact in migrant-receiving cities, and how this interaction can generate long-run tensions after an initial phase of apparent mutual benefit. I define order resources as the institutional, organisational and relational infrastructures that make a particular social order possible: laws and courts, schools and hospitals, transport and planning systems, but also trust networks, professional associations and predictable patterns of behaviour. I distinguish these from global human capital, the skills and credentials that are valued in transnational value chains and remote digital work. In the upswing of globalisation, skilled migrants can earn in global markets while living inside local orders, creating a temporary "multi-winner" configuration in which migrants, incumbent residents and the fiscal state all appear to gain. However, when global demand for such labour slows, and if the city does not expand and redesign its stock of order resources, the structural asymmetry between high human capital and low access to order resources becomes visible. Migrants may be confined to the consumer side of order, while local lower-income groups experience rising costs and perceived displacement, with both sides lacking leverage over the institutions that govern their shared future. Using Sydney as a case of regional, order-seeking migration with low-contact calm, and New York as a case of high-friction, high-contact integration that nevertheless thickens order over generations, the paper shows how different "geometries of contact" and intergenerational pathways shape whether skilled migration stabilises or destabilises urban orders. The framework has implications for how global cities design migration, urban planning and institutional policies in an era of slower and more uneven globalisation.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个中程理论框架，解释全球人力资本与本地秩序资源如何互动，以及这种互动如何在初期互利后产生长期紧张。研究发现，当全球需求放缓且城市秩序资源未能扩张时，高人力资本与低秩序资源获取之间的结构性不对称会显现，导致移民被限制在秩序消费端，本地低收入群体面临成本上升和感知替代，双方都缺乏对共享未来的制度影响力。
AI.research_question: 全球人力资本与本地秩序资源如何互动？这种互动如何在移民接收城市中产生长期紧张关系？不同的"接触几何"和代际路径如何影响技术移民是稳定还是破坏城市秩序？
AI.motivation: 全球化背景下，技术移民在接收城市中创造了初期"多方共赢"的局面，但长期来看可能产生紧张关系。现有研究缺乏对全球人力资本与本地秩序资源互动的系统性分析，特别是在全球化放缓的背景下，这种互动如何影响城市秩序稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 秩序资源理论：定义为使特定社会秩序成为可能的制度、组织和关系基础设施，包括法律、教育、医疗、交通系统以及信任网络、专业协会和行为模式。
2. 全球人力资本理论：指在跨国价值链和远程数字工作中被重视的技能和资质。
3. 接触几何理论：分析不同城市中移民与本地居民接触模式（如悉尼的低接触平静vs纽约的高接触摩擦）如何影响秩序形成。
4. 代际路径理论：探讨移民融入的时间维度如何影响秩序资源的积累和分配。
AI.method: 比较案例研究法：以悉尼（区域秩序寻求型移民，低接触平静）和纽约（高摩擦高接触整合，但代际秩序增厚）作为对比案例，分析不同"接触几何"和代际路径如何塑造技术移民对城市秩序的影响。
AI.findings:
1. 全球化上升期：技术移民在全球市场赚钱同时生活在本地秩序中，创造暂时的"多方共赢"配置。
2. 全球化放缓期：当全球劳动力需求放缓且城市秩序资源未能扩张时，高人力资本与低秩序资源获取的结构性不对称显现。
3. 移民被限制在秩序消费端，本地低收入群体面临成本上升和感知替代。
4. 双方都缺乏对治理共享未来的制度的影响力。
5. 不同城市的"接触几何"和代际路径显著影响移民对城市秩序的稳定或破坏作用。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了一个整合全球人力资本与本地秩序资源的中程理论框架。
2. 发展了"秩序资源"的概念化，区分了制度基础设施与社会关系基础设施。
3. 引入了"接触几何"的概念，分析移民-本地居民互动模式对秩序形成的影响。
4. 提供了理解全球化放缓背景下城市移民动态的新理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为全球城市设计移民政策提供框架：需要考虑秩序资源的扩张和重新设计。
2. 为城市规划提供启示：需要平衡移民人力资本与本地秩序资源的匹配。
3. 为制度政策制定提供指导：需要增强各方对共享未来治理的影响力。
4. 为应对全球化放缓和不均衡发展提供政策工具。

reference: ECB Working Paper No. 2026/3169
title: Liquidity Spirals
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB),  and University of Oxford - Institute for New Economic Thinking at the Oxford Martin School

detail.title: Liquidity Spirals
detail.abstract: The financial crisis of 2007-2008 highlighted the risks that liquidity spirals pose to financial stability. We introduce a novel method for studying liquidity spirals and use this method to identify spirals before stock prices plummet and funding markets lock up. We show that liquidity spirals may be underestimated or completely overlooked when interactions between different types of contagion channels or institutions are ignored. We also find that financial stability is greatly affected by how institutions choose to respond to liquidity shocks, with some strategies yielding a “robust-yet-fragile" system. To demonstrate the method, we apply it to a highly granular data set on the South African banking sector and investment fund sector. We find that the risk of a liquidity spiral emerging increases when the pool of institutions' most liquid assets is reduced, while a liquidity injection by the central bank can dampen the spiral. We further show that a liquidity spiral may be due to the banking and fund sectors' collective dynamics, but can also be driven by an individual sector under some market conditions. The approach developed here canbe used to formulate interventions that specifically target the sector(s) causing the liquidity spiral.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种研究流动性螺旋的新方法，发现忽视不同传染渠道或机构间的相互作用会低估或完全忽略流动性螺旋风险，并证明机构对流动性冲击的应对策略会影响金融稳定性，形成"稳健但脆弱"的系统。
AI.research_question: 如何识别和预测流动性螺旋？不同机构间的相互作用如何影响流动性螺旋的形成和发展？中央银行的干预措施如何影响流动性螺旋的演变？
AI.motivation: 2007-2008年金融危机突显了流动性螺旋对金融稳定的风险，但现有方法可能低估或忽视不同传染渠道和机构间的相互作用对流动性螺旋的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 流动性螺旋理论、金融传染理论、系统性风险理论、网络效应理论、机构间相互作用理论。
AI.method: 开发了一种研究流动性螺旋的新方法，并应用于南非银行业和投资基金部门的高度细粒度数据集进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1. 忽视不同传染渠道或机构间的相互作用会低估或完全忽略流动性螺旋风险；2. 机构对流动性冲击的应对策略影响金融稳定性，某些策略会形成"稳健但脆弱"的系统；3. 机构流动性资产池减少会增加流动性螺旋风险；4. 中央银行流动性注入可以抑制螺旋；5. 流动性螺旋可能由银行和基金部门的集体动态驱动，也可能在某些市场条件下由单个部门驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 开发了研究流动性螺旋的新方法；2. 揭示了机构间相互作用对流动性螺旋形成的重要性；3. 提出了"稳健但脆弱"系统的概念框架；4. 深化了对金融传染机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了一种识别和预测流动性螺旋的工具；2. 为中央银行和政策制定者提供了针对特定部门干预的决策支持；3. 帮助金融机构优化流动性管理策略；4. 为金融监管提供了新的风险评估框架。

reference: ECB Working Paper No. 2026/3170
title: Contingent Convertible Debt: What Is and What Should Have Been
affiliations: Universidad Autónoma de Madrid and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Contingent Convertible Debt: What Is and What Should Have Been
detail.abstract: This paper develops a model of AT1 CoCos and corporate securities analysing the role of CoCos as replacements of Equity or of Debt. Our results show that, in terms of value creation, CoCos perform better when they replace vanilla corporate debt rather than when they replace common Equity. Moreover, we show as well that although debt increases the probability of bankruptcy, given the coupon suspension possibility, with CoCos the probability of financial distress is higher. Our paper also highlights the considerable complexity of this instrument, something at odds with its role as a potential solution to a financial crisis in part triggered by less complex securities.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了AT1 CoCos（或有可转换债券）作为股权或债务替代品的作用，发现CoCos替代普通公司债比替代普通股权更能创造价值，但会增加财务困境概率，并指出这种工具的复杂性与其作为金融危机解决方案的角色相矛盾。
AI.research_question: AT1 CoCos作为股权或债务替代品时，哪种方式能创造更多价值？CoCos对破产概率和财务困境概率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解CoCos在资本结构中的作用，评估其作为金融危机解决方案的有效性，分析这种复杂金融工具的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本结构理论，或有可转换债券（CoCos）定价模型，公司财务理论，破产概率分析。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建AT1 CoCos和公司证券的数学模型，进行价值创造、破产概率和财务困境概率的定量分析。
AI.findings: 1. CoCos替代普通公司债比替代普通股权能创造更多价值；2. 虽然债务会增加破产概率，但由于CoCos具有息票暂停可能性，使用CoCos时财务困境概率更高；3. CoCos工具本身具有相当大的复杂性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了CoCos作为股权或债务替代品的价值创造比较框架；2. 揭示了CoCos对财务困境概率的特殊影响机制；3. 指出了金融工具复杂性与危机解决方案之间的内在矛盾。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融机构选择CoCos发行策略提供指导；2. 提醒监管者注意CoCos可能增加财务困境风险；3. 质疑复杂金融工具作为危机解决方案的有效性。

reference: ECB Working Paper No. 2026/3171
title: Structural Drivers of Growth At Risk: Insights from a VAR-Quantile Regression Approach
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Structural Drivers of Growth At Risk: Insights from a VAR-Quantile Regression Approach
detail.abstract: We investigate the impact of structural shocks on the joint distribution of future real GDP growth and inflation in the euro area. We model the conditional mean of these variables, along with selected financial indicators, using a VAR and perform quantile regressions on the VAR residuals to estimate their time-varying variance as a function of macroeconomic and financial variables. Through impulse response analysis, we find that demand and financial shocks reduce expected GDP growth and increase its conditional variance, leading to negatively skewed future growth distributions. By enabling this mean-volatility interaction, demand and financial shocks drive significant time variation in downside risk to euro area GDP growth, while supply shocks result in broadly symmetric movements. For inflation, supply shocks drive instead a positive mean-volatility co-movement, where higher inflation is associated with increased uncertainty, causing time variation in upside risk.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了欧元区结构性冲击对实际GDP增长和通胀联合分布的影响，发现需求和金融冲击通过均值-波动性相互作用导致GDP增长下行风险，而供给冲击则导致通胀上行风险。
AI.research_question: 结构性冲击如何影响欧元区未来实际GDP增长和通胀的联合分布？特别是这些冲击如何通过均值-波动性相互作用导致增长和通胀风险的时间变化？
AI.motivation: 理解结构性冲击对宏观经济风险分布的影响对于政策制定和风险管理至关重要。欧元区作为重要的经济体，其GDP增长和通胀的风险特征需要深入分析，特别是不同冲击类型（需求、供给、金融）如何产生不对称的风险效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于VAR模型和分位数回归框架，结合均值-波动性相互作用理论。该框架允许分析冲击如何同时影响条件均值和条件方差，从而产生不对称的风险分布。
AI.method: 使用VAR模型估计实际GDP增长、通胀和金融指标的条件均值，然后对VAR残差进行分位数回归，以估计作为宏观经济和金融变量函数的时变方差。通过脉冲响应分析研究不同冲击的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 需求和金融冲击降低预期GDP增长并增加其条件方差，导致未来增长分布负偏斜；2. 通过均值-波动性相互作用，需求和金融冲击驱动欧元区GDP增长下行风险的显著时间变化；3. 供给冲击导致大致对称的变动；4. 对于通胀，供给冲击驱动正的均值-波动性共动，较高通胀与不确定性增加相关，导致上行风险的时间变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了分析结构性冲击对宏观经济风险分布影响的理论框架；2. 揭示了不同类型冲击通过均值-波动性相互作用产生不对称风险效应的机制；3. 提供了理解经济增长和通胀风险时间变化的系统性方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧元区政策制定者提供了识别和管理不同冲击类型风险的工具；2. 帮助金融机构更好地评估宏观经济风险；3. 为风险管理实践提供了基于冲击类型的差异化策略；4. 有助于预测和应对经济增长下行风险和通胀上行风险。

reference: this paper was published on https://medium.com/.
title: The Untold History of ELF Testing in the Baltic Sea:

detail.title: The Untold History of ELF Testing in the Baltic Sea:
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the possible existence of a secret Soviet program dedicated to the study and application of Extremely Low Frequency (ELF) transmissions in the Baltic Sea region during the final phase of the Cold War. Drawing on technical data related to the ZEVS transmitter, documented ELF/ULF experiments in Fennoscandia, operational patterns of the KGB, and administrative records from 1988–1992, this study proposes that the enigmatic project known in Western literature
as “BERC” — Baltic ELF Research & Communication — is in fact a misinterpretation of an authentic Soviet codename: “Балтика-3” (Baltika-3).
The name, coincidentally shared with a state-owned beverage company founded at the same time, may have served as an administrative cover for classified ELF documentation. With the collapse of the USSR and subsequent privatization processes, these records disappeared, reinforcing the project’s obscure legacy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析ZEVS发射器技术数据、芬诺斯坎迪亚ELF/ULF实验记录、KGB行动模式以及1988-1992年行政档案，提出西方文献中的"BERC"项目实际上是苏联代号"Балтика-3"的误读，该代号可能以同名国有饮料公司为掩护，用于分类ELF文件管理。
AI.research_question: 冷战末期苏联在波罗的海地区是否存在一个专门研究与应用极低频（ELF）传输的秘密计划？西方文献中的"BERC"项目是否真实存在，还是对苏联代号"Балтика-3"的误解？
AI.motivation: 冷战时期苏联的ELF研究项目一直笼罩在神秘之中，西方情报界和学术界对"BERC"项目的存在存在争议。随着苏联解体后档案的消失，这些项目的真实性质变得更加模糊，需要通过对现有技术数据、行动记录和行政档案的系统分析来澄清历史真相。
AI.theoretical_framework: 冷战科技史、信号情报分析理论、苏联军事科技发展模式、代号与掩护机制理论、档案消失与历史重构理论。
AI.method: 多源档案分析方法：1）ZEVS发射器技术数据分析；2）芬诺斯坎迪亚地区ELF/ULF实验文档研究；3）KGB行动模式分析；4）1988-1992年苏联行政记录审查；5）代号与掩护机制比较分析。
AI.findings: 1）西方文献中的"BERC"项目实际上是苏联代号"Балтика-3"的误读；2）该代号与同期成立的国有饮料公司"Балтика"同名，可能作为分类ELF文件的行政掩护；3）苏联解体后的私有化过程导致相关档案消失，强化了项目的隐秘性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）为冷战科技史研究提供了新的档案分析方法论；2）揭示了苏联军事科技项目中代号与掩护机制的运作模式；3）提出了档案消失与历史重构的理论框架，解释为何某些秘密项目在历史记录中变得模糊。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为情报分析人员提供了识别和解读苏联时期秘密项目的分析框架；2）为冷战历史研究者提供了档案追踪和验证的方法参考；3）为解密档案的管理和保存提供了历史教训。

title:
Neurobehavioral Architecture of Decision-Making. 
Structural Determinants of Strategic Stability Under Pressure

detail.title:
Neurobehavioral Architecture of Decision-Making. 
Structural Determinants of Strategic Stability Under Pressure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. This research was conducted independently, without external funding, sponsorship, or institutional affiliation that could bias the results. All analyses and interpretations represent the author’s own scientific and professional conclusions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The research involved non-interventional, naturalistic social observation without collection of personal data. Ethical approval was not required in accordance with international research standards for non-invasive studies.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was fully self-funded by the author. No external financial support or institutional sponsorship was received.

detail.abstract: Strategic failures in modern governments and corporations rarely stem from inadequate expertise, insufficient intelligence, or limited access to information. They arise from a predictable phenomenon: executive decision architecture deforms under systemic pressure, altering the geometry of judgment, risk interpretation, and temporal reasoning. Existing models of governance, economics, and organizational theory assume that cognition remains structurally consistent across environmental gradients. This assumption is both empirically invalid and increasingly dangerous. This paper develops a comprehensive framework-the Neurobehavioral Architecture of Decision-Making-to explain how pressure reorganizes executive cognition and modifies institutional outcomes. Drawing on the conceptual foundations of the Psychoeconomic Resilience Model (PRM) and the structural principles embedded within the SIRX© standard, it demonstrates that stability is a function not of competence, but of behavioral fidelity under stress. The framework establishes pressure as a structural variable capable of reshaping attention, emotional regulation, and integrative reasoning, thereby altering the system's trajectories long before explicit failure becomes visible. For states, corporations, and transnational institutions, the implications are substantial: resilience, trust, and strategic continuity depend on the stability of decision architecture, not the authority of its holder.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"决策神经行为架构"框架，解释压力如何重组高管认知并改变制度结果，强调稳定性不是能力问题，而是压力下的行为保真度问题。
AI.research_question: 压力如何系统性重组高管决策架构，从而改变判断几何、风险解释和时间推理，最终导致战略失败？
AI.motivation: 现代政府和企业的战略失败很少源于专业知识不足、情报不足或信息获取有限，而是源于可预测的现象：高管决策架构在系统压力下变形。现有治理、经济学和组织理论模型假设认知在环境梯度中保持结构一致性，这一假设既经验无效又日益危险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策神经行为架构框架，借鉴心理经济韧性模型(PRM)的概念基础和SIRX©标准中的结构原则。
AI.method: 理论框架开发，基于现有理论和概念基础构建综合框架。
AI.findings: 稳定性不是能力问题，而是压力下的行为保真度问题；压力作为结构变量能够重塑注意力、情绪调节和整合推理，从而在显性失败出现前就改变系统轨迹。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出决策神经行为架构框架，将压力概念化为能够重塑认知结构的变量，挑战了传统治理、经济学和组织理论中认知结构一致性的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 对国家、企业和跨国机构具有重要启示：韧性、信任和战略连续性取决于决策架构的稳定性，而非持有者的权威；提供了评估和增强组织在压力下决策保真度的实用框架。

title: Ready-Bridge Training Pack — Integrated Crew Training Module

detail.title: Ready-Bridge Training Pack — Integrated Crew Training Module
detail.abstract:
Modern standards for training maritime crews are increasingly focused not only on technical competence, but also on the ability of the team to act in a coordinated manner in crisis situations. Although the STCW (Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping for Seafarers) Convention defines the basic requirements for navigational training, most training programs remain fragmented and do not take into account the specifics of the real ship environment. This gap is filled by the Ready-Bridge Training Pack module, a training course created by Ukrainian maritime expert Maksym Marichev, which combines practical experience, emergency analytics, and modern approaches to blended crew training. [1]

The program is aimed at training bridge officers, GMDSS operators, and junior navigators. Its structure is based on an integrated system of training materials — presentations, video demonstrations, interactive Q&A sessions, and short simulation cases. Unlike traditional courses, Ready-Bridge does not simply explain algorithms for action in emergency situations, but creates a controlled environment for decision-making in which officers learn to think, not just follow instructions.

AI.tldr: Ready-Bridge培训模块填补了传统海事培训的空白，通过结合实践经验、紧急情况分析和混合式培训方法，为船员提供在危机情境下的协调决策能力训练。
AI.research_question: 如何通过Ready-Bridge培训模块有效提升海事船员在危机情境下的团队协调和决策能力？
AI.motivation: 现代海事培训标准不仅关注技术能力，更强调团队在危机中的协调能力。STCW公约虽然定义了基本培训要求，但大多数培训项目仍碎片化且未考虑真实船舶环境特点，存在培训空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于混合式培训理论、情境学习理论和决策理论，强调在受控环境中培养批判性思维而非简单遵循指令。
AI.method: 采用综合培训材料系统，包括演示文稿、视频演示、互动问答和简短模拟案例，创建受控决策环境。
AI.findings: Ready-Bridge培训模块成功填补了传统海事培训的空白，通过实践导向的方法帮助船员在危机情境中学习思考和决策，而不仅仅是执行算法。
AI.theory_contributions: 为海事培训领域提供了整合实践经验、紧急情况分析和现代培训方法的理论框架，强调从"遵循指令"到"批判性思考"的培训范式转变。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了针对驾驶台官员、GMDSS操作员和初级导航员的实用培训课程，通过综合培训材料系统提升船员在真实危机情境中的协调和决策能力。

title: A Monetary Policy Perspective on the Euro Area Fiscal Reaction Function

detail.title: A Monetary Policy Perspective on the Euro Area Fiscal Reaction Function
detail.abstract: This paper examines how fiscal policy in the euro area reacts to monetary policy, by estimating fiscal policy reaction functions for the period 1999-2019. Inclusion of the monetary policy stance in the fiscal reaction function, approximated by a shadow interest rate, is a relatively novel aspect in this type of analysis. The findings suggest that fiscal policy acts in a substitutive manner, its stance moving in the opposite direction of monetary policy, though this effect may have seized operating during ECB’s quantitative easing. Using local projections, the substitutive effect is found to increase over time before turning broadly neutral. Analysing the fiscal response to other monetary policy relevant variables - government debt and the output gap -, outcomes suggests that budget balances react positively to government debt, supporting fiscal sustainability, and that fiscal policy acts countercyclically in recessions.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了欧元区财政政策对货币政策的反应，发现财政政策与货币政策呈替代关系（方向相反），但在欧央行量化宽松期间这种效应可能消失。财政政策对政府债务和产出缺口也做出反应，支持财政可持续性和逆周期调节。
AI.research_question: 欧元区财政政策如何对货币政策做出反应？财政政策与货币政策之间是互补还是替代关系？
AI.motivation: 理解财政政策与货币政策之间的互动关系对于政策协调和宏观经济稳定至关重要，特别是在欧元区这样的货币联盟中。现有研究对财政政策反应函数的分析通常未充分考虑货币政策立场的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于财政政策反应函数理论，将货币政策立场（通过影子利率衡量）纳入分析框架，探讨财政政策与货币政策的互动关系。
AI.method: 使用1999-2019年欧元区数据，估计包含货币政策立场的财政政策反应函数，采用影子利率衡量货币政策立场，并使用局部投影法分析效应随时间的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 财政政策与货币政策呈替代关系（方向相反）；2. 在欧央行量化宽松期间替代效应可能消失；3. 替代效应随时间增强后转为中性；4. 财政余额对政府债务反应积极，支持财政可持续性；5. 财政政策在衰退期呈逆周期性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将货币政策立场纳入财政政策反应函数分析，为理解财政-货币政策互动提供了新的理论视角，特别是在货币联盟背景下。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧元区政策制定者提供实证依据，帮助理解财政政策对货币政策的反应模式，促进更好的政策协调和宏观经济稳定。

title: Amoral Democracy: Institutional Formalism, State Weakness, and Semi-Peripheral Vulnerability in Romania

detail.title: Amoral Democracy: Institutional Formalism, State Weakness, and Semi-Peripheral Vulnerability in Romania

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. No personal, financial, or institutional relationships influenced the preparation of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is based exclusively on publicly available secondary data and does not involve human participants, personal data, or procedures requiring institutional ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This article examines the particular way in which liberal democracy functions in Romania, arguing that although democratic institutions are formally maintained and procedures are respected in a technical sense, their functioning is marked by a profound absence of a moral ethos that would give coherence to public action. The central concept proposed, that of amoral democracy, attempts to capture situations in which democratic institutions operate without internalising the values they are supposed to uphold, and political decision-making takes place in a pragmatic and defensive register. In developing this framework, the analysis integrates contributions from the literature on Europeanisation, state weakness, institutional capture and populism, complemented by structural perspectives on Romania's semi-peripheral position and the systemic constraints of the contemporary international environment. The result is an interpretation in which administrative blockages, decision-making incoherence and geopolitical vulnerabilities converge to produce a procedurally functional democratic model that is insufficiently anchored in a common moral project. The article also examines how this configuration stimulates the rise of sovereignist discourses, which capitalise on social frustration and the perception of a state incapable of providing clear direction. Amoral democracy is thus presented not as a superficial aberration, but as a mode of functioning that stems from the interaction between external pressures, incomplete Europeanisation, institutional fragmentation, and structural dependencies that limit the state's autonomy. Through this approach, the study aims to provide an analytical framework that can be transferred to other semi-peripheral contexts, emphasising the importance of the moral dimension for understanding democratic performance in seemingly consolidated regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"非道德民主"概念，描述罗马尼亚民主制度虽形式完备但缺乏道德内核的运作模式，分析其源于欧洲化不彻底、制度碎片化和结构性依赖的深层原因。
AI.research_question: 罗马尼亚自由民主制度如何运作？为何在形式上维持民主程序的同时，却缺乏赋予公共行动连贯性的道德精神？
AI.motivation: 理解看似巩固的民主政体中民主表现不佳的现象，特别是半边缘国家民主制度的特殊运作模式，强调道德维度对民主质量的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧洲化理论、国家脆弱性理论、制度俘获理论、民粹主义理论，结合罗马尼亚半边缘地位的结构性视角和当代国际环境的系统性约束。
AI.method: 理论框架整合分析，结合结构视角和文献综述，构建"非道德民主"概念框架，进行案例阐释。
AI.findings: 罗马尼亚民主制度在程序上功能正常但缺乏道德内核，表现为行政阻滞、决策不连贯和地缘政治脆弱性；这种配置刺激了主权主义话语的兴起；非道德民主源于外部压力、不完全欧洲化、制度碎片化和结构性依赖的相互作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"非道德民主"新概念，强调民主制度的道德维度；提供可转移到其他半边缘背景的分析框架；整合多种理论视角解释民主表现。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助理解半边缘国家民主运作的特殊性；揭示程序民主与实质民主的差距；为政策制定者提供改善民主质量的参考；解释民粹主义兴起的结构性原因。

title: Civilizational Trauma-Response-Resilience Dynamics (CTD): A Unified Mechanism Framework

detail.title: Civilizational Trauma-Response-Resilience Dynamics (CTD): A Unified Mechanism Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Civilizational crises are typically interpreted through narratives of rise and decline, moral decay, or institutional failure, yet such accounts rarely identify the mechanisms that generate divergent outcomes across historical cases. This article introduces the Civilizational Trauma-Response-Resilience Dynamics (CTD) model, a unified analytical framework that explains crisis trajectories through the interaction of trauma magnitude (T), signification direction (S), reaction modality (R), and resilience with its temporal gradient (D, dD/dt). CTD formalizes reactions as a function of trauma, meaning, and structure, and demonstrates that the consequences of reactions are primarily lagged, producing next-cycle trauma through recursive feedback (R → Tₙ₊₁). Resilience velocity emerges as a central determinant of whether systems collapse, stabilize, mobilize, or undergo re-foundation. Methodologically, the model employs tomographic scanning to isolate the effects of T, S, R, and D, and coupling analysis to map interactions across institutional, social, and geopolitical layers. Six cases-late Soviet collapse, modern Ukrainian mobilization, Meiji re-foundation, postwar Japanese high-D stability, the Roman-Byzantine transition, and U.S.-China competitive coupling-demonstrate CTD's explanatory range. CTD reframes civilizational analysis as a dynamic mechanism science, integrating cultural trauma, institutional theory, and complex systems dynamics into a tractable structure suitable for historical interpretation, comparative analysis, and computational modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了文明创伤-反应-韧性动力学（CTD）模型，通过创伤强度、意义赋予、反应模式和韧性变化率的相互作用来解释文明危机轨迹，强调反应后果具有滞后性并通过递归反馈产生下一周期创伤。
AI.research_question: 文明危机如何产生不同的历史结果？哪些机制决定了文明系统在危机中是崩溃、稳定、动员还是重建？
AI.motivation: 传统文明危机叙事（如兴衰、道德堕落、制度失败）很少能识别产生不同历史结果的机制，需要统一的动态分析框架来解释危机轨迹的多样性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文明创伤-反应-韧性动力学（CTD）模型，整合了文化创伤理论、制度理论和复杂系统动力学，将反应形式化为创伤、意义和结构的函数。
AI.method: 采用断层扫描法分离T、S、R、D的影响，耦合分析映射制度、社会和地缘政治层面的相互作用，并通过六个历史案例验证模型解释力。
AI.findings: 反应后果具有滞后性，通过递归反馈产生下一周期创伤；韧性变化率是决定系统崩溃、稳定、动员或重建的核心因素；模型能解释不同文明危机轨迹。
AI.theory_contributions: 将文明分析重构为动态机制科学，整合文化创伤、制度理论和复杂系统动力学，提供可处理的结构用于历史解释、比较分析和计算建模。
AI.practical_contributions: 为历史解释、比较分析和政策制定提供统一分析框架，可用于理解当代文明挑战（如美中竞争）和危机管理。

title: Adaptive Transformation of Industrial Enterprises
affiliations: MGIMO University of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation

detail.title: Adaptive Transformation of Industrial Enterprises
detail.abstract: Based on the analysis of scientific works by Russian authors, the main elements of the adaptive management mechanism of industrial enterprises in conditions of high uncertainty and dynamism of the external environment have been identified. An adaptive management mechanism should ensure flexibility and timely restructuring of the company's goal-setting, business processes and organizational structure in response to environmental challenges. At the same time, it is important to take into account both external and internal factors with varying degrees of predictability and manageability.

AI.tldr: 该研究识别了工业企业在高度不确定和动态外部环境下的自适应管理机制要素，强调机制应确保企业目标设定、业务流程和组织结构的灵活性与及时重组。
AI.research_question: 在高度不确定和动态的外部环境下，工业企业的自适应管理机制应包含哪些关键要素？
AI.motivation: 当前工业企业在面对高度不确定和动态的外部环境时，需要有效的自适应管理机制来应对环境挑战，确保企业的灵活性和适应性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自适应管理理论、组织适应性理论、环境不确定性理论、动态能力理论
AI.method: 基于俄罗斯作者科学文献的分析研究
AI.findings: 识别了自适应管理机制的主要要素，包括：确保企业目标设定、业务流程和组织结构的灵活性与及时重组；考虑外部和内部因素的不同可预测性和可管理性。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了自适应管理理论在工业企业的应用，提出了考虑内外因素不同特性的自适应管理机制框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业企业在不确定环境中建立有效的自适应管理机制提供指导，帮助企业提高应对环境变化的灵活性和适应性。

title: Cryptoauditors

detail.title: Cryptoauditors

declarations.ethicsApproval: IRB approved for the unstructured interviews.

detail.abstract: This article explores the emergence of cryptoauditors as a distinctive class of intermediaries in decentralized finance (DeFi). While DeFi is often portrayed as eliminating intermediaries through decentralization and automated audit trails, the article reveals that market pressures, technological complexity, and recurrent protocol failures have instead led to a process of re-intermediation. In this environment, “Cryptoauditors”—specialized auditing firms in DeFi—have become central actors. Drawing on an interdisciplinary methodology that combines quantitative web content analysis of ninety-two cryptoauditing firms, unstructured interviews, and historical comparison, the article analyzes their origins, organizational structure, and functional evolution of these firms. It demonstrates that cryptoauditors have gained prominence by conducting technical audits, security verification, and ancillary compliance and governance services, particularly in the aftermath of major cryptoexchange collapses. Although cryptoauditors differ from traditional financial auditors in scope and regulatory embedding, they perform comparable trust-producing and fraud-deterrence functions in markets characterized by pseudonymity and informational opacity. The article uses this comparison to illuminate how gatekeeping functions re-emerge in decentralized markets and offers insights into how future regulatory frameworks might engage with these hybrid private actors without undermining DeFi’s technological architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了加密审计师作为去中心化金融（DeFi）中独特中介类别的出现。尽管DeFi常被描述为通过去中心化和自动化审计追踪消除中介，但研究发现市场压力、技术复杂性和协议故障反而导致了再中介化过程。加密审计师通过技术审计、安全验证及合规治理服务，在匿名和信息不透明的市场中发挥着与传统审计师类似的信任生产和欺诈威慑功能。
AI.research_question: 在去中心化金融（DeFi）环境中，加密审计师如何作为新型中介出现并发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 虽然DeFi常被宣传为通过去中心化消除中介，但现实中市场压力、技术复杂性和协议故障却导致了再中介化现象，需要研究这种新型中介的出现机制和功能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 再中介化理论、信任生产理论、欺诈威慑理论、守门人理论
AI.method: 跨学科方法：对92家加密审计公司进行定量网络内容分析、非结构化访谈、历史比较分析
AI.findings: 加密审计师通过技术审计、安全验证及合规治理服务获得重要地位，特别是在主要加密货币交易所崩溃后。尽管在范围和监管嵌入方面与传统金融审计师不同，但在匿名和信息不透明的市场中发挥着类似的信任生产和欺诈威慑功能。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了去中心化市场中守门人功能的重新出现机制，扩展了再中介化理论在数字金融环境中的应用，为理解混合私人行为者在去中心化生态系统中的作用提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为未来监管框架如何与这些混合私人行为者互动而不破坏DeFi技术架构提供了见解，帮助政策制定者理解加密审计师在DeFi生态系统中的实际功能。
