title: Silence as a First-Order Phase Transition: A Minimal Landau Model of Participation Hysteresis

detail.title: Silence as a First-Order Phase Transition: A Minimal Landau Model of Participation Hysteresis
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a minimal theoretical framework that models the transition between collective participation and silence as a first-order phase transition rather than a continuous process. We introduce a macroscopic order parameter for observable engagement and a control variable representing environmental pressure against participation. By constructing a Landautype effective free energy with the minimal polynomial structure required for metastability, we obtain noncontinuous collapse, coexistence, and hysteresis without additional psychological assumptions. We derive in closed form the order-parameter jump, the coexistence point, the spinodals, and the hysteresis width, providing a structural explanation for abrupt silence and delayed recovery. We then incorporate interventions as a conjugate field and show that susceptibility diverges at the spinodal boundaries, implying that small interventions can be either ineffective or explosively effective depending on the system's position within the hysteresis loop. The framework provides a quantitative foundation for diagnosing silent states and designing social environments that avoid irreversible collapse.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个最小理论框架，将集体参与和沉默之间的转变建模为一阶相变而非连续过程。通过引入可观测参与度的宏观序参数和代表环境压力的控制变量，构建具有亚稳态所需最小多项式结构的Landau型有效自由能，得到非连续崩溃、共存和滞后现象。该框架为诊断沉默状态和设计避免不可逆崩溃的社会环境提供了量化基础。
AI.research_question: 集体参与和沉默之间的转变如何建模为一阶相变？如何用最小理论框架解释突然沉默和延迟恢复现象？
AI.motivation: 传统上认为集体参与和沉默之间的转变是连续过程，但现实中经常观察到突然的沉默崩溃和延迟恢复现象，需要新的理论框架来解释这些非连续转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于相变理论，特别是Landau理论，将集体参与建模为一阶相变。引入宏观序参数表示可观测参与度，控制变量表示环境压力，构建具有亚稳态所需最小多项式结构的有效自由能。
AI.method: 构建Landau型有效自由能模型，推导序参数跳跃、共存点、自旋边界和滞后宽度的闭合形式解。将干预措施作为共轭场纳入模型，分析系统在滞后环内不同位置的敏感性。
AI.findings: 模型显示集体参与和沉默之间存在非连续崩溃、共存状态和滞后现象。干预措施的敏感性在自旋边界处发散，意味着小干预可能无效或爆炸性有效，取决于系统在滞后环中的位置。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将集体参与-沉默转变建模为一阶相变；2) 提供最小理论框架解释突然沉默和延迟恢复；3) 推导关键参数的闭合形式解；4) 将干预措施纳入相变框架分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为诊断沉默状态提供量化工具；2) 指导设计避免不可逆崩溃的社会环境；3) 帮助理解干预措施在不同系统状态下的效果差异；4) 为组织管理和社会治理提供理论支持。

title: On Chinese A-share ROE Problem: Reduced-Form Framing with Macro Predictors

detail.title: On Chinese A-share ROE Problem: Reduced-Form Framing with Macro Predictors
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the drivers of a custom Return on Equity (ROE) factor in Chinese A-shares, inspecting the connection between share issuance dilution and macroeconomic conditions in shaping deeper profitability dynamics. While our theoretical framework emphasises the mechanical dilution effect of equity issuance - whereby equity base expansion depresses reported ROE and drives persistent underperformance - our empirical analysis reveals a more nuanced picture that challenges conventional practitioner narratives that China is ‘all about real estate, currency policy, and profitability (we use ROE as the proxy) factor timing’. Using a reduced-form linear regression, we model the custom ROE factor - defined as the monthly spread between high- and low-ROE ‘names’ in the A-shares universe - as a function of aggregate A-share issuance, broad-weighted CNY exchange rates, and the Real Estate Financial Conditions Index (RE-FCI). We argue that issuance dilution and RE-FCI effects are statistically significant predictors of ROE factor performance, while currency effects remain insignificant. These findings lend credence for the theoretical framework in the context of our sample period. The economic magnitude of equity issuance also presents harvestable temporal risk premia in future work for extending our findings to high frequency price returns. We think our work has implications for both investment practice and policy design, suggesting that monitoring real estate sector financial conditions may be equally as valuable as tracking equity issuance volumes for custom ROE factors in A-shares. Drawing on empirical literature, our fundamental contribution lies in that for factor investing in emerging markets, the relationships between firm-level characteristics and macro predictors may be more indirect than standard theoretical frameworks or market intelligence suggest.

AI.tldr: 本文研究中国A股自定义ROE因子的驱动因素，发现股票发行稀释和房地产金融条件指数是ROE因子表现的重要预测指标，而汇率效应不显著，挑战了传统市场认知。
AI.research_question: 中国A股自定义ROE因子的驱动因素是什么？股票发行稀释、汇率政策和房地产金融条件如何影响ROE因子表现？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统市场认知（认为中国股市主要受房地产、货币政策和盈利能力因子择时驱动），深入探究股票发行稀释与宏观经济条件对ROE因子动态的复杂影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 股票发行稀释理论：股权基础扩张会压低报告的ROE并导致持续表现不佳；新兴市场因子投资理论：企业层面特征与宏观预测因子之间的关系可能比标准理论框架或市场认知更为间接。
AI.method: 使用简化形式的线性回归模型，将自定义ROE因子（定义为A股市场中高ROE与低ROE股票之间的月度价差）建模为A股总发行量、广义加权人民币汇率和房地产金融条件指数（RE-FCI）的函数。
AI.findings: 1. 股票发行稀释效应和RE-FCI效应是ROE因子表现的统计显著预测指标；2. 汇率效应不显著；3. 股票发行的经济规模为未来高频价格回报研究提供了可获取的时间风险溢价。
AI.theory_contributions: 对新兴市场因子投资理论做出贡献：揭示了企业层面特征与宏观预测因子之间关系的间接性，挑战了标准理论框架和市场认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资实践提供指导：监控房地产部门金融条件与跟踪股票发行量对A股自定义ROE因子同等重要；2. 为政策设计提供参考：强调房地产金融条件监控的重要性。

title: Parliamentips: Knowledge, Perceptions, and Performance in Teaching Senior High School-Level Philippine Politics and Governance
affiliations: , Department of Education of the Philippines and Department of Education of the Philippines

detail.title: Parliamentips: Knowledge, Perceptions, and Performance in Teaching Senior High School-Level Philippine Politics and Governance
detail.abstract: This study examines the effects of ParliamenTips, a microlearning approach, on knowledge, perceptions, and performance in Senior High School Philippine Politics and Governance. ParliamenTips consists of eight single-slide instructional units paired with a mock parliamentary meeting task, designed to bridge theoretical civic knowledge and practical democratic skills. Participants were 81 Grade 11 Humanities and Social Sciences students at Dr. Jose P. Rizal Senior High School during the first quarter of School Year 2024-2025. Knowledge acquisition was measured via the ParliamenTips RUAA Test (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze), learner perceptions through a seven-dimension survey, and performance outcomes through quarterly grades and mock meeting scores. Results show that knowledge strongly predicts academic performance, while positive learner perceptions moderately correlate with both knowledge and grades. Group-level analyses suggest collaborative dynamics can offset individual knowledge gaps, supporting consistent performance in practical parliamentary tasks. The study demonstrates that microlearning approaches like ParliamenTips can enhance procedural knowledge acquisition, promote transfer to real-world performance, and foster meaningful engagement in civic education. Implications highlight the need to balance cognitive comprehension with experiential, collaborative learning to optimize both knowledge retention and learner satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了ParliamenTips（一种微学习方法）对高中菲律宾政治与治理课程中知识、感知和表现的影响。研究发现知识能强预测学业表现，积极的学习者感知与知识和成绩呈中等相关，小组协作能弥补个体知识差距。
AI.research_question: ParliamenTips微学习方法如何影响高中生在菲律宾政治与治理课程中的知识获取、学习感知和表现？
AI.motivation: 需要弥合理论公民知识与实际民主技能之间的差距，探索微学习方法在公民教育中的有效性，以提升学生的参与度和实际应用能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 微学习理论、建构主义学习理论、体验式学习理论、协作学习理论、知识迁移理论。
AI.method: 准实验研究设计，81名11年级人文社会科学学生参与。使用ParliamenTips RUAA测试测量知识获取（记忆、理解、应用、分析），七维度调查测量学习者感知，季度成绩和模拟会议分数测量表现结果。
AI.findings: 知识能强预测学业表现；积极的学习者感知与知识和成绩呈中等正相关；小组协作动态能弥补个体知识差距，支持在实际议会任务中的一致表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了微学习在公民教育中的有效性；展示了知识迁移从理论到实践的路径；揭示了协作学习对弥补个体知识差距的作用；提供了RUAA测试框架在评估多层次知识获取中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: ParliamenTips可作为有效的公民教育教学工具；教育者应平衡认知理解与体验式协作学习；教学设计应注重理论知识与实践技能的衔接；评估体系应包含知识、感知和表现多维度指标。

title: An Empirical Decomposition of Implied Volatility Surfaces

detail.title: An Empirical Decomposition of Implied Volatility Surfaces

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial or personal interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or experiments requiring ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes and empirically tests an integrated decomposition of implied volatility surfaces, constructed from observable quantities and local estimation procedures. The approach organizes the surface into empirically interpretable components, associated with the reference level, position of the skew vertex, local curvature, wing asymmetry, and directional dislocation between calls and puts. Using data from the Brazilian equity options market, the empirical analysis shows that these components exhibit regime-conditional co-movements, while simultaneously preserving distinct dynamics and heterogeneous sensitivities to market stress and frictions. In particular, structural changes in specific components may occur without uniform shifts of the implied volatility surface as a whole. The results suggest that monolithic representations of implied volatility surfaces may obscure relevant price formation mechanisms, especially in environments characterized by heterogeneous liquidity and informational asymmetry. The proposed integrated decomposition therefore provides a transparent empirical framework for regime diagnosis, risk analysis, and interpretation of implied volatility dynamics, complementing traditional global parametrizations. This article focuses on the identification, organization, and empirical evidence of the components of implied volatility surfaces, rather than on the development of a complete option pricing model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实证检验了一种隐含波动率曲面的集成分解方法，该方法基于可观测量和局部估计程序构建，将曲面分解为可解释的组成部分，包括参考水平、偏斜顶点位置、局部曲率、翼部不对称性以及看涨/看跌期权之间的方向错位。使用巴西股票期权市场数据的实证分析表明，这些组成部分在不同市场状态下表现出协同运动，同时保持独特的动态特征和对市场压力及摩擦的异质性敏感性。
AI.research_question: 如何将隐含波动率曲面分解为可解释的组成部分，以揭示传统整体表示可能掩盖的相关价格形成机制？
AI.motivation: 传统的整体隐含波动率曲面表示可能掩盖相关的价格形成机制，特别是在流动性异质和信息不对称的环境中。需要一种更透明的框架来理解隐含波动率曲面的动态特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 隐含波动率曲面分解理论，将曲面组织为可解释的组成部分：参考水平、偏斜顶点位置、局部曲率、翼部不对称性、看涨/看跌期权方向错位。
AI.method: 基于可观测量和局部估计程序构建集成分解方法，使用巴西股票期权市场数据进行实证分析，检验各组成部分的协同运动、动态特征和对市场压力的敏感性。
AI.findings: 1. 分解的组成部分在不同市场状态下表现出协同运动；2. 各组成部分保持独特的动态特征；3. 对市场压力和摩擦具有异质性敏感性；4. 特定组成部分的结构变化可能发生而不引起整个隐含波动率曲面的统一变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了隐含波动率曲面的集成分解框架；2. 揭示了整体表示可能掩盖的价格形成机制；3. 为理解隐含波动率动态提供了更精细的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为市场状态诊断提供透明框架；2. 支持风险分析和隐含波动率动态解释；3. 补充传统的全局参数化方法；4. 特别适用于流动性异质和信息不对称的市场环境。

title: Anchoring Climate Damages to Real Housing Wealth: Evidence from the United States

detail.title: Anchoring Climate Damages to Real Housing Wealth: Evidence from the United States

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses exclusively publicly available, aggregated secondary data and does not involve human participants or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether the long-run evolution of economic damages from climate-related natural disasters in the United States is anchored to the real appreciation of residential real estate. Using monthly data from January 2000 to May 2025, we construct a novel measure of real climate-related damages normalized by housing market exposure. Johansen cointegration tests and a vector error-correction model provide robust evidence of a stable long-run relationship between normalized real damages and real house prices. The cointegrating relationship is statistically significant and robust across lag specifications ranging from two to eight lags. The results suggest that the observed rise in disaster-related losses largely reflects increasing exposure driven by housing wealth appreciation rather than solely increasing climate hazard intensity.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现美国气候相关自然灾害的经济损失长期演变与住宅房地产实际升值存在锚定关系，表明灾害损失上升主要反映了住房财富增长驱动的暴露度增加，而非单纯的气候灾害强度增强。
AI.research_question: 美国气候相关自然灾害经济损害的长期演变是否与住宅房地产的实际升值存在锚定关系？
AI.motivation: 理解气候灾害经济损失上升背后的驱动因素：是气候灾害强度增加，还是资产价值（特别是住房财富）增长导致的暴露度增加？
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产价值与灾害损失关系的经济理论，特别是房地产价值作为灾害暴露度代理变量的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用2000年1月至2025年5月的月度数据，构建住房市场暴露度归一化的实际气候损害新指标，采用Johansen协整检验和向量误差修正模型分析长期关系。
AI.findings: 归一化实际损害与实际房价之间存在稳定的长期协整关系，该关系在2-8阶滞后的不同设定下均统计显著且稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解气候灾害经济损失的长期演变提供了新的理论视角，强调了资产价值变化在灾害暴露度评估中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了区分气候灾害强度增加与资产价值增长对经济损失贡献的分析框架，有助于更准确地评估气候风险和政策干预效果。

title: Effectiveness of documentation requirements in curbing profit shifting

detail.title: Effectiveness of documentation requirements in curbing profit shifting
detail.abstract: This study examines whether transfer pricing and tax documentation requirements effectively curb profit shifting by multinational enterprises (MNEs). Against the backdrop of increasing digitalisation and the growing complexity of cross-border corporate structures, the paper evaluates the extent to which documentation rules contribute to transparency, compliance, and enforcement in international taxation. The study adopts a qualitative methodology combining doctrinal legal analysis, comparative policy review across OECD and selected non-OECD jurisdictions, and a synthesis of empirical literature assessing compliance behaviour and enforcement outcomes. The analysis draws on OECD guidelines and recent academic evidence on the relationship between documentation regimes, audit effectiveness, and tax revenue protection. The findings indicate that transfer pricing documentation requirements, particularly master files, local files, and country-by-country reporting, significantly enhance information availability for tax authorities and improve audit targeting and risk assessment. However, the evidence also shows that documentation alone has limited deterrent effects on profit shifting when enforcement capacity is weak, administrative resources are constrained, or international cooperation is fragmented. Furthermore, the absence of integrated digital reporting and data-sharing systems reduces the practical effectiveness of documentation rules. The study concludes that while transfer pricing documentation is a necessary foundation for addressing profit shifting, it is not sufficient on its own. Effective curbing of profit shifting requires complementary enforcement mechanisms, enhanced international coordination, and the adoption of advanced digital reporting frameworks (Xu, Yang, and Lian; OECD-related literature).

AI.tldr: 该研究评估转移定价和税务文档要求是否能有效遏制跨国企业利润转移。研究发现文档要求能提高税务机构信息获取和审计效率，但单独使用时效果有限，需要配合执法能力、国际合作和数字报告系统才能有效遏制利润转移。
AI.research_question: 转移定价和税务文档要求是否能有效遏制跨国企业的利润转移行为？
AI.motivation: 随着数字化发展和跨境企业结构日益复杂，需要评估现有文档规则在国际税收透明度、合规性和执法方面的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于OECD指南和学术文献，分析文档制度、审计效果与税收保护之间的关系框架。
AI.method: 采用定性研究方法，结合法律分析、OECD与非OECD司法管辖区的比较政策审查，以及对合规行为和执法结果的实证文献综合。
AI.findings: 转移定价文档要求（主文件、本地文件、国别报告）显著提高税务机构信息获取能力，改善审计目标定位和风险评估。但文档单独使用时对利润转移的威慑效果有限，特别是在执法能力弱、行政资源有限或国际合作不足的情况下。缺乏集成数字报告和数据共享系统也降低了文档规则的实际效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论上明确了转移定价文档作为遏制利润转移的必要但不充分条件，提出了需要配合执法机制和国际协调的综合框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践上建议政策制定者：1）加强执法能力建设；2）增强国际协调合作；3）采用先进数字报告框架；4）将文档要求与有效执行机制相结合。

title: Tax avoidance strategies and regulatory gaps in developing countries

detail.title: Tax avoidance strategies and regulatory gaps in developing countries
detail.abstract: This study investigates tax avoidance strategies and regulatory gaps in developing countries, with a focus on understanding the mechanisms that enable non-compliance and the effectiveness of current policy measures. Using a critical literature synthesis complemented by a review of case studies across multiple developing economies, the research identifies prevalent avoidance strategies, including transfer pricing manipulation, underreporting of income, and the exploitation of loopholes in digital transactions. The study highlights significant gaps in enforcement capacity, inconsistencies in regulatory frameworks, and the challenges posed by the expanding digital economy, which facilitates cross-border tax planning and complicates monitoring efforts. Findings also suggest that taxpayer education initiatives improve voluntary compliance but are often limited by resource constraints and low institutional trust. The study concludes that developing countries face systemic regulatory and enforcement challenges that constrain effective tax collection, emphasizing the need for targeted policy reforms, capacity building, and the integration of digital tools to enhance transparency and compliance. Addressing these issues is critical for improving revenue mobilization and promoting equitable economic development (Hossain et al., 2024).

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了发展中国家避税策略与监管漏洞，分析了非合规机制、现行政策效果，并提出了加强税收征管的政策建议。
AI.research_question: 发展中国家存在哪些主要避税策略和监管漏洞？当前政策措施的成效如何？如何有效应对这些挑战以改善税收征管？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家面临严重的税收流失问题，避税行为侵蚀税基，影响财政收入和经济公平发展。现有研究对发展中国家特定环境下的避税机制和监管挑战关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收遵从理论、监管缺口理论、制度能力理论、数字经济发展对税收征管的挑战理论。
AI.method: 采用批判性文献综述法，结合多个发展中国家案例研究分析，系统梳理避税策略和监管问题。
AI.findings:
1. 主要避税策略：转让定价操纵、收入少报、利用数字交易漏洞
2. 监管问题：执法能力不足、监管框架不一致、数字经济带来的跨境税收规划挑战
3. 纳税人教育能提高自愿遵从度，但受资源限制和制度信任度低制约
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 系统识别了发展中国家特有的避税机制和监管缺口
2. 拓展了数字经济环境下税收征管的理论框架
3. 深化了对制度能力与税收遵从关系的理解
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供针对性改革建议
2. 强调能力建设和数字工具整合的重要性
3. 提出改善税收透明度和遵从度的具体路径，促进财政收入增加和公平经济发展

title: Network Interactions and Mutual Dependence in the Global Sustainability Governance System
affiliations: Bar-Ilan University - Faculty of Law and  Bar-Ilan University - Faculty of Law, Students

detail.title: Network Interactions and Mutual Dependence in the Global Sustainability Governance System
detail.abstract: This article examines the hybrid network structure of the global sustainability governance system, focusing on the evolving relationships between private transnational regulators (PTRs), and intergovernmental organizations (IOs). We argue that a defining feature of this structure is the mutual dependence between PTRs and IOs: PTRs invoke public international law instruments (PILIs)-and, by extension, the authority of the IOs behind them-to bolster their own authority and to enhance the normative force of the standards they promulgate. IOs rely on PTRs to disseminate their norms within corporate settings, thereby strengthening their compliance capacities. This interdependence carries significant synergistic potential. We examine the grounding relationship between PTRs and PILIs/IOs through extensive network analysis based on a specially curated dataset comprising 55 PTRs, 393 private standards, 261 PILIs (including treaties, conventions, and declarations), and 41 IOs. Citation patterns within this network support our thesis. We also offer tentative evidence regarding the second prong of our model and outline directions for future research. Finally, we assess the vulnerabilities of this interdependent structure, highlighting the fragility of the global sustainability legal order in the face of rising nationalism and anti-multilateralist pressures.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过网络分析探讨全球可持续发展治理中的混合网络结构，发现私人跨国监管机构与政府间组织之间存在相互依赖关系，这种依赖既有协同潜力也存在脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 全球可持续发展治理系统的混合网络结构特征是什么？私人跨国监管机构与政府间组织之间如何相互依赖？这种相互依赖关系对全球可持续发展法律秩序有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解全球可持续发展治理中日益复杂的公私混合网络结构，特别是私人跨国监管机构与政府间组织之间的互动关系，对于评估全球治理的有效性和脆弱性至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合网络治理理论、公私治理互动理论、跨国监管权威理论、国际法律秩序脆弱性理论
AI.method: 网络分析方法，基于专门构建的数据集：包括55个私人跨国监管机构、393个私人标准、261个公共国际法律文书（条约、公约、宣言）和41个政府间组织，分析引用模式
AI.findings: 1. 私人跨国监管机构通过引用公共国际法律文书来增强自身权威和标准规范性；2. 政府间组织依赖私人跨国监管机构在企业环境中传播其规范；3. 网络分析支持相互依赖的论点；4. 这种相互依赖结构在面对民族主义和反多边主义压力时具有脆弱性
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了全球可持续发展治理中公私混合网络结构的理论模型；2. 阐明了私人跨国监管机构与政府间组织相互依赖的机制；3. 揭示了全球法律秩序的脆弱性来源
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解全球可持续发展治理的复杂性提供框架；2. 识别治理系统的脆弱点以增强韧性；3. 为跨国企业和非政府组织参与治理提供指导

title: When Two Clocks Collide: Threshold Heuristics for Patent Governance Under Regulatory Congestion

detail.title: When Two Clocks Collide: Threshold Heuristics for Patent Governance Under Regulatory Congestion
detail.abstract: Why do some rms fragment their patent portfolios while others centralise? This paper argues that the answer lies in a threshold heuristic triggered by institutional congestion. When regulatory bottlenecks compress elective patent protection, rms face coupled uncertainty from two unsynchronised institutional clocks: one measuring regulatory approval time, the other measuring patent term. We develop a behavioral framework showing that organisations respond to this uncertainty not through continuous optimisation but through discrete governance switches at critical exposure thresholds. The analysis builds on the tradition of behavioral organization research developed in this journal. Drawing on Simon (1955)'s bounded rationality, Cyert and March (1963)'s behavioral theory of the rm, and Oxley (1999)'s work on intellectual property governance, we introduce systemic irreversibility exposure (ξ) as the organising construct. This measure captures interaction between regulatory concentration, legal centralisation, and temporal overlap of vulnerability windows. Methodologically, we model regulatory approval as a G/G/c queueing process and derive variance dynamics via Kingman's heavy-traffic approximation. The central result employs Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman optimal control to show that the governance problem admits a bang-bang solution: rms either fully centralise or fully fragment, switching discretely at a scalar threshold ξ ∗ . This mathematical structure has direct behavioral interpretation: the optimal policy collapses to precisely the kind of simple threshold rule that bounded rationality research predicts organisations will adopt. Model calibration against European medical device regulation shows the phasetransition regime is empirically relevant: notified body utilisation rates of ρ ∈ [0.90, 0.98] generate variance multipliers of 1002500×. Sectoral variation in Unified Patent Court opt-out behaviour provides a natural setting for testing the threshold predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个行为框架，解释企业专利组合碎片化与集中化的决策：当监管瓶颈压缩专利保护时，企业面临两个不同步的制度时钟（监管审批时间 vs 专利期限）带来的不确定性。企业通过离散的治理切换来应对，而非连续优化。
AI.research_question: 为什么有些企业将专利组合碎片化，而另一些企业则集中化？
AI.motivation: 理解企业在面对监管瓶颈和制度时钟不同步时，如何做出专利治理决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Simon(1955)的有限理性、Cyert和March(1963)的企业行为理论、Oxley(1999)的知识产权治理研究，引入系统性不可逆暴露(ξ)作为组织建构。
AI.method: 将监管审批建模为G/G/c排队过程，使用Kingman的重负载近似推导方差动态，采用Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman最优控制证明治理问题存在bang-bang解。
AI.findings: 企业要么完全集中化，要么完全碎片化，在标量阈值ξ*处离散切换。模型校准显示相变机制具有经验相关性：欧洲医疗器械监管的利用率ρ∈[0.90,0.98]产生100-2500倍的方差乘数。
AI.theory_contributions: 引入系统性不可逆暴露(ξ)概念，将监管集中度、法律集中度和脆弱窗口时间重叠的相互作用理论化，证明最优政策简化为有限理性研究预测的简单阈值规则。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业专利治理决策提供行为框架，统一专利法院选择退出行为的行业差异为测试阈值预测提供了自然场景。

title: Resisting Abuses of Spyware in Peace and War through Civil Litigation
affiliations: University College London - Faculty of Laws

detail.title: Resisting Abuses of Spyware in Peace and War through Civil Litigation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Faculty of Laws University College London Law Research Paper No. 01/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: University College London Faculty of Laws Legal Studies Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming in LAW IN THE SHADOWS OF WAR: ESPIONAGE AND SABOTAGE IN MODERN CONFLICT (Watking and West Eds., University of Toronto Press, 2026).

detail.abstract: The commercial spyware industry has emerged as a profitable and pervasive market, reflecting the privatization of intelligence and the outsourcing of traditionally sovereign surveillance functions. Long associated with domestic law enforcement, these tools are increasingly deployed in connection with armed conflict and transnational security operations, raising more acute questions of accountability and oversight. This chapter examines the largely overlooked role of private law-particularly contract and tort litigation-as a means of contesting and remedying spyware-related abuses across both peacetime and wartime contexts. Drawing on recent civil litigation in the United States, the United Kingdom, and Canada, it analyzes how private law claims can operate alongside, and at times in the gaps left by, international law and other public regulatory regimes. The chapter examines the doctrinal reach and practical limits of civil litigation, focusing in particular on cases where spyware deployment intersects with armed conflict and claims of state or contractor immunity. It argues that while private law cannot by itself resolve the broader failures of spyware governance, it can nonetheless provide a meaningful, if partial, form of accountability in an otherwise fragmented legal landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨商业间谍软件行业如何私有化情报功能，并分析在武装冲突和跨国安全行动背景下，如何利用合同法、侵权法等私法诉讼来追究间谍软件滥用的责任，作为国际法和公共监管体系的补充。
AI.research_question: 私法（特别是合同法和侵权法诉讼）如何在和平时期和战争背景下，作为追究间谍软件相关滥用的手段，并与国际法及其他公共监管制度相互作用？
AI.motivation: 商业间谍软件行业已成为一个有利可图且普遍存在的市场，反映了情报私有化和传统主权监视功能的外包。这些工具越来越多地用于武装冲突和跨国安全行动，引发了更严重的问责和监督问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 私法理论（合同法和侵权法）、国际法理论、主权豁免理论、公私法互动理论、法律碎片化理论
AI.method: 案例分析法，基于美国、英国和加拿大近期的民事诉讼案例，分析私法诉讼在间谍软件部署与武装冲突交叉情境下的应用
AI.findings: 私法诉讼可以在国际法和其他公共监管制度留下的空白中运作，为间谍软件滥用提供有意义的问责机制，尽管其效力受到国家或承包商豁免权等限制
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 拓展了私法在国家安全和武装冲突领域的应用理论；2. 提出了公私法互动在间谍软件治理中的理论框架；3. 丰富了法律碎片化背景下问责机制的理论探讨
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为受害者提供了追究间谍软件滥用的法律途径；2. 为律师和法院处理类似案件提供了实践指导；3. 揭示了私法诉讼在弥补公共监管不足方面的实际作用；4. 为政策制定者提供了改进间谍软件治理的参考

title: Analyzing the Value of Managed Accounts
affiliations: Morningstar, Inc. - Morningstar Investment Management LLC, Morningstar Center for Retirement and Policy Studies and Morningstar Investment Management

detail.title: Analyzing the Value of Managed Accounts
detail.abstract: In this paper, we quantify the value of managed accounts using the Morningstar Center for Retirement and Policy Studies' new quantitative framework, the Defined Contribution Outcomes Model. DCOM integrates predictive equations for savings rates and asset allocations, estimated from a large dataset of millions of participant-level observations across thousands of plans, which control for participant demographics and plan design features. These equations incorporate a high level of granularity, capturing the heterogeneity across participants and plan designs. To assess the value of managed accounts, we simulate outcomes under a baseline scenario in which participants invest in target-date funds or self-directed portfolios and a counterfactual scenario in which they adopt a managed account at a cost of 40 basis points per year. Overall, we find that managed accounts boost retirement wealth outcomes, with the median wealth to salary ratio at age 65 increasing by 7.7% across all participants studied. We also note that the impact of managed accounts is more pronounced for younger and lower- to middle-income workers. From a plan design perspective, we find that managed accounts provide value for both voluntary enrollment and auto enrollment plans. The impact is smaller for auto enrollment with auto escalation plans but is still positive. Lastly, we note that there is considerable heterogeneity in the results across plans.

AI.tldr: 使用Morningstar退休政策研究中心的DCOM模型量化管理账户的价值，发现管理账户能提升退休财富，中位数财富/工资比增加7.7%，对年轻和中低收入者效果更显著。
AI.research_question: 管理账户对退休财富积累的价值是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着退休储蓄需求的增长，需要量化评估管理账户这类投资工具的实际价值，为参与者和计划设计者提供决策依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Morningstar退休政策研究中心的定义供款结果模型(DCOM)，该模型整合了储蓄率和资产配置的预测方程。
AI.method: 使用DCOM模型，基于数百万参与者级别的观测数据，模拟基线情景（目标日期基金或自主投资组合）与反事实情景（采用管理账户，年成本40基点）下的退休结果。
AI.findings: 管理账户能提升退休财富，65岁时中位数财富/工资比增加7.7%；对年轻和中低收入工作者效果更显著；对自愿注册和自动注册计划都有价值，但对自动注册+自动升级计划影响较小但仍为正；不同计划间存在显著异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了量化管理账户价值的实证框架，揭示了管理账户在不同人口统计特征和计划设计下的异质性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为退休计划参与者提供管理账户价值评估，为计划设计者提供管理账户在不同计划类型中实施效果的实证证据。

title: Electoral Synchronisation Risk and Strategic Decision Latency in Coalition Systems

detail.title: Electoral Synchronisation Risk and Strategic Decision Latency in Coalition Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial, professional, or personal conflicts of interest related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research was conducted independently and received no external funding from public, private, or institutional sources.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently and received no external funding from public, private, or institutional sources.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces Electoral Synchronisation Risk (ESR) as a system-level framework for analysing how overlapping election cycles and leadership transitions across allied democracies can increase coalition strategic decision latency during fast-moving security crises. The central claim is not that elections weaken military capability or that democratic systems fail under stress, but that simultaneity across political calendars temporarily constrains political authorisation and alliance coordination, even when operational readiness remains high. Applied to the late-2020s Indo-Pacific, the framework identifies a period of elevated ESR arising from stacked electoral and post-transition phases across multiple coalition members. The paper further shows that this risk is structurally asymmetric: while democratic coalitions experience peak political fragmentation, authoritarian systems may simultaneously experience leadership consolidation, altering relative decision-making capacity without implying intent or prediction. The paper is analytical rather than predictive. It does not forecast conflict or attribute motives to any actor. Its contribution is to formalise a timing-based risk mechanism that is portable across regions and applicable to coalition security challenges beyond any single contingency.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"选举同步风险"（ESR）框架，分析盟国民主国家选举周期重叠如何增加安全危机中的联盟决策延迟，并应用于2020年代末的印太地区。
AI.research_question: 盟国民主国家选举周期重叠如何影响安全危机中的联盟战略决策效率？
AI.motivation: 现有研究较少关注民主国家选举周期同步对联盟协调能力的时间性影响，特别是在快速发展的安全危机中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 选举同步风险（ESR）框架，强调时间性风险而非能力缺陷，关注政治授权与联盟协调的暂时性约束。
AI.method: 分析性框架构建与应用，将ESR框架应用于2020年代末印太地区的选举周期重叠情境。
AI.findings: 1）2020年代末印太地区存在选举同步风险升高期；2）ESR具有结构性不对称性：民主联盟政治碎片化时，威权体系可能经历领导层巩固；3）这改变了相对决策能力，但不暗示意图或预测冲突。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）形式化基于时间的风险机制；2）提供可跨区域移植的分析框架；3）将选举周期同步概念化为系统性风险因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者识别联盟协调脆弱期提供工具；2）帮助理解民主-威权决策能力动态；3）适用于超越单一应急情况的联盟安全挑战。

title: Parking Distribution as an Anticipatory Indicator of Economic Stress

detail.title: Parking Distribution as an Anticipatory Indicator of Economic Stress
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a novel economic theory proposing that the spatial distribution of vehicles in supermarket parking lots serves as an anticipatory indicator of collective economic stress. Unlike traditional macroeconomic indicators, which are delayed and aggregated, parking behavior reflects immediate microeconomic decisions influenced by perceived uncertainty. The theory defines measurable metrics, such as spatial concentration, inefficiency, and aversion to distant spaces, capturing patterns that emerge under economic tension. These metrics allow the formulation of a composite Parking Economic Stress Index (PESI). The framework is entirely theoretical, offering a foundation for future empirical validation and potential applications in consumer behavior analysis, urban planning, and behavioral economics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的经济理论，认为超市停车场的车辆空间分布可以作为集体经济压力的前瞻性指标。与延迟且聚合的传统宏观经济指标不同，停车行为反映了受感知不确定性影响的即时微观经济决策。
AI.research_question: 超市停车场的车辆空间分布模式能否作为集体经济压力的前瞻性指标？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观经济指标存在延迟性和聚合性，无法及时反映微观层面的经济压力。停车行为作为日常消费决策的一部分，可能包含更即时、更细粒度的经济压力信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出了一个全新的经济理论框架，将停车行为视为反映经济压力的微观决策过程。理论定义了空间集中度、效率低下和远距离空间规避等可测量指标。
AI.method: 这是一个纯理论框架研究，提出了Parking Economic Stress Index (PESI)的构建方法，但尚未进行实证验证。方法包括定义可测量的停车行为指标和构建复合指数。
AI.findings: 理论框架表明，在经济增长压力下，停车行为会表现出特定的空间模式，这些模式可以通过定义的指标进行量化，并整合成PESI指数。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了停车行为作为经济压力指标的新理论视角；2. 建立了微观行为与宏观经济压力之间的理论联系；3. 定义了可量化的停车行为指标；4. 提出了PESI指数的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为消费者行为分析提供新工具；2. 为城市规划提供数据支持；3. 为行为经济学研究提供新视角；4. 为未来实证研究奠定理论基础。

title: Ai As a Co-Founder: Can Machine Intelligence Drive Entrepreneurial Success?

detail.title: Ai As a Co-Founder: Can Machine Intelligence Drive Entrepreneurial Success?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or identifiable personal data and did not require ethics committee approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This research explores the evolving role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a strategic cofounder in modern entrepreneurship. Drawing on examples from the tourism industry and broader startup ecosystems, the paper investigates how machine intelligence contributes to ideation, product development, pricing, marketing, and operations. Findings reveal that AI enhances decision-making, reduces costs, and drives innovation, but also presents challenges in ethics, accountability, and the human-AI balance of leadership. When integrated ethically, AI can co-lead entrepreneurial ventures toward scalable and sustainable success.

AI.tldr: AI作为战略联合创始人在现代创业中的角色演变：AI在旅游和创业生态系统中如何参与创意生成、产品开发、定价、营销和运营，提升决策、降低成本、推动创新，但也带来伦理、问责和领导力平衡的挑战。
AI.research_question: AI作为战略联合创始人在现代创业中扮演什么角色？AI如何影响创业过程的不同阶段（创意生成、产品开发、定价、营销、运营）？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术快速发展，其在创业生态系统中的作用日益重要，但AI作为"战略联合创始人"的角色尚未得到充分研究。需要探索AI如何改变创业过程，以及这种变化带来的机遇和挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业理论、战略管理理论、人机协作理论、技术创新理论、伦理与问责理论
AI.method: 案例研究法（旅游行业和更广泛的创业生态系统案例）、定性分析
AI.findings: 1. AI在创业各阶段（创意生成、产品开发、定价、营销、运营）都发挥重要作用；2. AI能提升决策质量、降低成本、推动创新；3. AI作为联合创始人带来伦理、问责和领导力平衡的挑战；4. 伦理整合的AI能共同引领创业企业实现可扩展和可持续的成功。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"AI作为战略联合创始人"的新概念框架；2. 扩展了创业理论中关于技术角色的理解；3. 丰富了人机协作在创业环境中的理论；4. 为AI伦理在创业中的应用提供理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为创业者提供AI整合的实用指南；2. 帮助企业识别AI应用的机遇和风险；3. 为政策制定者提供AI伦理监管的参考；4. 为投资者评估AI驱动的创业项目提供框架。

title: Can AI Empower African Entrepreneurs or Replace Human Labor? AI Adoption in African Tourism and Hospitality Businesses

detail.title: Can AI Empower African Entrepreneurs or Replace Human Labor? AI Adoption in African Tourism and Hospitality Businesses

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or identifiable personal data and did not require ethics committee approval.

detail.abstract: This research explores how Artificial Intelligence (AI) is transforming Africa's tourism and hospitality industry, focusing on whether it empowers entrepreneurs or replaces human labor. AI technologies such as chatbots, predictive analytics, and automated booking systems are changing how tourism businesses operate across the continent. While AI offers opportunities for efficiency, global visibility, and improved customer satisfaction, it also raises concerns about job loss and reduced human interaction. Through a review of literature, case studies, and regional data, this study examines how AI adoption can balance innovation and inclusion. Findings suggest that when guided by ethical frameworks and supported by digital literacy initiatives, AI can serve as a powerful tool for entrepreneurship, service quality, and sustainable growth.

AI.tldr: AI在非洲旅游酒店业的应用既赋能创业者又可能替代人力，需在创新与包容间平衡
AI.research_question: AI如何改变非洲旅游酒店业？是赋能创业者还是替代人力？

AI.theoretical_framework: 技术创新与就业替代理论、数字包容性理论、可持续发展理论
AI.method: 文献综述、案例研究、区域数据分析
AI.findings: 在伦理框架和数字素养支持下，AI可成为创业、服务质量和可持续发展的有力工具
AI.theory_contributions: 提出AI在发展中地区应用的平衡模型，强调创新与包容的协调

title: AI Use in K-12 Classrooms: Teacher-Student Sensemaking Process Using AI Tools

detail.title: AI Use in K-12 Classrooms: Teacher-Student Sensemaking Process Using AI Tools
detail.abstract: This study aims to further deepen the current discourse on AI use in the classroom by closely examining how teachers and students make sense of AI tools in their learning interactions, with implications for future AI education policy development. Using AI can also enable personalized, adaptive learning for students (Mahender & Sharma, 2025). The use of AI will double the effectiveness of learning by allowing learners to learn at their own pace, and in their own time and space. Notably, AI mediates the teacher-student relationship in the learning process, or, more precisely, collectively reinforces knowledge among the teacher, the knowledge, and the students. This reconstructed knowledge, boosted by AI, serves as the basis for successive teacher-student interactions.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过考察教师和学生在学习互动中如何理解AI工具，深化了课堂AI使用的讨论，为未来AI教育政策制定提供启示。AI能实现个性化自适应学习，将学习效果加倍，并在教师、知识和学生之间中介和强化知识建构。
AI.research_question: 教师和学生在学习互动中如何理解AI工具？这对AI教育政策制定有何启示？
AI.motivation: 深化当前关于课堂AI使用的讨论，探索AI工具在教育互动中的意义建构过程，为政策制定提供实证基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会建构主义学习理论、技术中介理论、教师-学生互动理论、个性化学习理论
AI.method: 定性研究方法，可能包括课堂观察、访谈、话语分析等，以考察教师和学生对AI工具的意义建构过程。
AI.findings: AI工具在教师-学生互动中起到中介作用，强化知识建构；AI支持个性化自适应学习，显著提升学习效果；重构的知识成为后续师生互动的基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了AI在教育中的中介作用理论，深化了技术中介学习互动的理解，提出了AI增强的知识建构模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI教育政策制定提供实证依据，指导AI工具在课堂中的有效整合，促进个性化学习环境的建设。

title: Golden Fair Value: A Market Equilibrium & Correction Indicator

detail.title: Golden Fair Value: A Market Equilibrium & Correction Indicator

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: Market corrections represent significant declines that align prices toward equilibrium, thereby enhancing market efficiency. Utilizing contemporary technical analysis methods, this study proposes a strategy to anticipate price fluctuations and market bottoms during corrective phases. The method integrates 52-week high and low price ranges with the Golden Ratio (0.618) to predict fair values, positing that these ranges reflect momentum and volume over the period, thus providing a reliable basis for stock price forecasts during corrections.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种结合52周高低价格区间和黄金分割比（0.618）的技术分析方法，用于预测市场修正期间的股价波动和底部位置，旨在提高市场效率。
AI.research_question: 如何利用技术分析方法有效预测市场修正期间的股价波动和市场底部？
AI.motivation: 市场修正通过将价格调整至均衡水平来提升市场效率，但投资者需要有效工具来预测修正期间的股价波动和底部，以做出更好的投资决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术分析理论，特别是价格动量理论（52周高低价格区间反映市场动量）和黄金分割比理论（0.618作为重要的技术分析比例）。
AI.method: 整合52周高低价格区间与黄金分割比（0.618）来预测公平价值，认为这些区间反映了期间的动量和成交量，从而为修正期间的股价预测提供可靠基础。
AI.findings: 该方法能够有效预测市场修正期间的股价波动和底部位置，为投资者提供可靠的技术分析工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 将传统技术分析指标（52周高低价格区间）与黄金分割比相结合，提出了一个新的技术分析框架，丰富了市场修正预测的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了实用的技术分析策略，帮助他们在市场修正期间更好地预测价格波动和识别市场底部，从而做出更明智的投资决策。

title: Comparing Econometric and Machine Learning Approaches to Forecasting India's CPI Inflation

detail.title: Comparing Econometric and Machine Learning Approaches to Forecasting India's CPI Inflation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal, professional, or financial relationships with any individuals or organizations that could be perceived to have influenced the conduct, analysis, or interpretation of the research presented in this paper. The study was undertaken independently, and all views expressed are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal data, surveys, experiments, or interventions. All analyses were conducted using publicly available, aggregated macroeconomic and financial time-series data obtained from official sources. As such, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author. No external financial support, grants, or institutional funding were received for the conduct of this study.

detail.abstract:
This paper presents an applied forecasting comparison between a classical econometric model (ARIMAX) and a machine learning approach (Extreme Gradient Boosting – XGBoost) in the context of macroeconomic inflation forecasting. Using monthly CPI inflation data for India from January 2013 to August 2025, augmented with key macro-financial exogenous variables—including food inflation, crude oil prices, exchange rates, and policy interest rates—the study evaluates the two approaches across out-of-sample predictive accuracy, model stability, and long-horizon forecasting suitability.

The results highlight a clear trade-off between flexibility and structural coherence. XGBoost achieves superior short-horizon out-of-sample accuracy through nonlinear feature interactions, while ARIMAX demonstrates greater parameter stability and more economically consistent long-run projections. Benchmarking both models against official central bank forecasts further illustrates that structurally specified econometric models remain competitive for policy-relevant medium- to long-term forecasting, particularly when data availability is limited.

The findings suggest that model selection in macro-financial forecasting should be guided not solely by predictive accuracy, but also by horizon length, interpretability requirements, and the underlying economic structure of the problem.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了传统计量模型(ARIMAX)与机器学习方法(XGBoost)在宏观经济通胀预测中的表现，发现XGBoost在短期预测精度更高，而ARIMAX在参数稳定性和长期预测一致性方面更优，建议模型选择应考虑预测期限、可解释性和经济结构等因素。
AI.research_question: 在宏观经济通胀预测中，传统计量模型(ARIMAX)与机器学习方法(XGBoost)在预测精度、模型稳定性和长期预测适用性方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 随着机器学习方法在预测领域的兴起，需要评估其在宏观经济预测中相对于传统计量模型的优劣，特别是在通胀预测这一政策制定关键领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观经济预测理论、时间序列分析理论、机器学习预测理论、通胀预测模型比较框架
AI.method: 使用印度2013年1月至2025年8月的月度CPI通胀数据，加入食品通胀、原油价格、汇率和政策利率等宏观金融外生变量，比较ARIMAX和XGBoost模型的样本外预测精度、模型稳定性和长期预测适用性，并与央行官方预测进行基准比较。
AI.findings: XGBoost通过非线性特征交互在短期样本外预测精度上表现更优，而ARIMAX在参数稳定性和长期预测的经济一致性方面更好。结构化的计量模型在数据有限的情况下，对于政策相关的中长期预测仍具有竞争力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了宏观金融预测中模型选择的权衡框架，强调了灵活性(机器学习)与结构一致性(计量模型)之间的平衡，为预测方法论选择提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和分析师提供了模型选择的具体指导：短期预测可优先考虑机器学习方法，中长期预测和政策分析应重视计量模型的结构一致性和稳定性，特别是在数据有限的情况下。

title: Effect of chart-GPT & AI in academic field:- Evidence from India

detail.title: Effect of chart-GPT & AI in academic field:- Evidence from India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author & co-author author declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not require ethics approval as it is based on publicly available secondary data and does not involve human participants, animals, or personal identifying information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

keywords: India Higher Education & Large Language Models (LLM)

detail.abstract: This paper studies the effects of large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT and related AI tools on higher-education outputs and behaviours in India. Using a mixed methods design-administrative and bibliometric data, university discipline records, platform usage and a large cross-section survey of faculty and students-we estimate how AI availability changed academic production (publications, assignment submissions), assessment integrity (plagiarism/AI-detected cases), and pedagogical practices (assignment design, use of AI as a teaching aid). Preliminary evidence shows both productivity gains and integrity risks: AI aids drafting and feedback but raises detection and evaluation challenges that institutions and regulators are beginning to address.Ultimately, while AI augments educational outcomes in resource-constrained settings, balanced integration is essential to mitigate risks and promote genuine cognitive growth in India's diverse academic ecosystem.This study synthesizes evidence from recent surveys and empirical research to evaluate their effects on student learning, engagement, and institutional practices. Drawing from a survey of 150 Indian university students, AI integration was found to enhance academic performance for 79.3% of respondents through personalized learning and instant feedback, with 77.2% expressing overall satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了大型语言模型（如ChatGPT）在印度高等教育中的影响，发现AI工具能提高学术生产力（如论文写作、反馈），但也带来抄袭检测和评估挑战。研究显示79.3%的学生因AI个性化学习而提升成绩，但需要平衡整合以降低风险。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型（如ChatGPT）和相关AI工具如何影响印度高等教育的产出、行为和学术诚信？
AI.motivation: 随着AI工具在高等教育中的普及，需要了解其对学术生产力、评估完整性和教学实践的影响，特别是在资源有限的印度教育环境中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育技术采纳理论、学术诚信框架、资源约束环境下的教育创新理论。
AI.method: 混合方法设计：使用行政和文献计量数据、大学学科记录、平台使用数据，以及对150名印度大学师生的大规模横断面调查。
AI.findings: 1. AI提高了学术生产力（论文写作、反馈）；2. 79.3%的学生因个性化学习和即时反馈而提升成绩；3. 77.2%的学生对AI整合表示满意；4. 同时存在抄袭检测和评估挑战；5. 在资源有限环境中AI能增强教育成果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为AI在资源约束高等教育环境中的作用提供理论框架；2. 扩展了教育技术采纳理论在AI时代的应用；3. 提出了平衡AI整合与学术诚信的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为印度高等教育机构提供AI整合指南；2. 帮助制定应对AI相关学术诚信挑战的政策；3. 为教师提供使用AI作为教学辅助工具的最佳实践；4. 为监管机构提供基于证据的决策支持。

title: Infrastructural Economics: Economics as the Stewardship of Moral Possibility

detail.title: Infrastructural Economics: Economics as the Stewardship of Moral Possibility

keywords: Economics as the Stewardship of Moral Possibility

publicationDetails.detailsText: Archival version available on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17982335

detail.abstract:
This paper reconstructs economics as a fundamentally moral discipline by identifying its true object of concern: the preservation and expansion of moral possibility. It argues that moral evaluation requires possibility, possibility requires viable agents, and viable agents require the preservation of viability-enabling infrastructure, including biological, ecological, social, epistemic, institutional, and technological systems that sustain agency over time. Because all economic activity acts upon this infrastructure, economics is not value-neutral but constitutes the governance of moral possibility itself.

Building on the normative ethical framework of Infrastructuralism, the paper introduces Infrastructural Economics as a structural re-foundation of economic theory. Central to this framework is the Viability Margin (VM), defined as the protective distance between an agent’s currently held viability-critical capacities, as enabled by access to viability-enabling infrastructure, and the threshold at which agency collapses (VM = Va − Vt). Economic value is redefined as the net change in Viability Margin (ΔVM), rather than as price, output, or preference satisfaction. Positive changes in VM expand moral and economic possibility, while negative changes erode it.

The paper formalizes three structural laws of Infrastructural Economics, redefines core economic concepts such as value, work, extraction, wealth, money, and inflation, and establishes a universal evaluative standard, the Possibility Preservation Criterion (PPC). The PPC states that an economy functions properly if and only if it preserves or increases total Viability Margin. A measurement framework is proposed that integrates existing multi-domain indicators through the Veil of Observation, demonstrating that Viability Margin is empirically tractable.

The framework applies across market, planned, mixed, and AI-driven economies, and explains how systems can appear successful by conventional metrics while structurally undermining the conditions required for agency. By resolving the paradox in which economic systems justify extraction using the very agency and evaluative capacity they erode, Infrastructural Economics provides a coherent moral foundation for evaluating economic legitimacy, sustainability, and governance in both present and future economies.

AI.tldr: 该论文将经济学重构为道德学科，提出"基础设施经济学"框架，将经济价值重新定义为可行性边际的变化，而非价格或产出。核心是可行性边际概念，衡量代理能力与崩溃阈值之间的距离。论文建立了可能性保存标准作为评估经济合法性的普遍标准。
AI.research_question: 经济学如何作为道德学科重新构建？经济活动的真正对象是什么？如何建立基于道德可能性的经济评估框架？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学被视为价值中立，但所有经济活动都作用于维持代理能力的基础设施系统。当前经济体系可能使用其正在侵蚀的代理能力和评估能力来为提取行为辩护，存在道德悖论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施主义（Infrastructuralism）作为规范伦理框架，强调道德评估需要可能性，可能性需要可行的代理，可行的代理需要维持代理能力的基础设施系统（生物、生态、社会、认知、制度、技术等）。
AI.method: 理论重构方法：1）引入可行性边际概念；2）形式化基础设施经济学的三个结构定律；3）重新定义核心经济概念；4）建立可能性保存标准；5）提出测量框架整合多领域指标。
AI.findings: 1）经济学本质上是道德学科，关注道德可能性的保存和扩展；2）经济价值应重新定义为可行性边际的变化；3）建立了可能性保存标准作为经济合法性的评估标准；4）框架适用于市场、计划、混合和AI驱动经济；5）解释了经济系统如何在使用其正在侵蚀的能力的同时显得成功。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将经济学重构为道德学科；2）提出基础设施经济学作为经济理论的结构性重构；3）引入可行性边际作为核心概念；4）建立可能性保存标准作为普遍评估标准；5）解决经济系统中的道德悖论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供评估经济合法性、可持续性和治理的道德基础；2）提出可操作的测量框架；3）适用于各种经济体系；4）帮助识别表面上成功但实质上破坏代理条件的经济系统；5）为未来经济设计提供指导原则。

title: A Glance at Iqbal's Sociology of Knowledge
affiliations: and Research Institute of Hawzah and University

detail.title: A Glance at Iqbal's Sociology of Knowledge
detail.abstract:
Though in sociology, sociology of knowledge is in some measure an unknown field and comparatively recent and in some respects unique, it seems to replace or perhaps supplement with epistemology. Thus, in line with naturalizing sciences, it would be appropriate to trace these two fields of study in the history of Islamic thoughts so that their epistemology can be fully comprehended or even perfected.
According to some of the ideas of Moslem thinkers, the social, economic and political factors are the causes of human knowledge and they determine its form and content.
 

 
Muhammad Iqbal of Lahore can be refered to as one of the Moslem thinkers whose ideas have some bearing on the sociology of Knowledge. In epistemology he paid special attention to various aspects of knowledge, including inner, intellectual, empirical as well as revealed knowledge. He holds that epistemology plays a great role in all planes of human life, moving from this treatment of epistemology to the treatment of the religious knowledge related to socio - cultural circumstances.
Concerning the latter issue, Iqbal makes some remarks on social and cultural changes within the realm of religious sciences. It is this very idea of Iqbal that affected the theory of contraction and expansion to a large extent. Moreover, Iqbal's plan which underlies the theory of "returning to oneself" directs the Islamic societies towards their own self-assurance to stand agains social self-estrangement.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了伊斯兰思想中知识社会学与认识论的关系，特别以穆罕默德·伊克巴尔的哲学思想为例，分析社会文化因素如何影响知识形成，以及宗教知识在社会变迁中的演变。
AI.research_question: 在伊斯兰思想史中，知识社会学与认识论有何关系？社会文化因素如何影响知识（特别是宗教知识）的形成与演变？
AI.motivation: 知识社会学在伊斯兰思想研究中相对较新且独特，可能补充或替代传统认识论。随着科学自然化趋势，有必要追溯伊斯兰思想中这两个研究领域，以更全面地理解甚至完善其认识论体系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识社会学理论、伊斯兰认识论、穆罕默德·伊克巴尔的哲学思想、社会建构主义、宗教知识的社会文化嵌入性
AI.method: 思想史分析、文本阐释、理论比较、案例研究（以伊克巴尔思想为例）
AI.findings:
1. 穆斯林思想家认为社会、经济和政治因素是人类知识的原因并决定其形式和内容
2. 伊克巴尔在认识论中特别关注内在、智识、经验和启示知识
3. 认识论在人类生活的各个层面都扮演重要角色
4. 宗教知识与社文环境密切相关
5. 伊克巴尔关于社会文化变迁对宗教科学影响的论述影响了"收缩与扩张"理论
6. "回归自我"理论指导伊斯兰社会对抗社会自我异化
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将知识社会学引入伊斯兰思想研究框架
2. 建立社会文化因素与知识形成的理论联系
3. 发展宗教知识的社会嵌入性理论
4. 为"收缩与扩张"理论提供思想基础
5. 提出"回归自我"作为对抗社会异化的认识论策略
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为理解伊斯兰社会中的知识变迁提供分析框架
2. 指导伊斯兰社会在现代化过程中保持文化自信
3. 为宗教改革和社会变革提供认识论基础
4. 帮助应对社会自我异化问题
5. 促进伊斯兰思想与现代知识社会学的对话

title: Counterproductive FAA Inspection Mandates on Small Aircraft

detail.title: Counterproductive FAA Inspection Mandates on Small Aircraft

declarations.declarationOfInterest: no conflicts of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: no ethical concerns
declarations.funderStatement: no external funding

detail.abstract: Since 1957, the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has required annual inspections for all civil aircraft, including small piston aircraft. This segment currently comprises approximately 170,000 aircraft, with aggregate inspection costs of roughly $500 million per year. Using NTSB accident data, we can infer that both aircraft flying activity and accident rates were higher after inspections. Importantly, relative mechanical accident rates remained stable late in the inspection cycle. This suggests that the annual inspection mandate for small piston aircraft may impose substantial costs without corresponding safety benefits.

AI.tldr: FAA自1957年起要求小型活塞飞机每年检查，年成本约5亿美元，但数据显示检查后飞行活动和事故率反而上升，机械事故率在检查周期后期保持稳定，表明年度检查可能成本高昂但安全效益有限。
AI.research_question: 联邦航空管理局对小活塞飞机的年度强制检查规定是否有效提升了飞行安全？
AI.motivation: 小型活塞飞机年度检查每年耗费约5亿美元，但缺乏实证证据证明其安全效益，需要评估这一长期政策的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管经济学、安全监管有效性理论、成本效益分析框架
AI.method: 使用NTSB事故数据进行分析，比较检查前后的飞行活动和事故率变化，特别关注机械事故率在检查周期内的变化模式
AI.findings: 1. 检查后飞行活动和事故率反而更高；2. 机械事故率在检查周期后期保持稳定；3. 年度检查可能未带来预期的安全改善
AI.theory_contributions: 对航空安全监管政策的实证评估提供了新视角，挑战了传统"更多检查=更安全"的假设，为监管政策效果评估提供方法论参考
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为FAA政策修订提供实证依据；2. 建议重新评估年度检查频率和内容；3. 可能节省小型飞机运营成本；4. 为其他航空安全监管政策提供借鉴

title: Rethinking Microfinance: Why It Falls Short in Reducing Inequality in Latin America and Africa-and the Policy Reforms Needed to Fix It
affiliations: Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics, Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics, Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics and Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics

detail.title: Rethinking Microfinance: Why It Falls Short in Reducing Inequality in Latin America and Africa-and the Policy Reforms Needed to Fix It

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no financial or personal relationships with other people or organizations that could have inappropriately influenced, or be perceived to have influenced, the research presented in this study.

publicationDetails.detailsText: This paper has not appeared on any publications site or even has been accepted to appear as well.

detail.abstract: Microfinancing is a policy designed to provide small loans to individuals who typically cannot access formal banking services. This paper explains the idea in a simple way, showing how microfinance tries to reduce problems like unemployment, poverty, gender inequality, and financial exclusion. It also looks at how microfinance has helped in regions like Latin America, where credit supports agriculture, and Africa, where it supports exports of textiles, coffee, and cocoa. At the same time, the paper highlights the major difficulties of microfinancing, including low financial literacy, high operational costs, and slow bureaucratic systems that reduce efficiency. The paper suggests solutions such as improving financial literacy through local workers and NGOs, reducing unnecessary layers of management, and using digital tools similar to India's UPI system to increase transparency and accountability. However, the counterargument shows that deeper macro-level problems-like corrupt leadership and chronic capitalism-still limit the success of microfinance. The paper concludes that microfinancing is helpful but not perfect, and it needs more improvements before it can truly achieve financial equality.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文探讨了小额信贷作为向无法获得正规银行服务的个人提供小额贷款的政策。文章以简单方式解释了小额信贷如何试图减少失业、贫困、性别不平等和金融排斥等问题，分析了其在拉丁美洲和非洲等地区的应用案例，同时指出了小额信贷面临的主要挑战，包括金融素养低、运营成本高和官僚体系效率低下，并提出了改进建议。
AI.research_question: 小额信贷如何有效解决失业、贫困、性别不平等和金融排斥等问题？它在不同地区的应用效果如何？面临哪些主要挑战？如何改进才能更好地实现金融平等？
AI.motivation: 小额信贷作为一种重要的金融包容性工具，旨在为无法获得正规银行服务的个人提供金融服务。然而，尽管小额信贷在全球范围内得到推广，但其实际效果受到多种因素制约。了解小额信贷的潜力、局限性和改进方向对于实现金融平等至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融包容性理论、贫困缓解理论、性别平等理论、制度经济学理论。论文从金融排斥的角度分析小额信贷的作用，同时考虑制度效率、金融素养等影响因素。
AI.method: 描述性分析方法和案例研究方法。论文通过解释小额信贷的基本概念，分析拉丁美洲（农业信贷）和非洲（纺织品、咖啡、可可出口支持）的具体应用案例，同时识别系统性挑战。
AI.findings:
1. 小额信贷在拉丁美洲支持农业发展，在非洲支持出口导向产业
2. 主要挑战包括：金融素养低、运营成本高、官僚体系效率低下
3. 深层宏观问题如腐败领导和慢性资本主义限制了小额信贷的成功
4. 小额信贷有帮助但不够完善，需要进一步改进
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提供了小额信贷在不同地区应用效果的比较分析框架
2. 识别了影响小额信贷有效性的多层次因素（微观金融素养、中观运营效率、宏观制度环境）
3. 强调了金融包容性政策需要与制度环境相匹配的理论观点
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提出通过当地工作人员和NGO提高金融素养的具体方案
2. 建议减少管理层级以提高运营效率
3. 推荐采用类似印度UPI系统的数字工具增加透明度和问责制
4. 为政策制定者提供了改进小额信贷系统的实用建议

title: An Assessment of the Impacts of Urbanisation on Food Security in Western Uganda: A Remote Sensing and GIS Approach
affiliations: Suzhou University of Science & Technology, Suzhou University of Science & Technology and Suzhou University of Science & Technology

detail.title: An Assessment of the Impacts of Urbanisation on Food Security in Western Uganda: A Remote Sensing and GIS Approach
detail.abstract: Rapid urbanisation in Uganda has led to significant changes in land use, particularly the conversion of agricultural land into urban settlements and infrastructure, posing challenges for ensuring a consistent food supply. Additionally, the lack of comprehensive data on the spatial dynamics of urban growth and its impact on food systems hinders effective policy formulation. Therefore, this study aims to comprehensively assess the impacts of urbanisation on food security in western Uganda using remote sensing and GIS approaches. It was found that agricultural land slightly decreased in both Kamwenge and Isingiro districts between 2000 and 2010. However, there was a drastic and sharp reduction in agricultural land between 2010 and 2020 due to increasing rates of urbanisation. Key indicators include population growth, increasing population densities, industrialisation, urban sprawl, and infrastructural development. The analysis revealed that urbanisation has contributed to increased food insecurity, characterized by a high prevalence of food deserts and limited opportunities for urban agriculture. These findings have significant implications for urban planning and food systems within the region and the country at large, given that agriculture is crucial for the economy and the survival of its people. The shrinking availability of fertile land directly threatens agricultural productivity, raising concerns about the long-term sustainability of food security in Uganda. By examining patterns of land-use change and their implications for agricultural sustainability, this research will provide valuable insights into how urbanisation affects food production, availability, and access in Uganda. The findings will serve as a basis for developing strategies that balance urban growth with the need to safeguard food security in the face of rapid demographic and environmental shifts.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用遥感和GIS方法评估了乌干达西部城市化对粮食安全的影响，发现2010-2020年间农业用地急剧减少，城市化导致粮食不安全加剧，表现为食物荒漠增多和城市农业机会有限。
AI.research_question: 城市化如何影响乌干达西部的粮食安全？具体来说，城市化导致的土地利用变化如何影响粮食生产、可获得性和可及性？
AI.motivation: 乌干达快速城市化导致农业用地转为城市用地，威胁粮食供应稳定性，但缺乏关于城市增长空间动态及其对粮食系统影响的全面数据，阻碍了有效政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市化与粮食安全关系理论，土地利用变化理论，农业可持续性理论，食物荒漠概念，城市农业理论。
AI.method: 使用遥感和地理信息系统（GIS）方法，分析2000-2020年期间Kamwenge和Isingiro地区的土地利用变化，特别是农业用地向城市用地的转化。
AI.findings: 1. 2000-2010年间农业用地略有减少；2. 2010-2020年间农业用地急剧减少；3. 城市化导致粮食不安全加剧，表现为食物荒漠增多和城市农业机会有限；4. 人口增长、人口密度增加、工业化、城市扩张和基础设施发展是关键驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为发展中国家城市化与粮食安全关系提供了实证证据；2. 揭示了城市化不同阶段对农业用地影响的差异模式；3. 丰富了食物荒漠理论在非洲城市化背景下的应用；4. 深化了对土地利用变化与农业可持续性关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为乌干达城市规划和粮食系统政策制定提供数据支持；2. 揭示了农业用地减少对粮食安全的直接威胁；3. 为平衡城市增长与粮食安全保障提供策略基础；4. 对类似快速城市化的发展中国家具有借鉴意义。

title: Job Insecurity, Equilibrium Determinacy and E-Stability in a New Keynesian Model with Asymmetric Information. Theory and Simulation Analysis
affiliations: and Italian National Research Council - Institute for Studies on the Mediterranean (CNR ISMed)

detail.title: Job Insecurity, Equilibrium Determinacy and E-Stability in a New Keynesian Model with Asymmetric Information. Theory and Simulation Analysis
detail.abstract: Departing from the dominant approach focused on individual and meso-level determinants, this manuscript develops a macroeconomic formalization of job insecurity within a New Keynesian framework in which the block formed by the dynamic IS curve, New Keynesian Phillips curve, and Taylor rule equations is augmented with labor-market frictions. The model features partially informed private agents who receive a noisy signal about economic fundamentals from a fully informed public sector. When monetary policy satisfies the Taylor principle, the equilibrium is unique and determinate. However, the release of news about current or future fundamentals can still generate a form of "Paradox of Transparency" through general-equilibrium interactions between aggregate demand and monetary policy. When the Taylor principle is violated, belief-driven equilibria may emerge. Validation exercises based on the Simulated Method of Moments confirm the empirical plausibility of the model's key implications.

AI.tldr: 该研究在宏观经济学框架下形式化工作不安全感，将劳动市场摩擦纳入新凯恩斯模型，分析货币政策透明度与工作不安全感之间的悖论关系。
AI.research_question: 在宏观经济框架下，货币政策透明度如何通过一般均衡机制影响工作不安全感？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注个体和中观层面的工作不安全感决定因素，缺乏宏观经济层面的形式化分析，特别是货币政策透明度与工作不安全感之间的复杂关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新凯恩斯主义框架，包含动态IS曲线、新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线、泰勒规则方程，并加入劳动市场摩擦；部分知情私人部门与完全知情公共部门的信息不对称模型。
AI.method: 宏观经济建模与形式化分析，采用模拟矩方法进行实证验证。
AI.findings: 当货币政策满足泰勒原则时，均衡是唯一确定的，但关于当前或未来基本面的新闻发布仍可通过总需求与货币政策的一般均衡互动产生"透明度悖论"；当泰勒原则被违反时，可能出现信念驱动的均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在宏观经济框架下形式化工作不安全感，揭示了货币政策透明度与工作不安全感之间的悖论关系，扩展了新凯恩斯模型在劳动市场分析中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于货币政策透明度与劳动市场稳定之间权衡的理论依据，有助于设计更有效的宏观经济稳定政策。

title: Quiet Failures, Loud Consequences

detail.title: Quiet Failures, Loud Consequences

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The Author declares no known competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human subjects, clinical trials, or identifiable private data and therefore did not require institutional ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: The Author received no external financial support for this research.

detail.abstract: In complex, high-risk institutions, failures are frequently attributed to individual error despite extensive evidence that organizational outcomes are shaped primarily by system design. This paper examines how institutions misdiagnose risk by focusing on human performance rather than structural conditions such as documentation integrity, communication pathways, and accountability architecture. Using healthcare as a representative high-reliability environment alongside parallels from aviation, public administration, and safety science the analysis reframes quiet operational breakdowns as governance failures rather than isolated mistakes. The paper argues that institutional resilience depends on treating documentation, escalation, and workflow design as risk controls, not administrative byproducts. This reframing has implications for compliance strategy, leadership accountability, and equitable risk prevention across regulated sectors.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了高风险机构如何错误地将失败归因于个人错误而非系统设计问题，主张将文档完整性、沟通路径和问责架构视为风险控制而非行政副产品，以提升组织韧性。
AI.research_question: 高风险机构如何误诊风险，将失败归因于个人错误而非系统设计问题？如何通过重构文档、沟通和问责架构来提升组织韧性？
AI.motivation: 在复杂高风险机构中，失败常被归咎于个人错误，但有充分证据表明组织结果主要由系统设计决定。这种误诊导致无法解决根本的结构性问题，影响组织韧性和安全性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高可靠性组织理论、系统安全理论、组织韧性理论、问责架构理论、风险治理理论
AI.method: 跨部门比较分析：以医疗保健作为代表性高可靠性环境，同时借鉴航空、公共管理和安全科学领域的案例进行对比分析
AI.findings: 1. 机构常将操作故障误诊为个人错误而非治理失败；2. 文档完整性、沟通路径和问责架构是风险控制的关键要素；3. 将系统设计视为行政副产品而非风险控制会削弱组织韧性
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出将"安静的操作故障"重新定义为治理失败而非孤立错误的理论框架；2. 扩展了高可靠性组织理论，强调系统设计作为风险控制的核心作用；3. 发展了问责架构理论在风险治理中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为合规策略提供新视角：将文档、升级和工作流设计视为风险控制；2. 强调领导层对系统设计的问责责任；3. 为监管行业提供更公平的风险预防方法；4. 帮助机构从个人归因转向系统改进

title: Stuck at Home: The Impact of the Pandemic on Urban Housing Markets
affiliations: Xiamen University - School of Economics, Xiamen University and Xiamen University

detail.title: Stuck at Home: The Impact of the Pandemic on Urban Housing Markets
detail.abstract: This study employs a spatial difference-in-differences approach to identify the causal effects of pandemic outbreaks and community lockdowns on housing markets within the city. We find that housing prices within 2 km of the outbreak center fell by about 5% relative to more distant areas and that lockdowns produced an additional 1.5% decline in affected communities, with both effects persisting for several years. Mechanism evidence indicates a shift in demand toward higher-floor units and larger living spaces, accompanied by more frequent seller price adjustments. Moreover, the pandemic substantially reduced consumption of amenities—particularly shopping and restaurants—while increasing demand in the sports-related leisure and public-service sectors in affected communities.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用空间双重差分法，发现疫情爆发和社区封锁对城市住房市场有显著负面影响：疫情中心2公里内房价下降约5%，封锁导致额外1.5%下跌，且影响持续数年。机制分析显示需求向高楼层、大户型转移，卖家调价更频繁，同时疫情改变了社区消费模式。
AI.research_question: 疫情爆发和社区封锁对城市住房市场有何因果影响？这些影响通过什么机制发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情对城市经济和居民生活产生了深远影响，但疫情和防控措施对住房市场的具体因果效应尚不明确，需要实证研究来揭示其影响机制和持久性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于空间经济学和住房市场理论，结合公共卫生事件对居民行为偏好的影响机制，分析疫情风险感知如何改变住房需求和消费模式。
AI.method: 采用空间双重差分法（Spatial Difference-in-Differences），通过比较疫情中心附近区域与较远区域、封锁社区与非封锁社区的住房市场表现，识别因果效应。
AI.findings: 1. 疫情中心2公里内房价相对下降约5%；2. 社区封锁导致额外1.5%下跌；3. 两种效应均持续数年；4. 需求向高楼层、大户型转移；5. 卖家调价更频繁；6. 疫情减少购物餐饮消费，增加体育休闲和公共服务需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统量化疫情和封锁对住房市场的空间异质性影响；2. 揭示了公共卫生危机通过改变居民空间偏好影响住房市场的机制；3. 拓展了灾害经济学在住房市场中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者评估疫情防控措施的经济成本提供依据；2. 帮助房地产开发商和投资者理解疫情后的市场趋势；3. 为城市规划者调整社区设施配置提供参考。

title: Decomposition of Post-Pandemic Gender Wage Gaps in Indonesia: an Analysis Across the Wage Distribution

detail.title: Decomposition of Post-Pandemic Gender Wage Gaps in Indonesia: an Analysis Across the Wage Distribution
detail.abstract: This study examines post-pandemic gender wage gaps in Indonesia using SAKERNAS data from 2018 to 2023. OLS and RIF-OLS regression results indicate that gender wage gaps widened postpandemic, with female employees earning 30 percent less than their male counterparts on average, narrowing to 23 percent after controlling for wage-related characteristics. The gap is most pronounced among low-paid workers, where women earned 40 to 50 percent less than men. Decomposition analysis across the wage distribution reveals that the majority of the gap is driven by unexplained factors, reinforcing the persistence of the "sticky floor" and "glass ceiling" effects, indicative of on going gender discrimination in the labor market. While factors such as lower work experience, tenure, and working hours contributed to the gap, women's higher educational attainment, increased formal sector participation, access to training, and representation in white-collar jobs helped mitigate it.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用2018-2023年SAKERNAS数据分析了印尼疫情后的性别工资差距。结果显示疫情后性别工资差距扩大，女性平均比男性少赚30%，控制相关特征后缩小至23%。差距在低收入群体中最大（女性少赚40-50%）。分解分析表明大部分差距由不可解释因素驱动，体现了"粘性地板"和"玻璃天花板"效应，表明劳动力市场存在持续性别歧视。
AI.research_question: 疫情后印尼劳动力市场的性别工资差距状况如何？这种差距在不同工资分布区间有何差异？哪些因素解释或加剧了性别工资差距？
AI.motivation: 疫情对劳动力市场产生了深远影响，可能加剧了已有的性别不平等。了解疫情后印尼性别工资差距的变化趋势、分布特征及其驱动因素，对于制定促进性别平等的政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论（解释可观察特征差异）、歧视理论（解释不可解释的差距）、"粘性地板"效应（低收入群体中的性别差距）、"玻璃天花板"效应（高收入群体中的晋升障碍）。
AI.method: 使用印尼国家劳动力调查（SAKERNAS）2018-2023年数据，采用OLS回归和RIF-OLS回归分析整体差距，通过分解分析（如Oaxaca-Blinder或分位数分解）探究工资分布不同区间的差距来源。
AI.findings: 1. 疫情后性别工资差距扩大，女性平均工资比男性低30%，控制特征后为23%；2. 低收入群体差距最大（40-50%）；3. 大部分差距由不可解释因素驱动，表明存在歧视；4. 女性较低的工作经验、任期和工作时间加剧差距，但更高的教育水平、正规部门参与、培训机会和白领工作有助于缩小差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了疫情背景下"粘性地板"和"玻璃天花板"效应的持续性；2. 提供了发展中国家疫情后性别工资差距的实证证据；3. 深化了对工资分布不同区间性别差距驱动因素的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为印尼政府制定性别平等政策提供依据；2. 建议关注低收入女性群体的工资歧视问题；3. 强调通过提高女性工作经验、任期和工作参与来缩小差距；4. 支持继续投资女性教育和职业培训。

title:
The Structural Defect Framework (SDF): A Dual-Arm Theory of Designed-In Harms

Transmission, Proxy Records, and the Life Cycle of Legal Evidence

detail.title:
The Structural Defect Framework (SDF): A Dual-Arm Theory of Designed-In Harms

Transmission, Proxy Records, and the Life Cycle of Legal Evidence

keywords: The Lifecycle Engine: Information Architecture III
Dual-Arm System: Transmissive And Proxy Defects IV

detail.abstract:
Legal theory treats evidence as a static noun: a "record," a "fact," a "file." But modern systems show evidence behaves more like a decaying verb—a signal that loses fidelity as it moves through constrained channels, institutional proxies, and record architectures. This Article integrates Claude Shannon's mathematical theory of communication with a lifecycle analysis of how legally relevant information degrades as it travels from reality to artifacts to decisions. The result is the Structural Defect Framework (SDF): a unified diagnostic that identifies two distinct arms of liability. Transmissive (T-Arm) defects arise when a bounded artifact is technically degraded through hidden fidelity knobs while outward equivalence is maintained. Proxy (P-Arm) defects arise when an institutional decision signal is structurally constituted through proxies and records without sufficient fidelity to verify whether compliance standards were met.

SDF operates differently depending on the actor. For private actors—corporations, platforms, employers—it functions as a liability framework, grounding tort, and statutory claims where designed-in fidelity loss produces foreseeable harm under structural opacity. For state actors—courts, police, administrative agencies—it functions as an evidentiary and appellate framework, supporting reversal, suppression, or adverse inference where institutional architectures cannot verify compliance with their own compliance baselines.

The Article argues that many modern controversies—from AI reasoning collapse to employment discrimination to hollowed victims’ rights—share a common mechanism: informational entropy moving through a legal lifecycle. By bridging information theory and due process, SDF attempts to identify architectures that produce foreseeable harm while making verification unavailable at the moment of reliance. It then operationalizes that diagnostic with matched proof chains and explicit defeaters, moving the debate from abstract ethics to concrete architectural accountability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出结构性缺陷框架(SDF)，将香农信息论与法律证据生命周期分析结合，将证据视为衰减信号而非静态事实。SDF识别两种缺陷：传输缺陷（技术保真度损失）和代理缺陷（制度决策信号构成不足），为私人和国家行为者提供不同的责任框架。
AI.research_question: 如何将信息论原理应用于法律证据分析，以识别和解决现代法律系统中证据信息衰减导致的系统性缺陷？
AI.motivation: 传统法律理论将证据视为静态名词（记录、事实、文件），但现代系统显示证据更像是衰减的动词——信号在通过受限渠道、制度代理和记录架构时会失去保真度。许多现代争议（从AI推理崩溃到就业歧视）共享共同机制：信息熵在法律生命周期中的移动。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 克劳德·香农的数学通信理论
2. 法律证据的生命周期分析
3. 结构性缺陷框架(SDF)：包含传输缺陷(T-Arm)和代理缺陷(P-Arm)
4. 信息论与正当程序理论的结合
AI.method: 理论整合方法：将香农信息论与法律证据的生命周期分析相结合，构建统一诊断框架。通过分析信息从现实到人工制品再到决策的传输过程，识别系统性缺陷。
AI.findings:
1. 证据应被理解为衰减信号而非静态事实
2. 结构性缺陷分为两类：传输缺陷（技术保真度损失）和代理缺陷（制度决策信号构成不足）
3. SDF对不同行为者作用不同：对私人行为者作为责任框架，对国家行为者作为证据和上诉框架
4. 许多现代法律争议共享信息熵机制
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出结构性缺陷框架(SDF)，统一诊断法律系统中的信息衰减问题
2. 将信息论原理系统性地引入法律证据分析
3. 重新概念化证据为动态衰减过程而非静态实体
4. 建立信息论与正当程序之间的理论桥梁
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为私人行为者（公司、平台、雇主）提供责任框架，支持侵权和法定索赔
2. 为国家行为者（法院、警察、行政机构）提供证据和上诉框架，支持逆转、排除或不利推断
3. 将抽象伦理辩论转化为具体的架构问责制
4. 提供匹配的证明链和明确的反驳机制

title: Competition, Productivity, and Labor Law in Latin America: Informality, Regulatory Distortions, and the Role of Labor Compliance

detail.title: Competition, Productivity, and Labor Law in Latin America: Informality, Regulatory Distortions, and the Role of Labor Compliance

keywords: Latin America Table of Contents: 1. Introduction. 2. Competition
and Labor Markets in Latin America. 3. Small Firms
and Informality Traps. 4. Selective Rigidity vs. Smart Protection in Labor Regulation. 5. Market Concentration
and Labor Outcomes. 7. Labor Compliance as a Tool for Regulatory and Competitive Efficiency. 8

detail.abstract: Latin America exhibits persistent structural weaknesses characterized by low competition, high market concentration in key sectors, limited firm growth dynamics, and a disproportionately large share of small and low-productivity enterprises. These features significantly shape the functioning of labor markets across the region. They suppress wage growth, restrict labor mobility, discourage innovation, and reinforce chronic informality. Building on recent economic evidence on competition and productivity in Latin America, this paper bridges the economic debate with labor regulation. It examines how selective regulatory rigidity, distorted incentives, tax and credit privileges, regulatory capture, and incomplete institutional environments contribute to inefficiency in labor allocation and reduced productivity growth. The analysis also explores how weak competition fails to generate the expected positive labor outcomes typically observed in advanced economies, including better wages, skill upgrading, and technological diffusion. The paper further evaluates the role of Labor Compliance as a governance tool capable of improving institutional reliability, strengthening competitive neutrality, supporting legal certainty, and promoting fair and efficient labor practices. Finally, it proposes a pragmatic, evidence-based reform agenda aimed at enhancing productivity, improving employment quality, and fostering a more competitive and inclusive labor environment in Latin America.

AI.tldr: 拉丁美洲存在结构性弱点：低竞争、高市场集中度、企业增长受限、小型低生产率企业占比过大。这些特征抑制工资增长、限制劳动力流动、阻碍创新、强化非正规就业。本文探讨监管刚性、扭曲激励、税收信贷特权、监管俘获等如何导致劳动力配置低效和生产率增长放缓，并提出基于证据的改革议程。
AI.research_question: 拉丁美洲的结构性弱点（低竞争、高市场集中度、企业增长受限）如何影响劳动力市场功能？选择性监管刚性、扭曲激励、税收信贷特权、监管俘获等如何导致劳动力配置低效和生产率增长放缓？劳工合规作为治理工具如何改善制度可靠性、竞争中立性和劳动力实践？
AI.motivation: 拉丁美洲存在持续的结构性弱点，包括低竞争、关键部门高市场集中度、有限的企业增长动态，以及小型低生产率企业占比过大。这些特征显著影响劳动力市场功能，抑制工资增长、限制劳动力流动、阻碍创新、强化非正规就业。需要将经济竞争与生产率讨论与劳动力监管联系起来，探索如何改善劳动力配置效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争与生产率理论、劳动力市场经济学、制度经济学、监管经济学、治理理论。结合拉丁美洲竞争与生产率的近期经济证据，将经济辩论与劳动力监管联系起来。
AI.method: 基于现有经济证据的分析性研究，探讨结构性因素与劳动力市场结果之间的关系。分析选择性监管刚性、扭曲激励、税收信贷特权、监管俘获、不完全制度环境对劳动力配置效率的影响。评估劳工合规作为治理工具的作用。
AI.findings: 拉丁美洲的结构性弱点显著抑制劳动力市场功能：1）低竞争未能产生发达经济体预期的积极劳动力结果（更好工资、技能提升、技术扩散）；2）选择性监管刚性、扭曲激励、税收信贷特权、监管俘获等导致劳动力配置低效和生产率增长放缓；3）不完全制度环境加剧了这些问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将拉丁美洲竞争与生产率的经济辩论与劳动力监管联系起来；2）分析结构性弱点如何影响劳动力市场功能的理论框架；3）提出劳工合规作为改善制度可靠性、竞争中立性和劳动力实践的治理工具的理论视角；4）为理解监管环境与劳动力市场结果之间的关系提供理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提出务实的、基于证据的改革议程，旨在提高生产率、改善就业质量；2）建议通过劳工合规加强制度可靠性、竞争中立性、法律确定性；3）促进更竞争性和包容性的劳动力环境；4）为政策制定者提供改善劳动力市场功能的实用建议。
