title: Time versus Money: The Willingness to Exchange Membership Fees and Volunteering in Dutch Sport Clubs

detail.title: Time versus Money: The Willingness to Exchange Membership Fees and Volunteering in Dutch Sport Clubs
detail.abstract: Amidst declining subsidies and volunteer shortages, clubs are exploring if labor shortages can be solved by financial buy-outs, or financial deficits by increased volunteering. Drawing on the labor-leisure trade-off model and social exchange theory, this research analyzes data from 3,723 members of Dutch voluntary sports clubs (mainly tennis and volleyball). Using ordinal and binary logistic regressions, the study identifies a significant socioeconomic divide. Results support the economic trade-off hypothesis: members with higher household incomes are significantly more willing to pay increased fees to avoid volunteering (the 'buyout' option). Conversely, members with lower incomes are more willing to perform more volunteer work in exchange for lower fees. However, this economic rationality is not universal; members with high club satisfaction and current volunteers generally resist these trade-offs, preferring the status quo. The findings suggest that while monetizing volunteer duties is a viable strategy for affluent segments, it may risk undermining the social cohesion and reciprocity central to the associative nature of voluntary sport clubs.

AI.tldr: 研究荷兰体育俱乐部发现：高收入会员愿意支付更高会费来避免志愿服务，低收入会员则愿意通过更多志愿服务换取更低会费，但俱乐部满意度高的会员和现有志愿者倾向于维持现状，货币化志愿服务可能损害俱乐部社会凝聚力。
AI.research_question: 体育俱乐部能否通过财务买断解决劳动力短缺，或通过增加志愿服务解决财务赤字？不同社会经济背景的会员对"付费免服务"和"服务换折扣"的接受度如何？
AI.motivation: 补贴下降和志愿者短缺背景下，俱乐部面临运营困境，需要探索财务与志愿服务之间的替代方案，但需考虑不同会员群体的反应及其对俱乐部社会结构的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动-闲暇权衡模型（经济理性选择）和社会交换理论（社会互惠关系）
AI.method: 对3,723名荷兰体育俱乐部（主要是网球和排球）会员进行有序逻辑回归和二元逻辑回归分析
AI.findings: 显著的社会经济分化：高收入家庭会员更愿意支付更高会费避免志愿服务（"买断"选项），低收入会员更愿意通过更多志愿服务换取更低会费；但俱乐部满意度高的会员和现有志愿者普遍抵制这些权衡，偏好维持现状
AI.theory_contributions: 将经济理性选择理论与社会交换理论结合，揭示了志愿组织中的社会经济分层现象，挑战了"一刀切"的解决方案，强调组织认同和社会互惠对成员决策的调节作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为俱乐部管理者提供差异化策略：对富裕会员可采用货币化方案，但对低收入会员和核心志愿者需维护社会互惠机制；警告过度货币化可能损害俱乐部社会凝聚力，建议平衡经济需求与社会价值

title: Data Intermediaries & Open Government Data An Examination of the Use of Open Data by Canadian Data Intermediaries

detail.title: Data Intermediaries & Open Government Data An Examination of the Use of Open Data by Canadian Data Intermediaries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I confirm that no personal or financial ties exist with individuals or organizations that could have affected this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was received from the University of Ottawa Ethics Board.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported in part by the University of Ottawa’s scholarship program

detail.abstract: Data intermediaries are considered an essential element in the open government data ecosystem. Canada is a leading member of the Open Government Partnership and has been active in applying the partnership principles, including the opening, and releasing of government data in an open, machine-readable format for re-use by the public. It has been ten years since Canada started opening and releasing its data; however, no study has been done on the users and uses of the published data. This paper reports on a sample of 17 data intermediaries operating in Canada, uncovering their status, profile, and work using open and non-open data. It also identifies the products/services created and the target industry/customers. The paper classifies three types of intermediaries: custom-made solutions builders, data services providers, and application software developers. It also identifies four performed functions: aggregators, enablers, suppliers, and developers. Additionally, the paper documents the data type the intermediaries use to develop their products/services, as well as the challenges intermediaries face in establishing their organizations, securing funds, and sourcing the data. The paper concludes by providing four insights and recommendations for additional work on the part of government to increase the awareness of open government data in Canada and create or modify programs to cater to the needs of data intermediaries.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了加拿大17个数据中介机构，分析了它们使用开放和非开放数据的情况、产品服务类型、目标行业以及面临的挑战，并提出了政府支持建议。
AI.research_question: 加拿大开放政府数据生态系统中的数据中介机构有哪些类型？它们如何运作、使用什么数据、面临什么挑战？
AI.motivation: 加拿大作为开放政府伙伴关系的领先成员，已开放数据十年，但缺乏对数据使用者和使用情况的研究，特别是对数据中介机构的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放政府数据生态系统理论，数据中介机构在数据价值链中的角色理论，以及数据中介机构的分类框架。
AI.method: 对17个在加拿大运营的数据中介机构进行样本研究，采用定性分析方法，收集关于其状态、概况、工作方式、数据使用、产品服务、目标客户等信息。
AI.findings: 识别了三种数据中介类型：定制解决方案构建者、数据服务提供商、应用软件开发者和四种功能：聚合者、赋能者、供应者、开发者。记录了使用的数据类型以及面临的挑战（组织建立、资金获取、数据源获取）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了加拿大数据中介机构的分类框架（三种类型和四种功能），丰富了开放政府数据生态系统中中介机构的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加拿大政府提供了四项具体建议：提高开放政府数据意识、创建或修改项目以满足数据中介需求，帮助政府更好地支持数据中介机构发展。

title: Social Media Sponsored Content and Organic Word-of-Mouth: Interaction Effects in E-Commerce Platforms

detail.title: Social Media Sponsored Content and Organic Word-of-Mouth: Interaction Effects in E-Commerce Platforms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest related to this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: All research reported in this study adhered to the ethical guidelines for human subjects as outlined in the Declaration of Helsinki. Participants provided informed consent, and all data were obtained either from publicly available sources or with explicit permission.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted without institutional funding. Total research expenditure was $351.75, covering participant compensation via CloudResearch Connect. All analytical software utilized open-source tools (Python, R, JASP) or free trials (ATLAS.ti, Canva Pro). Data collection adhered to ethical guidelines for unfunded research.

detail.abstract: The​‍​‌‍​‍‌​‍​‌‍​‍‌ rise of social commerce has blurred the lines between differently paid content and pure organic word-of-mouth (WOM), which has led to consumer decision environments becoming more complex. This mixed-methods research explores the moderating effects of the interaction between the type of content (sponsored vs. organic) and the source of recommendation (influencer vs. peer) on purchase intentions within e-commerce platforms. The first study used thematic content analysis for 647 product review videos and 3,235 comments from TikTok Shop, Instagram Shopping, and YouTube Shopping, revealing different persuasion tactics and engagement patterns. Study 2 examined the predicted relationships through a 2×2 between-subjects online experiment (N = 387 U.S. adults) and found that source credibility and perceived authenticity mediate the relationship between content type and purchase intention, while consumer skepticism moderates these effects. Study 3 combined survey data (N = 112) with behavioral indicators from public datasets and through structural equation modeling, it confirmed the experimental findings. The results suggest that organic content from peers leads to higher purchase intentions than sponsored content from influencers. However, high-credibility influencers can still overcome skepticism if the disclosure is transparent. Theoretical contributions extend source credibility theory and the persuasion knowledge model to digital contexts, while practical implications help platform designers and marketers to be more effective in their content strategies. This work fills in very important gaps related to understanding authenticity perceptions and disclosure effects in the latest social commerce ​‍​‌‍​‍‌​‍​‌‍​‍‌ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了社交商务中内容类型（赞助vs有机）与推荐来源（网红vs同伴）对购买意愿的交互影响，发现同伴的有机内容比网红的赞助内容更能促进购买，但高可信度的网红在透明披露下仍能克服消费者怀疑。
AI.research_question: 内容类型（赞助vs有机）与推荐来源（网红vs同伴）的交互作用如何影响消费者在电商平台上的购买意愿？
AI.motivation: 社交商务的兴起模糊了付费内容和纯有机口碑之间的界限，使消费者决策环境变得更加复杂，需要理解不同内容和来源组合的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 来源可信度理论、说服知识模型、真实性感知理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究：研究1对TikTok Shop、Instagram Shopping和YouTube Shopping的647个产品评测视频和3,235条评论进行主题内容分析；研究2采用2×2被试间在线实验（N=387美国成人）；研究3结合调查数据（N=112）和公共数据集行为指标，使用结构方程模型验证。
AI.findings: 1. 同伴的有机内容比网红的赞助内容产生更高的购买意愿；2. 来源可信度和感知真实性中介内容类型与购买意愿的关系；3. 消费者怀疑调节这些效应；4. 高可信度的网红在透明披露下仍能克服怀疑。
AI.theory_contributions: 将来源可信度理论和说服知识模型扩展到数字环境，填补了社交商务生态系统中真实性感知和披露效应理解的重要空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助平台设计者和营销人员更有效地制定内容策略，强调了透明披露的重要性，以及在不同内容和来源组合中管理消费者怀疑的策略。

title: "Revitalizing Coastal Aquaculture: A Cluster-Based Improved Traditional Farming Model for Sustainable Tiger Shrimp (Penaeus monodon) Production in Dumuria, Khulna"

detail.title: "Revitalizing Coastal Aquaculture: A Cluster-Based Improved Traditional Farming Model for Sustainable Tiger Shrimp (Penaeus monodon) Production in Dumuria, Khulna"
detail.abstract: Shrimp aquaculture in Bangladesh faces persistent productivity and sustainability challenges due to disease outbreaks, poor management, and limited access to quality inputs. This study evaluated the biological performance, economic viability, and sustainability of a cluster-based improved traditional farming model for Penaeus monodon introduced under the Sustainable Coastal and Marine Fisheries Project (SCMFP) in Dumuria Upazila, Khulna. Two pilot clusters covering 4,400 decimals were managed under standardized protocols for pond engineering, biosecurity, and feeding. Specific Pathogen-Free (SPF) post-larvae were stocked at 160 PL decimal⁻¹, and the culture period lasted 90 days. Results showed substantial improvement compared with baseline traditional systems. The survival rate increased from 20% to 70%, yield rose from 1.5 to 5.0 kg decimal⁻¹, and the feed conversion ratio (FCR) improved from 2.4 to 0.68. The average net profit reached BDT 1,782 decimal⁻¹ with a return on investment (ROI) of 72.23%, remaining profitable under ±20% yield and ±15% price variations. Water quality parameters remained within optimal ranges, and no outbreaks of White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV) or Early Mortality Syndrome (EMS) were recorded. The findings demonstrate that cluster-based improved traditional shrimp farming enhances productivity, profitability, and biosecurity while promoting environmental stability and gender-inclusive participation--offering a scalable model for sustainable coastal aquaculture in Bangladesh.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了孟加拉国杜穆里亚地区基于集群的改进传统对虾养殖模式，结果显示该模式显著提高了生存率、产量和经济效益，同时保持了环境稳定性。
AI.research_question: 基于集群的改进传统对虾养殖模式在孟加拉国能否提高生物性能、经济可行性和可持续性？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国对虾养殖面临疾病爆发、管理不善和优质投入品有限等持续的生产力和可持续性挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续水产养殖理论、集群养殖模式、生物安全协议、经济效益分析框架。
AI.method: 在杜穆里亚地区建立两个试点集群（4400十进制），采用标准化池塘工程、生物安全和饲喂协议，使用SPF虾苗（160 PL/十进制），养殖期90天，对比基线传统系统。
AI.findings: 生存率从20%提高到70%，产量从1.5增至5.0 kg/十进制，FCR从2.4改善至0.68，平均净利润1782 BDT/十进制，ROI达72.23%，水质参数保持最优范围，无WSSV或EMS爆发。
AI.theory_contributions: 为可持续水产养殖提供了集群化改进传统养殖的理论框架，验证了标准化协议在热带沿海环境中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可扩展的可持续对虾养殖模型，提高了生产力和盈利能力，增强了生物安全，促进了环境稳定性和性别包容参与，为孟加拉国沿海水产养殖提供了实用解决方案。

title: Unlock SaaS like Capabilities with Excel and Power Query

detail.title: Unlock SaaS like Capabilities with Excel and Power Query

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there is no known conflict of interest associated with the research
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve any human participants or personal data and therefore did not require ethical committee approval
declarations.funderStatement: This research is independent and has received no external funding

detail.abstract: The FP&A team today works under high pressure to deliver accurate insights faster, with expectations of real-time reporting, seamless automation, and consistent, audit-ready data models. While modern cloud-based SaaS platforms promise these capabilities, many organizations continue to rely heavily on Excel due to its familiarity, flexibility, and low implementation barriers. This dependence, however, leaves a gap between rising analytical demands and the manual, error-prone workflows traditionally associated with spreadsheets. This study explores how Microsoft Power Query fundamentally changes Excel’s role within financial operations, transforming it from a static spreadsheet tool into a lightweight, SaaS-like automation engine. Through automated data ingestion, standardized and repeatable transformation logic, and refreshable end-to-end pipelines, Power Query enables finance teams to work with greater accuracy, speed, and operational consistency. To validate this capability, we conduct empirical testing across four representative FP&A workloads (W1–W4) and three dataset scales (100k → 300k → 1M rows). Our analysis assesses refresh times, scalability, and variance across multiple runs. Results demonstrate up to a 70% reduction in manual effort, highly stable refresh performance even at larger data volumes, and the ability to replicate key SaaS characteristics without the cost, complexity, or operational disruption associated with enterprise platform migrations. These findings highlight a practical pathway for finance teams to modernize their reporting and data workflows while continuing to operate within the familiar Excel environment.

AI.tldr: Power Query将Excel从静态电子表格工具转变为轻量级自动化引擎，使财务团队能在熟悉的Excel环境中实现高达70%的手动工作量减少，并具备SaaS平台的关键特性，无需昂贵的企业平台迁移。
AI.research_question: Microsoft Power Query如何改变Excel在财务运营中的角色，将其从静态电子表格工具转变为轻量级、类似SaaS的自动化引擎？
AI.motivation: 财务规划与分析团队面临实时报告、无缝自动化和一致数据模型的高压需求，但许多组织仍依赖Excel，导致分析需求与手动、易错工作流程之间存在差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字化转型理论、技术采纳理论、工作流程自动化理论
AI.method: 实证测试：在四个代表性FP&A工作负载（W1-W4）和三个数据集规模（10万→30万→100万行）上进行分析，评估刷新时间、可扩展性和多次运行的方差。
AI.findings: 结果显示：手动工作量减少高达70%；即使在较大数据量下也能保持高度稳定的刷新性能；能够复制关键SaaS特性，而无需企业平台迁移的成本、复杂性或运营中断。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"轻量级SaaS化"概念，展示了如何在现有工具基础上实现数字化转型，而不需要完全的平台迁移；扩展了技术采纳理论在财务领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为财务团队提供了一条实用的现代化路径：在熟悉的Excel环境中实现自动化，减少70%手动工作，提高准确性和运营一致性，避免昂贵的平台迁移成本和运营中断。

title: Reach Out and Heal a Heart: Tele-ICU and Low Virtualization Care Processes
affiliations: , Donald G. Costello College of Business at George Mason University, Donald G. Costello College of Business at George Mason University and Donald G. Costello College of Business at George Mason University

detail.title: Reach Out and Heal a Heart: Tele-ICU and Low Virtualization Care Processes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: Gopukumar from Richard Richard A. Chaifetz Business School. Menon from Donald G. Costello College of Business.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Donald G. Costello College of Business at George Mason University Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Donald G. Costello College of Business at George Mason University Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Telehealth offers significant potential to improve healthcare delivery, but its benefits are context-driven. It shows clear advantages in consumer-facing, high-virtualization settings and uncertain impacts in high-stakes, tightly coupled processes like Intensive Care Unit (ICU) care. Prior IS research has examined high-virtualization telehealth, such as mental health. In these settings, patients are active agents, and self-efficacy drives outcomes. Less attention was given in the ICU context, where continuous monitoring, rapid decision-making, and coordination are critical.

In this paper, we examine tele-ICU, a telehealth technology designed to support ICU care. We use acute myocardial infarction (AMI) as a context to study a low-virtualizable care process. The AMI care process mostly begins with ICUs and requires rapid monitoring, coordination, and reliance on specialized staff. AMI care contributes significantly to hospital readmissions, targeted under the Medicare Hospital Readmission Reduction Program, underscoring their importance.

The shortage of cardiac care staff has increased interest in tele-ICU, which can extend expertise across hospitals. However, the comprehensive role of intensivists in the ICU may also affect the impact of tele-ICUs. These countervailing forces motivate our investigation. Drawing on process virtualization theory and the sociotechnical systems perspective, we develop hypotheses about the direct and interaction effects of tele-ICU, health information interchange, and closed-model cardiac intensivist use on AMI outcomes. Using panel data and a control-function approach, we find no direct effects of tele-ICU. We find strong complementarity between tele-ICU and health information interchange, and separately, between tele-ICU and intensivist staffing. Effects vary by organizational level—hospital, joint-venture, or system—highlighting ICU coordination challenges.

Our study contributes theoretically by extending virtualization theory with a sociotechnical perspective to low-virtualization care processes. It helps guide hospital administrators on when tele-ICU can improve the ICU care process. It contributes policy-wise by informing telehealth investment, integration, and post-pandemic efforts to enhance complex care.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了远程ICU在低虚拟化医疗场景（如急性心肌梗死治疗）中的效果，发现远程ICU本身无直接影响，但与健康信息交换和心脏重症医师配置存在互补效应，且效果因组织层级而异。
AI.research_question: 远程ICU技术如何影响低虚拟化医疗过程（特别是急性心肌梗死治疗）的临床结果？远程ICU与健康信息交换、心脏重症医师配置之间存在怎样的交互效应？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注高虚拟化远程医疗（如心理健康），但对ICU等高风险、紧密耦合的医疗过程关注不足。心脏护理人员短缺增加了对远程ICU的兴趣，但重症医师在ICU中的综合角色可能影响远程ICU的效果，这些矛盾力量促使本研究探索远程ICU在低虚拟化医疗过程中的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 过程虚拟化理论和社会技术系统视角。研究将社会技术视角扩展到过程虚拟化理论中，以分析低虚拟化医疗过程。
AI.method: 使用面板数据和控制函数方法，分析远程ICU、健康信息交换和封闭模式心脏重症医师使用对急性心肌梗死结果的直接效应和交互效应。
AI.findings: 1. 远程ICU本身无直接影响；2. 远程ICU与健康信息交换存在强互补性；3. 远程ICU与重症医师配置存在强互补性；4. 效应因组织层级（医院、合资企业、系统）而异，突显ICU协调挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：通过引入社会技术视角扩展了过程虚拟化理论，将其应用于低虚拟化医疗过程的分析，为理解复杂医疗环境中的技术实施提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1. 指导医院管理者了解何时远程ICU能改善ICU护理过程；2. 为远程医疗投资、整合提供政策建议；3. 为后疫情时代复杂护理改进提供参考。

title: Intelligent Threat Detection and Response Using AI in Multi-Cloud Networks

detail.title: Intelligent Threat Detection and Response Using AI in Multi-Cloud Networks

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest related to this study. All research conducted was independent and objective.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or data collected from patients. Therefore, ethics approval was not required. However, in the case of a case study, written consent was obtained from all participants involved in the study, and confidentiality was maintained throughout the research process.
