detail.abstract: This entry examines the evolving compliance framework governing retail investors in US securities markets. The overview surveys how the federal securities laws-principally the Securities Act of 1933, the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, and the Investment Advisers Act of 1940-along with SEC regulations and FINRA rules protect retail investors while fostering innovation. The entry discusses key regulatory standards including SEC Regulation Best Interest for broker-dealers and the fiduciary duties applicable to investment advisers, also examining recent enforcement trends and regulatory proposals. Additionally, this entry addresses the transformative potential of enhanced retail investor participation in corporate governance through technological innovations like corporate forums.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国证券市场零售投资者合规框架的演变，分析了主要证券法规、SEC监管和FINRA规则如何保护零售投资者并促进创新，讨论了Regulation Best Interest和投资顾问的信托责任等关键监管标准，以及技术革新如何增强零售投资者在公司治理中的参与。
AI.research_question: 美国证券市场零售投资者合规框架如何演变，以及主要证券法规、SEC监管和FINRA规则如何平衡零售投资者保护与市场创新？
AI.motivation: 随着金融市场创新和技术发展，零售投资者参与证券市场的机会增加，需要了解现有合规框架如何保护投资者权益，同时促进市场创新和投资者参与公司治理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于美国联邦证券法体系，包括1933年证券法、1934年证券交易法和1940年投资顾问法，结合SEC监管框架和FINRA自律规则，构建零售投资者保护的理论基础。
AI.method: 采用文献综述和法规分析的方法，系统梳理美国证券法规体系、SEC监管规定和FINRA规则，分析零售投资者保护框架的演变和现状。
AI.findings: 美国零售投资者保护框架通过多层次监管体系运作，SEC Regulation Best Interest为经纪商设定了行为标准，投资顾问需履行信托责任，技术革新如公司论坛增强了零售投资者在公司治理中的参与能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了美国零售投资者合规框架的理论基础，明确了不同法规在投资者保护中的角色定位，为理解证券市场监管体系提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构、金融机构和零售投资者提供了合规指引，帮助理解现有监管要求，促进投资者保护与市场创新的平衡，推动零售投资者更有效参与公司治理。

title: Soundscapes of Fashion: The Impact of Music on Consumer Behavior in Retail Environments

detail.title: Soundscapes of Fashion: The Impact of Music on Consumer Behavior in Retail Environments

declarations.ethicsApproval: All participants in this study provided informed consent prior to participating. Each participant received a written consent form outlining the purpose of the research, confidentiality protections, voluntary participation, and the option to withdraw at any time. Interviews were conducted only after participants confirmed their agreement in writing or through digital signature. Because this capstone project involved voluntary interviews with adults and did not involve medical, clinical, or vulnerable populations, institutional ethics board approval was not required under Parsons School of Design’s graduate research guidelines.

detail.abstract:
This capstone investigates the strategic role of music in fashion retail environments and its influence on consumer behavior, including purchasing decisions, brand perception, and emotional engagement. While visual merchandising is widely studies, the auditory dimension remains underutilized. (Jwu, 2024) This study explores how music tempo, brand-music alignment, and cultural resonance shape consumer experiences in subtle yet powerful ways.

A mixed-method approach was used, involving a quantitative survey of 165 respondents and 17 semi-structured qualitative interviews. Thematic analysis revealed thirteen distinct themes. Survey results showed that 60% of respondents said music influenced their time spent in-store, and 61.9% were more likely to stay longer if they enjoyed the music. Additionally, 38.8% reported that music had a strong impact on mood, and 27.3% said it sometimes affected their purchasing decisions. Cultural music fostered emotional connection, especially among diasporic shoppers, but did not necessarily drive purchases. Fast-tempo music prompted quicker decisions and impulse buy, though when paired with high volume it risked feeling repulsive. Conversely, slow-tempo music encouraged relaxed, prolonged shopping and was often associated with luxury. Music that matched a brand’s identity made the brand appear more intentional and curated, while well-selected music overall contributed to brand loyalty.

This research has both managerial and academic implications. For industry professionals, it offers actionable insights into how music can enhance brand perception, customer dwell time, and emotional engagement when aligned with identity and audience expectations. For academia, it contributes to interdisciplinary conversations across marketing, psychology, and cultural studies-positioning sound as a vital yet underutilized component of sensory branding in retail.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨音乐在时尚零售环境中的战略作用及其对消费者行为的影响，包括购买决策、品牌感知和情感参与。研究发现音乐节奏、品牌-音乐契合度和文化共鸣以微妙而强大的方式塑造消费者体验。
AI.research_question: 音乐在时尚零售环境中如何影响消费者行为，包括购买决策、品牌感知和情感参与？音乐节奏、品牌-音乐契合度和文化共鸣如何塑造消费者体验？
AI.motivation: 虽然视觉营销被广泛研究，但听觉维度在零售环境中仍未得到充分利用。本研究旨在探索音乐作为感官品牌重要组成部分的战略价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 感官营销理论、环境心理学、消费者行为理论、品牌管理理论、文化研究理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究：定量调查（165名受访者）和定性半结构化访谈（17人）。采用主题分析法识别出13个不同主题。
AI.findings: 1. 60%受访者表示音乐影响他们在店内的停留时间，61.9%表示如果喜欢音乐会更愿意停留更久；2. 38.8%报告音乐对情绪有强烈影响，27.3%表示有时影响购买决策；3. 文化音乐促进情感连接（特别是离散购物者），但不一定驱动购买；4. 快节奏音乐促使快速决策和冲动购买，但高音量可能产生排斥感；5. 慢节奏音乐鼓励放松、延长购物时间，常与奢侈品关联；6. 与品牌身份匹配的音乐使品牌显得更有意图和精心策划；7. 精心选择的音乐整体上有助于品牌忠诚度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为跨学科对话（营销、心理学、文化研究）做出贡献；2. 将声音定位为零售感官品牌中重要但未充分利用的组成部分；3. 扩展了感官营销理论框架；4. 深化了环境心理学在零售环境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为行业专业人士提供可操作的见解：如何通过音乐增强品牌感知、顾客停留时间和情感参与；2. 指导音乐选择策略：根据品牌身份和受众期望进行音乐匹配；3. 提供音乐节奏管理建议：快节奏促进冲动购买，慢节奏适合奢侈品；4. 强调文化音乐的情感价值，特别是在多元文化市场中。

title: Empirical Evidence for the Risk-Proportionality Principle: Proportional Transmission of Risk and Performance in the S&P 500 Index Fund and a Covered-Call ETF

detail.title: Empirical Evidence for the Risk-Proportionality Principle: Proportional Transmission of Risk and Performance in the S&P 500 Index Fund and a Covered-Call ETF
detail.abstract:
This paper provides empirical evidence for the Risk-Proportionality Principle (RPP), a real-world framework for option strategy performance. RPP relaxes the Sharperatio conservation assumption embedded in the Generalized Sharpe-Parity Principle (GSPP) and allows risk-adjusted performance to be transmitted proportionally rather than identically from the underlying asset. Using daily total-return data for an S&P 500 index fund and an S&P 500 Buy-Write ETF, we compute volatility and Sharpe ratios based on 12-month rolling windows. The relationship between the risk and performance measures of the two assets is examined through scatter-plot regression analysis.
We find strong and stable linear proportional relationships in both volatility and
Sharpe ratios across the full sample. Origin–constrained regressions exhibit sub-
stantially higher stability than free–intercept specifications. Zero–intercept bootstrap
Monte Carlo simulations further confirm the statistical robustness of the proportional
slopes.
Overall, the results are consistent with the central implication of RPP and sup-
port a real–world interpretation of option strategy performance based on proportional
transmission of risk and performance

AI.tldr: 本文为风险比例原则(RPP)提供了实证证据，该原则是期权策略绩效的现实框架。研究发现S&P 500指数基金和S&P 500买入-卖出ETF在波动率和夏普比率上存在稳定线性比例关系，支持风险调整绩效按比例而非完全一致地从基础资产传导的观点。
AI.research_question: 风险比例原则(RPP)是否能在现实市场中得到实证支持？具体而言，期权策略的风险调整绩效是否按比例而非完全一致地从基础资产传导？
AI.motivation: 广义夏普平价原则(GSPP)假设夏普比率完全守恒，这可能过于理想化。现实世界中，期权策略的风险调整绩效可能以比例方式而非完全一致地从基础资产传导，需要实证检验这一风险比例原则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险比例原则(RPP)作为理论框架，放松了广义夏普平价原则(GSPP)中的夏普比率完全守恒假设，允许风险调整绩效按比例从基础资产传导。
AI.method: 使用S&P 500指数基金和S&P 500买入-卖出ETF的日总回报数据，基于12个月滚动窗口计算波动率和夏普比率。通过散点图回归分析检验两个资产风险和绩效指标之间的关系，包括原点约束回归和零截距自助蒙特卡洛模拟。
AI.findings: 在整个样本期间，波动率和夏普比率均表现出强烈且稳定的线性比例关系。原点约束回归比自由截距规格显示出更高的稳定性。零截距自助蒙特卡洛模拟进一步证实了比例斜率的统计稳健性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为风险比例原则(RPP)提供了实证支持，验证了期权策略绩效按比例传导的理论框架，丰富了期权定价和绩效评估的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了更现实的期权策略绩效评估框架，有助于更准确地理解和管理期权投资组合的风险调整回报，支持基于比例传导的实际投资决策。

title: Facilitating Conceptual Translation in Cross-Cultural Research
affiliations: Moscow State Institute of International Relations (MGIMO)

detail.title: Facilitating Conceptual Translation in Cross-Cultural Research
detail.abstract: The adaptation of psychometric instruments developed by Western scholars is challenging given "cultural hegemony." Ignoring methodological biases arising from cultural-linguistic factors leads to invalid cross-cultural comparisons. The growing influence of non-Western cultures in global science necessitates a paradigm shift as the mere adaptation of Western tools often fails in different cultural contexts. Successful adaptation requires: 1. A proactive assessment of the cultural-linguistic distance (language, values, norms). 2. The involvement of expert native informants from the target culture and the use of qualitative methods (interviews, focus groups) to identify latent differences. 3. The development of instruments from scratch that accounts for the cultural peculiarities of basic concepts (e.g. "family," "adolescence"). 4. The application of rigorous methods, including back-translation, pilot studies, field observations, complemented by statistical control techniques. Minimizing cultural-linguistic interference is foundational to scientific rigor in the era of globalized research. Only a proactive, expert-informed approach that rejects the universalization of Western models can ensure the validity of cross-cultural comparisons.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了西方心理测量工具跨文化适应中的挑战，指出文化霸权导致的方法论偏差，并提出了包含文化语言距离评估、本土专家参与、从头开发工具和严格方法应用的四步解决方案，强调只有拒绝西方模型的普遍化才能确保跨文化比较的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何有效适应西方开发的心理学测量工具到非西方文化背景中，以确保跨文化比较的有效性？
AI.motivation: 随着非西方文化在全球科学中的影响力增强，单纯适应西方工具在不同文化背景下常常失败，忽略文化语言因素导致的方法论偏差会使跨文化比较无效，需要范式转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文化霸权理论、跨文化心理学、心理测量学、文化语言距离理论、本土心理学方法。
AI.method: 提出了一个四步方法论框架：1）主动评估文化语言距离；2）邀请目标文化本土专家参与并使用定性方法；3）从头开发考虑文化特性的工具；4）应用包括回译、试点研究、实地观察和统计控制技术的严格方法。
AI.findings: 成功的跨文化适应需要拒绝西方模型的普遍化，采用主动的、专家知情的方法，最小化文化语言干扰是全球化研究时代科学严谨性的基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了西方心理测量工具的普遍适用性假设，提出了文化语言距离评估的理论框架，强调了本土专家在工具开发中的核心作用，为跨文化心理学研究提供了新的方法论范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员提供了具体的四步操作指南，帮助开发有效且文化敏感的心理测量工具，提高跨文化研究的科学严谨性，促进全球科学研究的平等参与。

title: Epistemic Translation: Infrastructure for Democratic Knowledge Governance Under Uncertainty Author Information

detail.title: Epistemic Translation: Infrastructure for Democratic Knowledge Governance Under Uncertainty Author Information

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No other conflicts of interest to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper presents theoretical framework development and design science research. No empirical studies involving human participants were conducted.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently without financial support from any organization.

keywords: Design Science Paper Type: Design Science Research -Framework Development

detail.abstract: Scientific uncertainty is routinely destroyed when crossing science→policy→media→public interfaces, creating predictable trust collapses when models update. This paper applies design science methodology to propose epistemic translation: a suite of standardized protocols, institutional mechanisms, and deliberative processes that preserve type-specific uncertainty, separate probability (P) from utility (U), communicate epistemic volatility, and extend quality assurance to affected communities. We diagnose the translation failure as a "lossy compression" problem where confidence intervals become point estimates, update expectations become betrayal narratives, and provisional models become false certainties. We contribute an enforceable, auditable translation standard-the Epistemic Due Process Checklist (EDPC)-paired with five translation invariants, confidence trail versioning, extended peer deliberation mechanisms, and explicit threat models for system gaming. The framework targets post-normal science contexts where facts are uncertain, values are in dispute, stakes are high, and decisions are urgent. We provide conformance testing procedures, a machine-readable schema, implementation profiles for crisis/policy/media/AI contexts, and a complete worked example demonstrating end-to-end application. Core thesis: Science's strength is being wrong in structured, informative ways. Translation destroys this structure. The solution is infrastructure that preserves it-and extends quality assurance to affected communities, not just experts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"认知翻译"框架，通过标准化协议、制度机制和审议流程，在科学→政策→媒体→公众的传播过程中保留不确定性，防止信任崩溃。核心贡献是可执行的认知正当程序清单（EDPC）及相关工具。
AI.research_question: 如何在科学→政策→媒体→公众的传播过程中有效保留和传达科学不确定性，防止信任崩溃？
AI.motivation: 科学不确定性在跨界面传播时经常被消除，导致模型更新时出现可预测的信任崩溃，特别是在后常态科学背景下（事实不确定、价值观争议、风险高、决策紧迫）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设计科学方法论、后常态科学理论、认知翻译理论、损失压缩问题分析、质量保证扩展理论。
AI.method: 设计科学研究方法，包括诊断分析、框架开发、协议设计、实施配置和完整案例演示。
AI.findings: 提出了认知翻译框架，包括EDPC清单、五个翻译不变量、置信度追踪版本控制、扩展同行审议机制和系统博弈的明确威胁模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将翻译失败诊断为"损失压缩"问题；2) 提出认知翻译理论框架；3) 扩展质量保证到受影响社区；4) 为后常态科学提供系统解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 可执行的EDPC清单；2) 机器可读模式；3) 危机/政策/媒体/AI背景的实施配置；4) 一致性测试程序；5) 完整应用案例。

title: Navigating Upwork: Understanding Corporate Dynamics and Unveiling Freelancer Realities Amid Policy Disruption

detail.title: Navigating Upwork: Understanding Corporate Dynamics and Unveiling Freelancer Realities Amid Policy Disruption
detail.abstract: This study delves into the dynamics of the freelancing market within the framework of the sharing economy and the pervasive influence of social media. By examining key indicators such as popularity, feedback volume, percentage of positive feedback, and the number of projects, the research provides valuable insights for both freelancers seeking work and clients in need of cost-effective solutions for one-time engagements or staff augmentation. Focusing on Upwork, the platform perceived as the industry leader by freelancers, this study aims to evaluate whether Upwork delivers on its promise of providing a safe and hassle-free marketplace where freelancers can earn a sustainable income. The research explores the treatment of freelancers compared to hiring companies, scrutinizing Upwork's policies, enforcement mechanisms, and the penalties applied for policy violations. It investigates the concept of fairness from the perspective of freelancers, highlighting disparities and real-world implications of policy enforcement. Furthermore, the study identifies potential loopholes and backdoors that freelancers might exploit to circumvent Upwork's policies, thereby avoiding penalties. By examining these aspects, the research aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of Upwork's operational governance and its impact on freelancers' experiences. The analysis includes a comparison of how the perception of fairness differs among freelancers and whether Upwork applies its policies consistently and equitably. The article also situates Upwork within the broader sharing economy landscape, drawing analogies with other prominent platforms like Uber, Airbnb, DoorDash, Grubhub, and Postmates. It examines the interconnections, influences, and impacts of social media on Upwork's operations, marketing strategies, community building efforts, and reputation management. This examination of Upwork's corporate dynamics and market positioning transitions seamlessly into an in-depth analysis of its daily operations and governance. The study bridges the gap between understanding Upwork as a business entity and evaluating its practical implications for freelancers, offering a holistic view of its role in the modern freelancing ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了Upwork自由职业平台在共享经济中的运作机制，分析平台政策执行、公平性感知及自由职业者体验，并与Uber、Airbnb等其他共享经济平台进行比较。
AI.research_question: Upwork是否兑现了为自由职业者提供安全、无麻烦且可持续收入市场的承诺？平台政策执行是否公平一致？自由职业者与雇佣公司待遇有何差异？
AI.motivation: 随着共享经济和社交媒体的发展，自由职业市场快速增长。Upwork作为行业领导者，其平台治理对自由职业者的生计至关重要，但平台承诺与实际体验可能存在差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 共享经济理论、平台治理理论、公平理论、社交媒体影响力理论、数字劳动市场理论
AI.method: 通过分析Upwork平台的关键指标（人气、反馈量、正面反馈比例、项目数量），审查平台政策、执行机制和违规处罚，比较自由职业者与雇佣公司待遇，并与其他共享经济平台进行类比分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现Upwork平台存在政策执行不一致、自由职业者与雇佣公司待遇差异、公平性感知分歧等问题。自由职业者可能利用政策漏洞规避处罚，平台治理存在改进空间。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了共享经济平台治理理论，深化了对数字劳动市场中公平性概念的理解，为平台政策执行机制研究提供了新视角，丰富了社交媒体对平台运营影响的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为自由职业者提供平台使用策略建议，帮助客户选择合适自由职业者，为Upwork等平台改进治理提供参考，为政策制定者监管共享经济平台提供依据。

title: Numerical Transform Inversion for Transient M/G/1 Performance Measures
affiliations: Tilburg University - Department of Econometrics & Operations Research

detail.title: Numerical Transform Inversion for Transient M/G/1 Performance Measures
detail.abstract: This paper is concerned with transient performance measures of the M/G/1 queueing system. Typically, the transforms of these time-dependent quantities are expressed in terms of the transform of the busy period distribution or of the distribution of the number of customers served in busy period. The latter are only implicitly given as the solution of a functional equation. To avoid the solution of these functional equations at many complex arguments a substitution is used to transform the original contour integrals with implicitly determined transforms as part of the integrand into alternative contour integrals with only known transforms in the integrand. The alternative contour integrals can be evaluated by the same techniques as the original ones.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种改进的M/G/1排队系统瞬态性能分析方法，通过变量替换将包含隐式变换的原始围道积分转换为仅包含已知变换的替代围道积分，避免了在多个复参数上求解函数方程。
AI.research_question: 如何更有效地计算M/G/1排队系统的瞬态性能指标，避免在多个复参数上求解隐式函数方程？
AI.motivation: 传统M/G/1排队系统瞬态性能分析中，相关变换通常表示为忙期分布变换或忙期服务顾客数分布变换的函数，而这些变换本身需要通过函数方程隐式求解。在多个复参数上求解这些函数方程计算成本高昂。
AI.theoretical_framework: 排队论、M/G/1排队系统、瞬态分析、围道积分、变换方法、忙期理论
AI.method: 提出变量替换技术，将原始包含隐式变换的围道积分转换为仅包含已知变换的替代围道积分，然后使用与原始方法相同的技术评估这些替代积分。
AI.findings: 通过变量替换方法，可以避免在多个复参数上求解隐式函数方程，从而更高效地计算M/G/1排队系统的瞬态性能指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了M/G/1排队系统瞬态分析的新计算方法，扩展了围道积分在排队论中的应用，为处理隐式变换提供了新的数学工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 该方法显著降低了M/G/1排队系统瞬态性能分析的计算复杂度，使工程师和研究人员能够更高效地进行系统性能评估和优化。

title: The Impact of Impatience on Productivity Among Teenagers: A Survey Analysis

detail.title: The Impact of Impatience on Productivity Among Teenagers: A Survey Analysis
detail.abstract: This research examines the relation between impatience and academic/personal productivity within a group of 112 adolescents. The adolescents were divided into two main age groups (12-15 year olds and 16-19 year olds). The study employed a survey to measure self-reported behaviors associated with concentration, time management, decision-making, and self-perception. While (81.3%) consider themselves reasonably productive, their impatience-driven habits reveal a significant gap between how productive they think they are and how productive they actually behave. Specifically, (82.2%) reported regretting fast decisions, and (80.4%) engage in multitasking. Comparative analysis revealed that impatience-related issues like rushing work (45.0%) and extreme procrastination (55.0%) are significantly more prevalent in the 16-19 age group compared to the 12-15 age group. The paper suggests that teenagers often confuse the speed derived from urgency in genuine productivity, underscoring the need for education on strategic time management over dependence on high-pressure, last-minute efforts.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了112名青少年的不耐烦与学术/个人生产力之间的关系。研究发现，虽然81.3%的青少年认为自己相当有生产力，但他们的不耐烦习惯（如82.2%后悔快速决策、80.4%多任务处理）揭示了自我认知与实际行为之间的显著差距。16-19岁组比12-15岁组在匆忙完成工作（45.0%）和极端拖延（55.0%）方面问题更严重。
AI.research_question: 青少年不耐烦与学术/个人生产力之间存在怎样的关系？不同年龄组（12-15岁 vs 16-19岁）在不耐烦相关行为上有何差异？
AI.motivation: 青少年经常面临时间管理和生产力挑战，但缺乏对不耐烦如何影响其实际生产力的理解。需要研究青少年如何混淆紧迫感带来的速度与真正的生产力，以及这种混淆如何影响他们的学术和个人表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于时间管理理论、决策理论（特别是冲动决策）和自我认知理论。研究探讨了不耐烦作为认知和行为特征如何影响生产力，以及自我评估与实际行为之间的差距。
AI.method: 对112名青少年（分为12-15岁和16-19岁两个年龄组）进行调查研究。使用问卷调查测量自我报告的集中力、时间管理、决策制定和自我感知相关行为。
AI.findings: 1. 81.3%的青少年认为自己相当有生产力，但存在显著的自我认知与实际行为差距；2. 82.2%后悔快速决策；3. 80.4%从事多任务处理；4. 16-19岁组比12-15岁组在匆忙完成工作（45.0%）和极端拖延（55.0%）方面问题更严重；5. 青少年经常混淆紧迫感带来的速度与真正的生产力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了青少年发展心理学中不耐烦与生产力关系的研究；2. 揭示了青少年自我认知与实际行为之间的系统性差距；3. 提供了不同年龄组在不耐烦相关行为上的发展差异证据；4. 理论化了"速度-生产力混淆"现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为教育工作者和家长提供识别青少年生产力问题的工具；2. 强调需要教育青少年区分紧迫感驱动的速度与真正的生产力；3. 建议开发针对性的时间管理培训，减少对高压、最后一分钟努力的依赖；4. 为青少年发展项目提供实证依据。

title: When Algorithms Meet Ethics: Systematic Evidence Of Framing Effects In LLM Organizational Decision-Making

detail.title: When Algorithms Meet Ethics: Systematic Evidence Of Framing Effects In LLM Organizational Decision-Making
detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as decision-support tools in organizational contexts, yet their susceptibility to contextual framing remains poorly understood. This preregistered experimental study systematically examines how six framing dimensions-procedural justice, outcome severity, stakeholder power, resource scarcity, temporal urgency, and transparency requirements-influence ethical recommendations from three frontier models: Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, and Gemini 1.5 Pro. We developed 5,000 unique organizational vignettes using a fractional factorial experimental design with balanced industry representation, generating 15,000 total model responses. After excluding responses without clear recommendations (n=694, 4.6%), we analyzed 14,306 responses using logistic regression with robust and clustered standard errors. We find that resource scarcity increases endorsement probability by 12.0 percentage points (pp) (OR = 1.67, 95% CI [1.45, 1.93], p < .001), while outcome severity reduces it by 11.3pp (OR = 0.62, 95% CI [0.54, 0.71], p < .001), and procedural justice reduces it by 10.1pp (OR = 0.66, 95% CI [0.57, 0.76], p < .001). These effect sizes are comparable to classical framing research (Tversky & Kahneman: 22pp; McNeil et al.: 18pp) and represent substantial shifts in organizational decision contexts. When multiple framing dimensions align in ethically unfavorable directions, cumulative effects reach approximately 27pp from baseline (range: 25-28pp depending on interaction assumptions), with maximum-to-minimum framing creating a 54-percentage-point total range approaching complete recommendation reversals. Effects appear consistently across all three models, with no significant Dimension × Model interactions, suggesting fundamental architectural properties rather than implementation-specific artifacts. Topic modeling of justification text from the 14,306 analyzed responses reveals systematic "adaptive rationalization"-models invoke utilitarian reasoning when contexts emphasize constraints (+6.7pp in high resource scarcity), deontological reasoning when contexts emphasize high stakes (+2.4pp in high outcome severity), and virtue/justice ethics when contexts emphasize fair processes (+4.4pp in high procedural justice). This suggests models select ethical frameworks to justify contextually appropriate conclusions rather than applying consistent principles across situations. Human validation confirms these patterns reflect genuine framing sensitivity rather than measurement artifacts. Crowdworker validation (n=7,500 responses, one rater each) achieved substantial agreement (Fleiss' κ = 0.71) and 81.3% concordance with expert codings. Subject matter expert evaluation (n=24 experts, 100 vignette pairs each including 20 control pairs, 2,400 total comparisons) detected framing-driven differences in 48.9% of pairs (net of 18.3% baseline false-positive rate), but correctly attributed differences to manipulated dimensions in only 41.3% of cases. Most detected differences (58.7%) were judged problematic for AI advisory systems. These findings raise fundamental questions about deploying LLMs for consequential organizational decisions where surface features may inappropriately influence outcomes. We discuss implications for AI governance, organizational ethics, and the design of more robust decision-support systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过预注册实验发现，大型语言模型在组织决策支持中容易受到情境框架的影响，资源稀缺性增加12.0个百分点的支持概率，而结果严重性和程序公正性分别减少11.3和10.1个百分点。当多个框架维度在伦理不利方向上对齐时，累积效应可达27个百分点，最大到最小框架差异达54个百分点，接近完全建议反转。模型表现出"适应性合理化"，根据情境选择不同的伦理框架来合理化结论。
AI.research_question: 六个框架维度（程序公正性、结果严重性、利益相关者权力、资源稀缺性、时间紧迫性、透明度要求）如何影响前沿大型语言模型的伦理建议？
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型越来越多地被部署为组织决策支持工具，但其对情境框架的敏感性仍未被充分理解。需要系统研究框架效应对模型伦理建议的影响，以评估其在重要组织决策中的可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于框架效应理论（Tversky & Kahneman），结合组织决策中的伦理框架（功利主义、义务论、美德/正义伦理），研究情境框架如何影响AI系统的建议。
AI.method: 预注册实验研究，采用分数阶乘实验设计，创建5000个独特的组织情境案例，涵盖平衡的行业代表性。使用三个前沿模型（Claude 3.5 Sonnet、GPT-4o、Gemini 1.5 Pro）生成15000个响应。排除无明确建议的响应后，分析14306个响应，使用逻辑回归和稳健聚类标准误。进行人类验证（众包工作者和领域专家评估）。
AI.findings: 资源稀缺性增加支持概率12.0个百分点（OR=1.67），结果严重性减少11.3个百分点（OR=0.62），程序公正性减少10.1个百分点（OR=0.66）。当多个框架维度在伦理不利方向上对齐时，累积效应可达27个百分点，最大到最小框架差异达54个百分点。三个模型效应一致，无显著维度×模型交互作用。主题建模显示"适应性合理化"模式：资源稀缺时更多功利主义推理，结果严重时更多义务论推理，程序公平时更多美德/正义伦理推理。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次系统量化了LLMs在组织决策中对情境框架的敏感性；2）发现了"适应性合理化"现象，即模型根据情境选择不同的伦理框架来合理化结论；3）证明了框架效应是LLMs的基本架构特性而非实现特定的人工产物；4）将经典框架效应研究扩展到AI决策支持系统。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为AI治理提供实证依据，强调需要监管框架敏感性的风险；2）为组织伦理实践提供指导，警示在重要决策中依赖LLMs的风险；3）为设计更稳健的决策支持系统提供方向；4）为AI系统评估和验证提供方法论框架。

title: Judgment Call in Business Leadership: Critical Decisions, People Choices, and Strategic Paths in Uncertain Environments

detail.title: Judgment Call in Business Leadership: Critical Decisions, People Choices, and Strategic Paths in Uncertain Environments
detail.abstract: This article offers an integrated analysis of business decision-making-what we call a judgment call-through a dialogue between classic and contemporary authors in leadership, strategy, and cognitive psychology. Building on Charan, Drotter, and Noel (2007), the study broadens the core concept of judgment by incorporating insights from Kahneman (2011), Collins (2001), Klein (1999), Taleb (2007; 2012), Heath & Heath (2013), and Drucker (1967). The goal is to demonstrate that effective decisions in business projects depend on a combination of rational analysis, trained intuition, proper people selection, contextual awareness, and the ability to operate under uncertainty. It concludes that executive judgment is not just an individual skill but a process reliant on the quality of human relationships, cognitive systems, and organizational environment.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对领导力、战略和认知心理学领域经典与当代作者的对话，提出了"判断力决策"的综合分析框架。研究扩展了判断力的核心概念，强调有效的商业决策需要理性分析、训练有素的直觉、恰当的人员选择、情境意识和不确定性应对能力的结合。
AI.research_question: 什么是有效的商业决策（判断力决策）？它需要哪些关键要素和能力的结合？
AI.motivation: 商业决策通常被简化为理性分析过程，但实际决策涉及更复杂的认知、人际关系和组织因素。需要整合不同学科视角来全面理解判断力决策的本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了Charan等人的领导力管道理论、Kahneman的思考快与慢、Collins的从优秀到卓越、Klein的自然决策理论、Taleb的黑天鹅理论、Heath兄弟的决策心理学以及Drucker的管理思想。
AI.method: 采用跨学科文献综述和理论整合方法，通过对经典与当代作者的理论对话，构建综合性的判断力决策分析框架。
AI.findings: 有效的商业决策依赖于五个关键要素的结合：理性分析、训练有素的直觉、恰当的人员选择、情境意识和不确定性应对能力。高管判断力不仅是个人技能，更是依赖于人际关系质量、认知系统和组织环境的系统性过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"判断力决策"的综合理论框架，整合了领导力、战略和认知心理学视角，扩展了传统决策理论对理性分析的过度依赖，强调了直觉、人际关系和组织环境的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了更全面的决策指导框架，强调需要培养多元能力组合，建立支持高质量判断的组织环境和人际关系网络，在不确定性中做出更有效的商业决策。

reference: FRB of Boston Supervisory Research & Analysis Unit Working Paper No. SRA 26-01
title: A Framework for Understanding the Vulnerabilities of New Money-Like Products
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: A Framework for Understanding the Vulnerabilities of New Money-Like Products

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Boston Supervisory Research & Analysis Unit Working Paper No. SRA 26-01
publicationDetails.journalName: FRB-Boston: Supervisory Research & Analysis Unit Working Papers (Topic)

detail.abstract: New money-like products, such as tokenized money market funds (MMFs), money market exchange-traded funds (MMETFs), and stablecoins, could be transformative for finance. These products may offer significant benefits, but like other money-like assets, they also have certain vulnerabilities. We introduce a framework to analyze the vulnerabilities of new products by comparing their features to those that contribute to vulnerabilities in MMFs. Specifically, we examine the extent to which each product engages in liquidity transformation, is subject to threshold effects, serves as a money-like asset, poses contagion risks, and has reactive investors. Our framework is useful for assessing the potential effects of novel cash-like products on the overall resilience of the financial system and how such an assessment may change as these products’ uses evolve.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个分析新型货币类产品（如代币化货币市场基金、稳定币等）脆弱性的框架，通过比较这些产品与货币市场基金的脆弱性特征，评估其对金融系统韧性的潜在影响。
AI.research_question: 新型货币类产品（如代币化货币市场基金、稳定币等）具有哪些脆弱性特征？如何评估这些产品对金融系统整体韧性的潜在影响？
AI.motivation: 新型货币类产品（代币化MMF、MMETF、稳定币等）可能对金融体系产生变革性影响，它们既带来显著益处，也像其他货币类资产一样存在脆弱性。需要建立一个分析框架来评估这些产品的风险特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于货币市场基金（MMF）脆弱性特征的分析框架，包括流动性转换程度、阈值效应、货币类资产属性、传染风险和投资者行为反应性等五个维度。
AI.method: 比较分析法：通过将新型货币类产品的特征与货币市场基金的脆弱性特征进行比较，分析每个产品在五个维度上的表现程度。
AI.findings: 建立了评估新型货币类产品脆弱性的系统性框架，能够识别不同产品在流动性转换、阈值效应、货币属性、传染风险和投资者反应性等方面的风险特征差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个用于分析新型货币类产品脆弱性的理论框架，扩展了传统金融脆弱性理论的应用范围，为理解数字时代货币类产品的风险特征提供了新的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构、金融机构和投资者提供了评估新型货币类产品风险的实用工具，有助于识别系统性风险，制定相应的监管政策和风险管理措施，增强金融系统韧性。

title: Path to Reducing Pesticide Input: Is Agricultural Production Outsourcing Effective?

detail.title: Path to Reducing Pesticide Input: Is Agricultural Production Outsourcing Effective?
detail.abstract: Excessive pesticide application in intensive farming systems poses serious environmental and health risks, yet the pathway to reducing pesticide input while maintaining crop yields remains debated. This study investigates whether agricultural service outsourcing, as an emerging form of organizational innovation in smallholder farming systems, contributes to the reduction of pesticide input in wheat production in China. Drawing on three-wave farmer-plot panel data from Jiangsu Province collected between 2020 and 2022, we employ a comprehensive identification strategy that integrates propensity score matching, instrumental variables, and double machine learning methods to address selection bias. The results show that participation in outsourcing services significantly reduces wheat pesticide expenditure by 41–57 yuan/mu (approximately 35–40%). Notably, this effect is primarily concentrated in labor-intensive operations such as land preparation, straw returning, and harvesting, rather than in the pesticide spraying process itself. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the pesticide reduction effect is stronger in wheat than in rice, reflecting crop-specific technological complementarities. Mechanism analysis identifies three channels: improved mechanization levels, economies of scale arising from land concentration, and increased commercialization rates. These findings suggest that service outsourcing functions as a “systemic prevention” intervention, reducing pest and disease pressure through enhanced agricultural practices, rather than merely serving as an alternative application method. This study advances understanding of how organizational innovations can help reconcile agricultural productivity with sustainability objectives in smallholder farming systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨农业服务外包能否减少中国小麦生产中的农药使用。基于江苏2020-2022年农户地块面板数据，采用PSM、IV和双机器学习方法，发现外包服务使农药支出减少35-40%，主要通过土地整理、秸秆还田和收获等环节的机械化、规模经济和商业化实现，而非直接替代喷洒过程。
AI.research_question: 农业服务外包作为小农户系统中的组织创新，是否有助于减少中国小麦生产中的农药投入？
AI.motivation: 集约化农业中过量使用农药带来严重的环境和健康风险，但如何在保持产量的同时减少农药投入仍存在争议。需要探索组织创新在促进可持续农业中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织创新理论、小农户系统转型理论、农业服务外包作为系统性预防干预的理论框架
AI.method: 使用江苏2020-2022年三波农户地块面板数据，采用倾向得分匹配（PSM）、工具变量（IV）和双机器学习方法解决选择偏误问题
AI.findings: 参与外包服务显著减少小麦农药支出41-57元/亩（约35-40%）；效果主要集中在土地整理、秸秆还田和收获等劳动密集型环节，而非农药喷洒本身；小麦的农药减少效应强于水稻；机制包括机械化水平提升、土地集中带来的规模经济、商业化率提高
AI.theory_contributions: 提出服务外包作为"系统性预防"干预的理论框架，阐明组织创新如何通过改善农业实践而非替代应用方法来减少病虫害压力；深化了对小农户系统中组织创新协调农业生产力和可持续性目标的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供通过推广农业服务外包减少农药使用的实证依据；为小农户提供通过参与外包服务实现可持续生产的可行路径；揭示了不同作物技术互补性的差异，为针对性推广提供参考

title: Strategic Experimentation with Hidden Hard Constraints Belief Misspecification, Misleading Learning, and Inefficient

detail.title: Strategic Experimentation with Hidden Hard Constraints Belief Misspecification, Misleading Learning, and Inefficient
detail.abstract: We study a repeated game in which one player optimizes subjectively under belief misspecification while another tolerates boundary-adjacent actions only up to a privately known hard constraint. Termination is irreversible and occurs deterministically once cumulative violations exceed this threshold. The experimenting player understands that collapse is possible but treats it as exogenous, ruling out any dependence on accumulated behavior. We show that, under mild behavioral selection conditions, subjectively optimal experimentation generically induces inefficient collapse, even with patient, forward-looking, and fully history-dependent strategies. A planner who internalizes the hard constraint preserves continuation. Allowing for Bayesian learning within the misspecified hazard class does not mitigate this inefficiency. Instead, survival is misinterpreted as evidence of safety, reinforcing experimentation and potentially accelerating collapse.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在信念错误设定下，一方玩家主观优化而另一方有私有硬约束的重复博弈。主观优化者将崩溃视为外生事件，忽略其与累积行为的关系，导致即使有耐心、前瞻性和完全历史依赖策略，也会普遍引发低效崩溃。规划者若内部化硬约束则可维持持续。贝叶斯学习反而会加剧问题，将生存误解为安全性证据，强化实验并可能加速崩溃。
AI.research_question: 在信念错误设定和私有硬约束的重复博弈中，主观优化实验如何导致低效崩溃？规划者内部化约束能否避免崩溃？贝叶斯学习是否能缓解这种低效性？
AI.motivation: 研究现实世界中决策者经常在错误信念下行动，忽略其行为对系统稳定性的累积影响（如环境破坏、金融风险等）。这种信念错误设定可能导致系统性崩溃，即使决策者看似理性、耐心且考虑历史。
AI.theoretical_framework: 重复博弈理论、主观优化理论、信念错误设定理论、硬约束阈值模型、外生崩溃假设、贝叶斯学习框架。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：构建重复博弈模型，其中一方在主观信念下优化，另一方有私有硬约束阈值。分析主观最优策略的性质，比较规划者解决方案，并引入贝叶斯学习扩展分析。
AI.findings: 1. 主观优化实验普遍导致低效崩溃，即使玩家有耐心、前瞻性和完全历史依赖策略；2. 规划者内部化硬约束可维持持续；3. 贝叶斯学习不能缓解低效性，反而将生存误解为安全性证据，强化实验并可能加速崩溃。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 形式化了信念错误设定下重复博弈的崩溃机制；2. 揭示了主观优化与系统约束之间的根本冲突；3. 证明了贝叶斯学习在错误设定模型下的反直觉效果；4. 提供了规划者解决方案的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供警示：在复杂系统中，即使看似理性的决策者也可能引发系统性崩溃；2. 强调需要内部化系统约束的监管机制；3. 指出单纯的学习可能加剧问题，需要结构性干预；4. 为风险管理、环境政策、金融监管等领域提供理论指导。

title: Feature Transfer and Fuzzy Clustering for Bearing Degradation Prediction under Complex Operating Conditions

detail.title: Feature Transfer and Fuzzy Clustering for Bearing Degradation Prediction under Complex Operating Conditions
detail.abstract: Bearing degradation predictions are critical to ensure reliable and efficient operations of rotating machinery, enabling timely fault diagnosis and maintenance scheduling. However, various loads and complex operating conditions lead to significant discrepancies in sample distributions, which in turn reduce prediction accuracy. To address this problem, a novel degradation prediction method based on transfer subspace learning and fuzzy clustering is proposed. First, semi-supervised domain adaptation algorithms, namely Transfer Component Analysis (TCA) and Correlation Alignment (CORAL), are introduced to learn and adapt features from laboratory to turbine situations. Second, fuzzy clustering is applied to determine feature centers associated with healthy and fault states. Third, fault predictions are determined by comparing transferred features with these centers. Based on the experimental results, this paper confirms that the proposed method can achieve improved prediction performance for wind turbine bearing degradation, with an RMSE of 0.058 and an MAE of 0.0453, representing reductions of 28.8% and 17.7% compared with BP and LSTM, respectively. In addition, the training time is shortened to 32.6s.The results confirm the superiority and essentiality of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于迁移子空间学习和模糊聚类的轴承退化预测方法，通过TCA和CORAL算法将实验室特征迁移到风机工况，结合模糊聚类确定健康与故障状态特征中心，显著提升了风电轴承退化预测性能。
AI.research_question: 如何在样本分布存在显著差异的不同工况下，提高风电轴承退化预测的准确性？
AI.motivation: 轴承退化预测对旋转机械的可靠高效运行至关重要，但不同负载和复杂工况导致样本分布差异大，降低了预测精度，需要解决跨工况的预测问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 迁移学习理论（特别是域适应）、子空间学习理论、模糊聚类理论
AI.method: 1. 使用TCA和CORAL半监督域适应算法从实验室到风机工况的特征迁移；2. 应用模糊聚类确定健康与故障状态的特征中心；3. 通过比较迁移特征与特征中心进行故障预测
AI.findings: 该方法显著提升了风电轴承退化预测性能：RMSE为0.058，MAE为0.0453，相比BP和LSTM分别降低了28.8%和17.7%，训练时间缩短至32.6秒
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将迁移子空间学习与模糊聚类结合用于轴承退化预测；2. 提出了跨工况的特征适应框架；3. 验证了半监督域适应在机械故障预测中的有效性
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为风电轴承退化预测提供了更准确的解决方案；2. 缩短了模型训练时间，提高了预测效率；3. 支持更及时的故障诊断和维护调度决策

title: Unpacking the Psychiatric Side of Entrepreneurship: How ADHD, Narcissism, and Hypomania Shape Entrepreneurial Intention Through Self-Efficacy
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice and Université de Kairouan

detail.title: Unpacking the Psychiatric Side of Entrepreneurship: How ADHD, Narcissism, and Hypomania Shape Entrepreneurial Intention Through Self-Efficacy
detail.abstract: Entrepreneurial intention (EI) reflects a key cognitive-motivational state that drives individuals toward new venture creation. While existing research has primarily examined conventional personality traits, less attention has been given to psychiatric traits often considered maladaptive in shaping entrepreneurial motivation. Drawing on person-environment fit theory and the Theory of Planned Behavior, this study investigates how ADHD symptoms, narcissism, and hypomania influence EI among university students, with entrepreneurial self-efficacy (ESE) as a potential mediating mechanism. Data were collected from 140 university students using validated self-report measures and analyzed through multiple regression and mediation analyses. Results reveal that ADHD symptoms positively predict EI, partially mediated by ESE; narcissism exhibits a negative relationship with EI and hypomania shows no significant effect. These findings suggest that traits traditionally viewed as maladaptive under supportive educational conditions, foster entrepreneurial motivation. Implications for management education include developing inclusive and experiential learning environments that harness diverse cognitive and personality profiles to strengthen students’ ESE and entrepreneurial engagement.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了传统上被视为适应不良的精神特质（ADHD症状、自恋和轻躁狂）如何影响大学生的创业意向，发现ADHD症状通过创业自我效能感正向预测创业意向，自恋则呈负相关，轻躁狂无显著影响。
AI.research_question: ADHD症状、自恋和轻躁狂这三种传统上被视为适应不良的精神特质如何影响大学生的创业意向？创业自我效能感在其中是否起到中介作用？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注传统人格特质对创业意向的影响，而较少关注那些通常被视为适应不良的精神特质（如ADHD、自恋、轻躁狂）在塑造创业动机中的作用。这些特质可能在特定环境下反而促进创业行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人-环境匹配理论和计划行为理论，探讨精神特质与创业意向的关系，并引入创业自我效能感作为中介机制。
AI.method: 采用横断面研究设计，对140名大学生使用经过验证的自我报告量表收集数据，通过多元回归和中介分析进行统计分析。
AI.findings: 1. ADHD症状正向预测创业意向，部分通过创业自我效能感中介；2. 自恋与创业意向呈负相关；3. 轻躁狂对创业意向无显著影响；4. 传统上被视为适应不良的特质在支持性教育环境下可能促进创业动机。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了创业意向研究，将传统上被视为适应不良的精神特质纳入分析框架；2. 验证了人-环境匹配理论在创业情境下的适用性；3. 揭示了创业自我效能感在特质与意向之间的中介作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为管理教育提供启示：应开发包容性和体验式学习环境；2. 利用多样化的认知和人格特征来增强学生的创业自我效能感和创业参与度；3. 为创业教育中如何支持具有不同特质的学生提供实践指导。
